He praised Maryam, Alishba and Mir Hussain for displaying “exceptional patience, courage, dignity and civility” throughout the proceedings.
The chairman also thanked Additional Home Secretary Javed Abro, Section Officer Ejaz Ali Bhatti, and Deputy Home Secretary Naveed Arain for promptly responding to the commission’s directions and requests.
“They have worked very hard,” the order stated.
Justice Sial commended Nasir, counsel for the Mir Hussain family, for assisting the commission with dedication and maintaining a dignified attitude.
He also thanked Sindh Advocate General Javad Dero for appearing before the commission with dignity and civility after making a mistake on one occasion.
The commission chairman acknowledged lawyers Maruf Hussain and Khalid Mumtaz, who represented some of the witnesses, for complying with the commission’s requests and helping maintain its dignity and decorum.
He also praised members of the press and media for attending every hearing and reporting the proceedings professionally, accurately and seriously.
Justice Sial specifically mentioned journalists Babar Saleem and Sault Jafri, saying their investigative work had greatly assisted him, although they were unaware that their reporting was helping the commission.
Read More: Mir Raza judicial commission’s term extended until October 15
The chairman thanked all witnesses who appeared before the commission and maintained restraint and dignity while answering its questions.
He also acknowledged people who provided information that assisted him in his work, as well as those who had consistently criticised the commission.
Justice Sial concluded by praising the commission’s staff for working with dedication and commitment, often until late at night.
He requested the Sindh government to consider granting the staff a bonus equivalent to two basic salaries, noting that their pay was relatively low.
With the recording of statements completed and its communication channels deactivated, the commission has formally brought its proceedings to an end.

items.author: News Desk
items.content:
They were alive, eligible to vote and still living at the addresses listed on their electoral records. Yet, in Karnataka’s ongoing revision of electoral rolls, eight voters were allegedly marked dead and targeted for deletion — six of them Muslim women.
The cases have surfaced in Vijayapura, where expelled BJP MLA Basanagouda Patil Yatnal submitted a list seeking the deletion of 1,054 voters on August 31, barely a week after the draft electoral rolls were published on August 24.
According to activists and the affected voters, the deletion requests were supported by death certificates that matched the voters’ names but carried different details, including the names of parents or spouses and addresses.
Also Read: India detains several in Gen Z voter protests
The victims include Malanbi Jamadar, 57; Mahabubi Peerazade Jahagirdar, 35; and Raziya Mehrunnisa Sheikh, 35, a resident of Ward-22, Langar Bazaar.
Government teacher Allama Bagwan, along with Abdul Razak Bagwan and Mumtaj Mulla, were also among those reportedly listed for deletion.
Activist Irfan Sheikh said the eight voters whose cases had been identified were alive and that the remaining 1,046 names on the list were also being verified.
The controversy has raised fresh questions over the use of bulk applications to remove voters from electoral rolls, particularly in constituencies with sizeable Muslim populations.
Bulk deletion requests
The allegations emerged during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, a nationwide exercise being overseen by Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
Activists claim more than 4,000 bulk Form-7 applications — the form used to request deletion of names from electoral rolls — have been submitted across Karnataka, with a significant number targeting Muslim voters.
In Babaleshwar alone, 1,373 Form-7 applications were reportedly submitted on September 22. Of these, 1,363 applications were allegedly filed by just 10 people.
The developments triggered protests outside the Vijayapura Deputy Commissioner’s office, while affected women and activists later held a press conference organised by Jagrutha Karnataka in Bengaluru.
The women demanded criminal cases against Yatnal, accusing him of attempting to facilitate the wrongful removal of legitimate voters from the electoral rolls.
Inquiry ordered
District Electoral Officer K Anand ordered an inquiry after preliminary scrutiny found that some of the death certificates submitted with the deletion requests appeared to belong to people with the same names as the voters or raised questions about their authenticity.
The findings have intensified concerns over whether electoral safeguards were followed before deletion requests were submitted or processed.
Under electoral procedures, objections seeking deletion of a voter’s name are subject to verification. The use of allegedly mismatched death certificates has therefore become a central issue in the Vijayapura controversy.
Yatnal has defended the electoral revision process and Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. He has also publicly alleged that "Muslims are the bogus voters”, a claim that has drawn criticism from activists who say the ongoing exercise risks disproportionately disenfranchising Muslim citizens.
The Vijayapura cases have become a flashpoint in the wider debate over the SIR, with activists warning that wrongful deletions could deprive eligible citizens of their constitutional right to vote.
For the affected women, however, the issue is more immediate: they remain alive, but their names were placed on a list that sought to treat them as though they were not.

Shares of Paytm ended today’s trading session 5.4% lower at ₹1,640 apiece on the BSE.
Meanwhile, shares of Pine Labs fell 4.3% to ₹169.75, while Mobikwik declined 4.5% by the end of the session.
Original| October 8, 2026, 14:05 IST
Shares of fintech companies Paytm, Pine Labs and MobiKwik came under pressure today following reports that the proposed merchant discount rate (MDR) on select UPI transactions could be deferred.
Paytm’s stock fell as much as 10% to an intraday low of ₹1,560.60 apiece on the BSE. As of 13:30 PM IST, the stock was trading 5.21% lower at ₹1,643 apiece, giving the company a market capitalisation of ₹1,05,416.1 Cr ($10.8 Bn).
Pine Labs was trading 4.3% lower at ₹169.90 apiece, with a market capitalisation of ₹19,619.18 Cr ($2 Bn).
MobiKwik, meanwhile, was trading 5.7% lower at ₹241.25 apiece, with a market capitalisation of ₹1,899.7 Cr ($196.3 Mn).
The sell-off comes amid reports that the rollout of MDR on select UPI transactions may be deferred from October 15, to January 1, 2027.
As per a report by Business Standard, a proposal to defer the MDR rollout is under consideration, with a final decision expected in the coming days. The delay, if approved, would keep eligible merchant UPI payments free of MDR through the festive season.
The UPI and Services Steering Committee, headed by NPCI, met on Wednesday to discuss the proposed rollout among various other aspects of the framework.
The committee is also considering increasing the exemption threshold to businesses with an annual turnover of up to ₹40 Lakh. Under the earlier proposal, merchants receiving up to ₹1 Lakh a month through UPI QR codes directly into their bank accounts would be exempt from the fee.
Meanwhile, the RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra said on Wednesday that a “small fee” in the form of MDR is unlikely to have a major impact on UPI transaction volumes.
“As of now, we do not see any drop in volumes. And I don’t personally think that a small fee will have a major impact on the volumes,” Malhotra told reporters at the central bank headquarters.
Meanwhile, UPI transactions continued to grow, with the platform processing 24.07 Bn transactions worth ₹29.37 Tn in September, up 22.6% YoY in volume and 18% YoY in value.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Samsung Electronics expects a major jump in quarterly profit as demand for artificial intelligence (AI) technology continues to boost the global semiconductor industry.
The South Korean technology giant estimates that its operating profit for the three months ending in September will reach 107.4 trillion won ($80 billion). This would represent a roughly nine-fold increase from the same period last year and mark Samsung’s fourth consecutive quarter of record earnings.
The company will release its complete third-quarter financial results at the end of October. However, Samsung has issued an early earnings forecast to give investors an indication of its expected performance.
Samsung Eyes $80 Billion Profit as AI Demand Drives Chip Sales
The strong results are largely linked to rising demand for memory chips used in AI data centres. AI companies require large quantities of high-performance memory and other advanced semiconductors to train and operate increasingly powerful AI systems.
Samsung is one of the world’s largest memory chip manufacturers. It is competing with SK Hynix of South Korea and Micron of the United States. Their chips are used in AI infrastructure developed by major technology companies, including Nvidia and other data-centre operators.
The rapid expansion of AI services has created strong demand for semiconductors and helped improve prices and sales across the industry.
Samsung Gets Support From Smartphone Business
Samsung’s semiconductor division is not the only part of the company expected to benefit. Its smartphone business could also receive a boost from the company’s latest foldable devices, which were launched in August.
Samsung remains one of the world’s largest smartphone manufacturers, with products including the Galaxy S26 series and Galaxy Fold lineup. Strong demand for its latest premium devices could provide additional support to its overall earnings.
However, the company’s expected profit surge is primarily being attributed to the semiconductor business and the ongoing AI-driven chip boom.
Global Investment in AI Chips Continues
The growing demand for AI computing has triggered a major increase in investment across the semiconductor and data-centre industries.
Major US technology companies, including Google, Amazon and Meta, will invest more than $650 billion in AI projects this year. Much of this spending is helping drive demand for computing infrastructure, processors and memory chips.
South Korea is also seeking to strengthen its position in the global semiconductor industry. In June, the country announced plans involving at least $880 billion in projects led by Samsung and SK Hynix to expand chip manufacturing capabilities over the coming years.
Companies in Japan, China and Taiwan are also investing heavily in new semiconductor facilities as they look to benefit from the long-term growth of AI.
See Also: Samsung Begins Mass Production of Exynos 2700 Ahead of Galaxy S27 Launch
Chip Shortage Pushes Up Prices
The rapid increase in demand for semiconductors has also created supply pressures in parts of the market. Manufacturers have responded by increasing chip prices as demand continues to outpace available supply for certain products.
Higher semiconductor costs can eventually affect consumer products, including smartphones and computers, potentially making some devices more expensive.
Samsung’s expected record earnings highlight how strongly the AI boom is affecting the wider technology industry. As companies continue to expand AI data centres and invest in advanced computing, demand for memory chips is expected to remain an important source of growth for major semiconductor manufacturers.

items.author: Anjali Jain
items.content:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has urged global tech companies, financial institutions and telecom operators to collaborate and form a comprehensive framework to curb cyber fraud and deep fakes.
“At a time when telecom and digital technology have become so important, it is equally important to make the security framework associated with it ironclad. It is our priority to secure mobile phones and networks… trust is very important for ordinary citizens communicating or making payments through the phone,” PM Modi said.
Speaking at the India Mobile Congress 2026, the PM highlighted India’s successful endeavour to protect citizens from cyber attacks and frauds, noting that global cooperation is required to nip the issue in the bud, especially as most such operations are borderless.
He urged the GSM Association (GSMA), which is a global advocacy group for the telecom industry, and global telecom operators, to create a global mechanism that can potentially prevent cyber fraud before it reaches the masses.
He also offered India’s deep expertise in the area to global regulators, noting that authorities in the country have gained vast knowledge on fighting cyber crime.
He further noted that the discussions held during the IMC’s tenth edition this year will create a map for how the next decade of telecom will look like, in India and globally.
India’s Cyber Fraud Battle
The country has grappled with rising cyber fraud over the past few years, with Indians losing ₹3,588.2 Cr in more than 5.83 Lakh digital payment fraud cases between FY22 and FY26.
The government has consequently taken several steps to curb such frauds, including a dedicated portal to report suspected crime. The Sanchar Saathi portal has received 12.8 Lakh inputs on suspected fraud communications since launch in 2023. The Centre announced this week that suspected cyber-fraud losses of more than ₹5,000 Cr were prevented through the Financial Fraud Risk Indicator (FRI).
Nevertheless, nearly 7.1% of the attempted digital consumer transactions in India were suspected fraud in 2025, almost double the equivalent rate globally (3.8%).
To curb this, union home minister Amit Shah directed officials to improve the National Cybercrime Helpline using AI to ease the process of reporting cybercrimes. He also called for addressing the issues related to bank accounts being frozen as part of cyber fraud investigations.
The RBI has also come up with a compensation mechanism to aid fraud victims, under which the Centre and bank operators shoulder parts of the unrecovered losses. Customers, losing up to ₹50,000 in cybercrime cases, would be eligible for compensation of up to 85% of the net loss amount or ₹25,000, whichever is lesser.

The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) Peshawar has recovered Rs300,000 in an online financial fraud case and returned the money to the affected citizen.
The action came after the agency received a complaint from a citizen who reported losing money through an online fraud. Following the complaint, the NCCIA Peshawar team launched an investigation to trace the fraudulent transaction and determine how the funds were obtained.
NCCIA Recovers Rs300,000 in Online Fraud Case in Peshawar and Returns Money to Citizen
According to the NCCIA, its Peshawar team carried out a detailed investigation along with technical کارروائی to track the money involved in the fraud. The agency used digital investigation methods to follow the trail of the funds and identify the transaction linked to the complaint.
As a result of the investigation, the authorities managed to recover Rs300,000 that had been obtained through fraudulent means. The authority later returned the recovered amount to the complainant.
The recovery provides an example of how digital forensics and technical investigations can help authorities trace financial transactions linked to online scams and assist victims in recovering their money.
Cybercrime Protection Among NCCIA Priorities
The NCCIA said that protecting citizens from cybercrime and taking effective action against online financial fraud are among its key priorities.
The agency continues to conduct investigations into cybercrime cases using digital forensic techniques and other technical tools. These investigations can help authorities trace digital transactions, identify suspects, and collect evidence related to online crimes.
The agency’s efforts also aim to improve public confidence in reporting cybercrime and encourage victims to approach the authorities rather than ignoring fraudulent activity.

Citizens Advised to Report Online Fraud Quickly
The NCCIA has advised citizens to remain careful when conducting financial transactions through online platforms. People should avoid sharing sensitive information such as passwords, account details, PINs, and verification codes with unknown individuals.
NCCIA also asked citizens to report online financial fraud as soon as possible. Early reporting can provide investigators with an opportunity to trace transactions and take action against those involved.
The NCCIA provides an online complaint facility for citizens who want to report cybercrime. People who become victims of online scams or financial fraud can use the available reporting channels to submit their complaints and provide relevant details to investigators.
The agency has reiterated that timely reporting and cooperation from victims can assist in the investigation of cybercrime cases and efforts to recover funds lost through fraudulent activities.

items.author: Fact Check By iVerify
items.content:
Multiple Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) supporters shared Instagram stories on Oct 8, 2026, allegedly showing social media posts from Pakistani actresses Mahira Khan and Sajal Aly expressing their support for the Cockroach Janta Party’s (CJP) Oct 10 protest. However, the visuals are fake.
Thousands of protesters gathered in New Delhi and Mumbai in October 2026, demanding the resignation of India’s Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over allegations that revisions to electoral rolls had removed millions of voters. The protests began on Oct 2, with demonstrators accusing the Election Commission of India (ECI) of disenfranchising voters to benefit Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s ruling BJP. Both the ECI and BJP denied the allegations.
Amid the demonstrations, the Gen Z-led CJP, headed by Abhijeet Dipke, announced plans to hold a major rally in New Delhi at Jantar Mantar on Oct 10, demanding free and fair elections.
How it started
On Oct 8, a BJP supporter shared a post on X featuring images allegedly showing Mahira expressing support for the Oct 10 protest at Jantar Mantar through her Instagram stories.
The post was captioned: “Pakistani actress Mahira Khan supports the October 10 protest.”
It also included her alleged Instagram story, followed by the following caption: “Still, people in India are thinking this is a genuine protest. No bro, it’s a regime-change protest against Modi, the BJP and Hindutva. If they succeed, Pakistanis will return to India, and we might see a situation like 2007 again.”
The post gained 523,000 views.
The alleged story reads: “Just heard Abhijeet Dipke and Dhruv Rathee are going to protest against the BJP government on October 10. Full support to this protest. I can’t come because the BJP has banned Pakistani actors from entering India. Hopefully, after this protest, relations between India and Pakistan will improve again.
Another BJP supporter shared the same story with the following caption: “CJP has started receiving support from Pakistan.”
The post gained 40,000 views on X.
The claim was further shared by several other BJP supporters on X, further amplifying the virality, as can be seen here, here, here, here, here, here, here, here, here, here, and here; collectively accumulating 38,000 views.
Similarly, another visual circulating on social media purported to show an Instagram story shared by Sajal Aly, expressing support for protesters in India and suggesting that a change in the country’s government was imminent.
The text in the alleged story read: “Heard someone is getting kicked out of power in the neighbouring country. Well done, youth. Finally, the era of hatred will end. Hopefully, the new people in power will make our relations better, and we can work together again like brothers.”
The Insta story snapshot was shared by a BJP supporter with the following caption: “It’s one vs all now. This is Sajal Aly, who works in Pakistani TV. She thinks the Modi regime is going to be changed. Even she knows that if Modi gets removed, the new people in power will again make Pakistan their best friend. They will allow Pakistanis to come here and work. And then these snakes will silently plan attacks on our civilians. Pakistan, CJP, leftists and America want to defeat just one man. It’ll be proper cinema if Modi Ji wins in 2029 despite all this foreign funding and paid agenda.”
The post garnered 305,000 views on X.
Another BJP supporter shared the same claim on X with the following caption: “Pakistani actress wants regime change in India. Dumb Indians, open your eyes”
The post attracted 80,000 views.
The claim was further shared by several other BJP supporters, further amplifying its virality, as can be seen here, here, here, here and here.
Methodology
A fact-check was initiated to determine the veracity of the claim due to its high virality and keen public interest in the CJP protests in India, along with whether the Pakistani actresses had actually supported them or not.
A keyword search was conducted to verify whether any credible Indian or Pakistani media outlets had reported on the alleged Instagram stories, but nothing was found to corroborate them.
Furthermore, no social media posts were found from Pakistani users, fans and media industry personnel commenting on or reacting to any such alleged posts, casting further doubt about their authenticity.
Inspecting Mahira’s official Instagram account showed no such story. Instagram stories automatically disappear after 24 hours, whereas the viral claim had surfaced on Oct 8.
On closer examination of the viral post, the fingers of Abhijeet Dipke appear distorted, a common discrepancy in AI-generated images.
The image was analysed using OpenAI’s tool to detect the SynthID watermark, which identified a SynthID signal, indicating that the image was likely generated or edited using OpenAI tools.
SynthID works by embedding an invisible digital watermark directly into AI-generated media content. Unlike normal metadata, the watermark forms part of the content itself and is designed to remain detectable even after the media is doctored, such as cropping, applying filters or lossy compression.
The photo was subsequently analysed using other AI-detection tools. Sightengine flagged the visual as 99 per cent doctored, while AI or Not flagged it as 76pc AI-generated.
 
Meanwhile, Decopy flagged the image as 91pc AI-generated and Fake Image Detector labelled it as 78pc doctored.
 
 
Similarly, for the claim regarding Sajal, her official Instagram account also carried no such story.
Meanwhile, analysing Sajal’s post using Truthscan flagged the image as 95pc doctored content.
 
Undetectable AI labelled it as 95pc edited, and Fake Image Detector flagged it as 76pc computer-generated or modified image.
Fact-check status: false
The claim that screenshots of alleged Instagram posts from Mahira Khan and Sajal Ali show them supporting the CJP’s Oct 10 protest against the BJP party is false.
The viral visuals are AI-generated and the actresses have made no such posts.

Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Islamabad Police has taken an important step to improve access to police services for women by keeping an online women’s police station and a dedicated helpline, 1815, available for female citizens.
The initiative is designed to help women seek immediate police assistance, report complaints, and receive guidance without facing unnecessary difficulties in reaching a police station. The service provides an additional channel for women who may need help in sensitive or emergency situations.
Islamabad Police Activates Online Women Police Station and Helpline 1815
According to the Islamabad Police’s official website, 1815 is the dedicated online women’s helpline. Women can contact the helpline to report problems, seek guidance, or request police assistance.
The helpline is available 24 hours a day, allowing women to contact the police whenever they face a situation that requires intervention. This includes cases involving harassment, domestic violence, physical violence, threats, or other issues affecting their safety.
Online Women Police Station
Along with the helpline, Islamabad Police has also established an online women police station to make it easier for women to communicate with law enforcement and register their complaints.
The online facility provides women with an alternative way to approach the police, particularly in situations where visiting a police station in person may be difficult or uncomfortable. It also aims to make the complaint process more accessible for female citizens.
Complaints Referred for Action
When a complaint is received through the helpline or online service, Islamabad Police forwards it to the relevant police officials and the concerned police station for necessary action.
The concerned officers can then review the complaint and take further steps according to the nature of the issue. This system will ensure that complaints received through the dedicated women’s support channel reach the appropriate authorities.
Police Urges Women to Seek Help
Islamabad Police has encouraged women to contact 1815 without hesitation if they face harassment, violence, threats, or any other serious problem requiring police assistance.
The dedicated helpline and online police station provide women with another way to report concerns and seek support. By offering access to these services around the clock, Islamabad Police aims to make it easier for women to approach law enforcement and receive timely assistance when needed.

Tak hanya berhenti pad
items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Google baru saja memperkenalkan Playground, platform gaming eksperimental berbasis browser di mana pengguna bisa membuat game mereka sendiri hanya dengan mengetikkan prompt teks tanpa harus memiliki pengalaman coding.
Google Playground sendiri dirilis pada 7 Oktober 2026, dan layanan ini memungkinkan game yang baru dibuat tersebut bisa langsung dimainkan, dimodifikasi, dan dibagikan kepada pengguna lainnya.
Saat ini, Google Playground hanya tersedia untuk pengguna berusia 18 tahun ke atas di Amerika Serikat dan harus berlangganan paket Google One, sebagaimana dikutip dari laman web perusahaan, Kamis (8/10/2026).
Baca Juga: Google Pensiunkan Gemini Gems 17 November, Pengguna Dipindahkan ke Skills
Bikin Game di Google Playground
Raksasa mesin pencari ini menjelaskan, Playground dirancang dengan antarmuka (User Interface, UI) layaknya ngobrol dengan chatbot. Hanya dengan menjelaskan ide game lewat teks, pengguna bisa langsung menguji game buatan langsung di browser.
Tak hanya berhenti pada prompt pertama. Pengguna dapat meminta AI mengubah fisika di dalam game, aturan, karakter, hingga lingkungan tanpa harus masuk ke coding secara manual.
Perusahaan juga menyediakan kanvas konsong, prompt awal, serta panduan untuk membantu pengguna membentuk konsep awal game. Proses ini membuat Playground mirip proses iterasi lewat percakapan ketimbang tool menghasilkan kode sekali lalu selesai.
Google Playground
Dalam video teaser yang Google rilis, pengguna dapa membuat game dari ide sederhana, mencoba hasil, kemudian meminta perubahan berdasarkan apa yang ingin diperbaiki. Google menyebut, pengguna tetap memegang kendali atas kreatif sejak konsep awal sampai hasil akhir.
Game Bisa Langsung Dimainkan dan Dibagikan
Setelah game selesai dibuat, pengguna dapat menyimpannya secara privat, membagikan tautan kepada orang lain, atau menerbitkannya ke Playground Explore gallery.
Karena Playground berbasis browser, game dapat dimainkan melalui ponsel maupun laptop. Pada genre tertentu, Google juga menyediakan dukungan multiplayer dan leaderboard untuk membuat game lebih kompetitif.
Google Playground
Playground juga memiliki elemen komunitas melalui profil Play Games. Pengguna dapat memilih handle, menyukai game, mengikuti kreator, serta melihat game yang menonjol berdasarkan rating dan aktivitas bermain. 
Google mengatakan game yang dipublikasikan melewati pemeriksaan keamanan dan tetap menyediakan mekanisme pelaporan dari pengguna.
Ditopang Model AI Google
Menurut laporan The Verge, Playground menggunakan model AI Google seperti Gemini, Nano Banana, dan Lyria yang dipadukan dengan sistem internal untuk menangani proses pembuatan game. Informasi tersebut disampaikan juru bicara Google kepada The Verge.
Google sendiri tidak memosisikan Playground sebagai pengganti pengembang software atau kreator game profesional Platform ini disebut sebagai eksperimen awal untuk membuat proses kreasi game lebih mudah diakses.
Karena masih berstatus eksperimen, Google juga akan terus mengembangkan Playground berdasarkan penggunaan dan masukan komunitas.
Kehadiran Playground menunjukkan arah baru dalam pembuatan game: bukan lagi sekadar menggunakan AI untuk membantu pekerjaan teknis, tetapi menjadikan bahasa sehari-hari sebagai bagian dari proses membuat dan mengubah game yang dapat langsung dimainkan.
Artikel berjudul Google Playground Ubah Prompt Jadi Game, Tanpa Perlu Coding yang ditulis oleh Yus Lianson pertama kali tampil di Gizmologi.id

items.title: New FEMA Rules Explained: What Freelancers, Creators, And SaaS Startups Need To Know
items.summary:
RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra yesterday eased concerns over the new foreign exchange reporting framework, clarifying that individuals undertaking transactions of a personal nature would not have to report them. For established SaaS startups already reporting software exports, industry participants expect mainly procedural changes.
What
items.author: Shrishti Bisht
items.content:
RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra yesterday eased concerns over the new foreign exchange reporting framework, clarifying that individuals undertaking transactions of a personal nature would not have to report them. He also cited earnings from overseas tutoring and small software assignments among the transactions that would not require reporting.
The clarification follows concerns among freelancers, creators, and small service exporters about additional paperwork under the Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026. The rules, which took effect on October 1, bring goods and services trade under a unified framework.
Malhotra said banks and authorised dealers would handle reporting to the RBI, while exporters could use self-declaration for bills of up to ₹10 Lakh — a threshold that applies per bill, not to annual earnings. For established SaaS startups already reporting software exports, industry participants expect mainly procedural changes.
What Has The RBI Clarified?
Malhotra said individuals’ transactions of a personal nature do not require reporting, irrespective of the amount. Examples include subscriptions to apps, television channels, journals, and newspapers.
His clarification also covered individuals receiving payments for overseas tutoring and small software assignments, extending the reassurance beyond personal spending.
Deputy governor Rohit Jain said the framework aims to simplify trade processes and give authorised dealers greater flexibility. Acknowledging confusion over reporting obligations, he said the RBI would issue FAQs to clarify the requirements.
These FAQs are expected to explain how the clarification applies across different freelance and creator business arrangements.
What Changes For SaaS Startups And Banks?
Software exporters previously used SOFTEX, while goods exports followed a separate declaration process. Other service exports did not necessarily require equivalent declarations, although obligations to realise and repatriate overseas earnings still applied.
The regulations prescribe an Export Declaration Form (EDF) for services, including software, and permit a single declaration covering a month’s service exports.
According to CA Abhinarayan Mishra, a cross-border tax and FEMA expert, the broader use of “services” expands the reporting architecture. However, established SaaS companies already have reporting systems, so their changes could largely involve forms and procedures.
Naganand Doraswamy, founder and managing partner at Ideaspring Capital, similarly expects limited changes for startups already filing SOFTEX forms.
“From a founder’s perspective, there’s not a whole lot of change… what was being filed in SOFTEX, they’ll go by and file it in EDF and the banks have to match,” Doraswamy said.
He expects some transitional disruption but said processes should become smoother once the system settles. Banks would undertake more work matching invoices with remittances.
Manav Garg, cofounder and managing partner at Together Fund, said consolidating export reporting through authorised banks could simplify compliance for software and AI startups.
Mishra also expects banks to play a larger role in reconciliation and compliance, making their implementation of the revised processes important for startups.
What Does The ₹10 Lakh Route Allow?
The ₹10 Lakh threshold applies per export bill, not to total annual export earnings. Annual earnings exceeding ₹10 Lakh would therefore not, by themselves, rule out the simplified route for eligible individual bills.
Banks may close export-monitoring entries for bills up to ₹10 Lakh based on an exporter’s declaration that payment has been realised in full or otherwise. Exporters can also submit these declarations quarterly to their authorised dealer for bulk closure of eligible entries in the export-monitoring system.
This simplifies smaller transactions but does not remove every obligation to supply information to banks or constitute a blanket FEMA exemption.
What Reconciliation Issues Could Arise?
Mishra flagged reconciliation challenges where platform charges or deductions leave service providers receiving less than they invoiced, including through platforms such as PayPal.
Similar questions arise for YouTube creators and influencers earning from overseas platforms. Larger creators may have agencies or accountants handling documentation, while smaller creators often maintain their own records.
For service providers covered by the framework, these differences make it important to reconcile invoices, platform deductions, and actual receipts.
What About The Nine-Month Deadline?
Service export proceeds generally must be realised and repatriated within nine months of the invoice date. A 12-month period applies where exports are invoiced or settled in rupees, and authorised dealers may grant extensions on satisfactory grounds.
It is pertinent to mention that nine months is not a fresh reduction introduced on October 1. The RBI restored this deadline in June after a temporary extension to 15 months. Through an amendment in September, the central bank aligned the incoming regulations with it.
Mishra said larger companies may find it easier to structure contracts around deadlines, while smaller providers could struggle with delayed or disputed payments.
A $1,000 invoice settled for $900, for example, leaves $100 requiring reconciliation. The regulations allow authorised dealers to approve reduced realisation on satisfactory grounds for bills up to ₹10 Lakh. This may be based on self-declaration.
For cases where proceeds remain unrealised beyond one year after the applicable due date or extension, further exports require full advance payment or an irrevocable letter of credit. A disputed payment therefore does not automatically trigger an export ban when nine months expire.
Why Is RBI Expanding Services Reporting?
Malhotra said the framework would improve services trade data, bringing reporting closer to merchandise trade. Customers already provide information such as purpose codes, while the revised framework seeks additional details.
Mishra said more comprehensive reporting could give policymakers a clearer picture of emerging service exports, including the creator economy, and more timely information on overseas service earnings.
The post New FEMA Rules Explained: What Freelancers, Creators, And SaaS Startups Need To Know appeared first on Inc42 Media.

items.author: Muhammad Saleem Jhandeer
items.content:
Sindh Senior Minister Sharjeel Memon on Thursday accused Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa Chief Minister Sohail Afridi of “sabotaging” negotiations between the government and opposition in Islamabad due to his “stubbornness and ego”, saying the talks had been moving towards a solution before they broke down.
His remarks came a day after Afridi accused the PPP of attempting to create “another East Pakistan” during a meeting of the K-P cabinet, alleging that the party had previously placed personal interests ahead of national interests. The chief minister also criticised Governor Faisal Karim Kundi, who belongs to PPP, for chairing a security meeting, calling it “an attack on the Constitution and democracy” and warning that his government would not allow any attempt to undermine Pakistan’s unity.
“The talks that happened in Islamabad were result-oriented. Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N) and Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) were part of it, and we were going towards a solution,” Memon said at a press conference in Karachi.
He said the K-P chief minister had “sabotaged” the talks due to his “stubbornness and ego”. “I understand that the reason was that, to look good in Imran Khan’s eyes, he was doing all of this,” he added.
“Talks were going well. The drafts of the agreement had almost been prepared. Some channels even reported that the agreement had been signed and that everything had been settled,” Memon said, while responding to a question.
He claimed that Afridi had acted in a manner aimed at protecting his position before the PTI leadership. “Afridi acted to save his own position before the PTI leadership. The consequences of this are being suffered by PTI and the innocent people of K-P,” he said.
Memon further said PPP had wanted political engagement with PTI and was willing to debate the issue of terrorism on any forum. “I am telling them to come to their senses. Even today there are sensible people in PTI; Gohar, their chairman, and Asad Qaiser,” he added, urging them to come forward and give a “shut-up call” to those promoting a confrontational approach.
Also Read: 'End long march, sit-ins and we will talk': PM Shehbaz once again extends olive branch to PTI
He further said political parties should remain within the political process rather than resort to confrontation or violence, urging senior PTI leaders to rein in such voices. “We want political parties to keep doing their work and have space and continue with a political mindset. Not to pick up weapons and do such hooliganism,” he added.
Memon stated that PPP had not responded to Afridi’s earlier statements but would defend its leadership after the K-P chief minister targeted the party. “PPP will not engage with PTI. But if PTI wants to and launches a baseless smear campaign, then PPP will defend its leaders and show PTI the mirror,” he said.
Asked whether the PPP was prepared for the possibility of governor’s rule or an emergency being imposed in K-P, particularly amid the threat of terrorism and the possibility of PTI protests, Memon said the matter should not be viewed as an issue concerning his party alone. “This is not merely a matter for the People’s Party. It is an issue for every Pakistani, especially my Pashtun brothers and sisters,” he said.
Memon compared the situation in K-P with Karachi’s past experience of terrorism and prolonged strikes, saying around 70% of the province was currently facing a similar situation on a daily basis.
He questioned whether restoring peace should not be the provincial government’s foremost priority. “Political disputes, protests and long marches can continue later but the immediate focus should be on protecting the lives of citizens,” he said.
He said K-P was facing a serious security crisis, with members of the armed forces, police and Frontier Corps, as well as civilians and political workers, being targeted and killed. “Your priority should be to sit down and provide peace to the people and secure their lives. Should the priority be sit-ins and long marches?” he asked.
Turning to the security situation in K-P, Memon said five of the province’s seven divisions were “completely in the grip of terrorism”. “Talibanisation’s biggest headquarters has almost been established in K-P, and its targets are innocent, poor Pashtun brothers and sisters,” he said.
He pointed to the threats facing police personnel and the deterioration of the security situation after dark, attributing it to what he described as “the provincial government’s failure”.
Memon also criticised PTI founder Imran Khan’s past position on negotiations with the Taliban, saying Khan had advocated dialogue with the militant group and the opening of Taliban offices.
He recalled the PPP government’s response to terrorism after the 2008 elections, saying hundreds of thousands of people had been displaced and later resettled. “Before the 2008 elections, in Benazir’s last speech in Rawalpindi, what did she say? She said that we would wave the Pakistani flag in Swat,” he said.
“When the PPP government came in 2008, President Zardari carried out a historic crackdown against terrorists. 800,000 people were displaced. They moved to Karachi, and during the PPP’s time they were resettled,” Memon said. “Those who level accusations against PPP do not see that this entire operation against terrorists was carried out by PPP,” he added.
Read More: Afridi calls Kundi's security meeting ‘attack on Constitution’, warns against 'another East Pakistan' situation
The minister also accused the PTI government in K-P of providing official funding to seminaries and networks he said were involved in terrorism.
“You Google it — the K-P government that was PTI’s government gave funding to the madrassas and terrorists,” he claimed. “Through official accounts, the K-P government gave government money to madrassas that were helping terrorism.” “Those networks that were part of terrorism were being officially funded,” he added.
He questioned why terrorists had targeted rallies held by PPP and other political parties but not PTI rallies. “Why was this?” he asked. He linked it to what he described as the party’s support for the Taliban.
“If your narrative is such that those people who are doing terrorism, you support them, become their spokesperson, they will say that they are our spokespersons, so they will not touch you,” he said.
Memon also cited the Bannu jailbreak during the PTI government and the Army Public School attack, accusing PTI of failing to take a strong position against the Taliban. “In the PTI government, the Bannu jailbreak happened. In double-cabin vehicles, terrorists came under the disguise of a rally and procession, carried out a jailbreak and took away terrorists, and PTI remained silent,” he said.
“Where they have their government, where their writ extends, have they ever said a word for the end of terrorism? Did they ever raise their voice for that? Did they ever hold a press conference against the Taliban?” he asked. He added that PPP had itself suffered heavily from terrorism and maintained that political parties should focus on restoring peace.
Memon also warned that the political conduct being displayed by the K-P government was setting a bad precedent and urged PTI to “come to its senses” and adopt a more sensible approach.
“There are serious people within PTI. I have mentioned their chairman, Gohar and Asad Qaiser. These are serious people. They should make the decisions rather than handing decision-making authority to a young man who could lead things towards some unfortunate incident,” Memon said.
Responding to a question about whether the federal government and PPP leadership had ruled out governor’s rule or an emergency in K-P, Memon said his party had consistently sought political space for PTI in the province. “If you yourself are moving into a circle of self-destruction, who can help you?” he asked.
Memon said PPP wanted Pakistan’s political system and parliament to remain strong and wanted all political parties to retain their political space. “I believe PTI is pushing itself into a dead end, which will become a major problem for them,” he concluded.

Sistem yang dijelaskan menggunakan data dari pemain dan kondisi dalam sebuah encounter dengan NPC, kemudian memasukkannya ke model machine learning untuk menentukan perubahan perilaku karakter.
Data yang dianalisis cukup detail. Dari sisi pemain, sistem dapat memperhatikan waktu reaksi terhadap serangan boss, keberhasilan melakukan dodge, block, dan parry, senjata maupun consumable yang digunakan, hingga jumlah percobaan ulang. Sementara dari sisi NPC atau boss, sistem dapat memantau pola serangan serta seberapa sering serangan tersebut berhasil dihindari atau dilawan pemain.
Baca Juga: Xbox Helix Akan Utamakan Konsol, Handheld Disebut Ikut dalam Satu Keluarga Perangkat
Perilaku Boss Bisa Berubah Berdasarkan Pemain
Salah satu kemungkinan penerapannya adalah membuat boss menyesuaikan pola pertarungan berdasarkan kemampuan pemain. Sistem dapat menghasilkan perubahan sebelum game dijalankan, ketika permainan berlangsung secara real-time, maupun setelah sesi permainan selesai. Artinya, dalam skenario tertentu, perilaku boss bahkan dapat berubah ketika pertarungan masih berlangsung.
Namun, kemampuan adaptif tersebut tidak terbatas pada mekanisme combat. Dokumen paten juga menyebut kemungkinan perubahan pada dialog, penampilan, serta suara NPC, termasuk penyesuaian pitch dan volume. Dengan pendekatan ini, AI tidak hanya digunakan untuk mengatur serangan musuh, tetapi juga dapat memengaruhi bagaimana karakter berinteraksi dengan pemain.
Belum Tentu Hadir di Game PlayStation
Meski terdengar menarik, paten tersebut belum berarti Sony sedang menyiapkan fitur ini untuk game atau konsol tertentu. Dokumen yang dipublikasikan merupakan aplikasi paten dan belum menjadi paten yang diberikan. Sony juga belum mengumumkan game maupun hardware yang akan menggunakan teknologi tersebut.
Penerapannya pun berpotensi menimbulkan perdebatan, terutama pada game yang mengandalkan pola musuh sebagai bagian dari tantangan. Pada game bergaya Soulslike, misalnya, pemain biasanya mempelajari pola serangan boss melalui percobaan berulang. Boss yang dapat mengubah pola secara dinamis justru bisa mengubah prinsip tersebut dan membuat pertarungan terasa kurang dapat diprediksi.
Seperti paten teknologi pada umumnya, pengajuan ini lebih tepat dilihat sebagai gambaran arah eksplorasi Sony daripada kepastian fitur masa depan. Perusahaan juga dapat mengajukan berbagai paten yang pada akhirnya tidak pernah digunakan dalam produk komersial.

items.author: Tom Jackson
items.content:
Nigerian fintech startup Bujeti has made Brain, an agentic AI platform for finance teams, publicly available following a two-week private beta.
Founded by Cossi Achille Arouko and Samy Chiba, Bujeti offers corporate cards with real-time controls, vendor payment automation with multi-level approvals, budgeting, invoicing, business accounts, a tax module, payroll and a mobile app. More than 2,000 finance professionals in Nigeria and Kenya use the platform.
A participant in Y Combinator’s Winter 2023 batch, Bujeti went on to raise US$2.5 million in seed funding, and has now launched Brain. The platform provides four AI “teammates” that handle routine finance work.
Fetch finds invoices, receipts and statements across email, storage and accounting apps, extracts the data, and routes low-confidence results to a human. Chaser runs invoice collections over email, SMS and WhatsApp, and can negotiate payment plans when customers cannot pay in full. Watchdog scans transactions, vendors and contracts daily, flagging risks and upcoming renewals. Concierge answers staff finance questions using the company’s own policies.
“Most AI finance tools sit beside the ledger and have to be fed data,” Arouko said. “Bujeti spent three years building the ledger first, so Brain reads across every account, budget, vendor, contract and transaction already inside it.”
No “teammate” has standing authority to move money.
“Low-confidence actions go to a person, every action is logged, each teammate is controlled separately, and customer data is not used to train outside models,” said Arouko.
Fetch and Chaser opened in private beta on September 16, with Watchdog and Concierge available to enterprise customers. All four became available to every Bujeti business on September 30.
Next, the startup is extending Chaser to full debt and loan collection. Early internal tests show it recovering 3.2 times more on the hardest accounts than a manual team. It is also building the Bujeti MCP, a connector that will let AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT query a business’s finance data and act on it, with permissions.
Arouko, an engineer from Cotonou who trained in France, was previously a technical lead at Paystack. There, he was struck by the American expense platform the company used internally, which issued cards with live limits and tied spending to budgets.
“Nothing like it existed for African businesses,” Arouko told Disrupt Africa. He left Paystack, partnered with Chiba, formerly of Arianespace, and started building.
Bujeti aims to be one of Africa’s top three financial management platforms within five years.
“Every ambitious African business should be able to run its finances with a CFO in the room, whether or not it can afford to hire one,” Arouko said.

Evos vs Dewa United Jadi Laga Pembuka Krusial MPL ID S18
Pertandingan Evos kontra Dewa United menjadi laga pembuka jadwal MPL ID S18 Week 8. Pertemuan ini memiliki bobot lebih besar karena kedua tim sama-sama membutuhkan kemenangan untuk memperkuat posisi mereka menjelang fase akhir Regular Season.
Baca Juga: Vivo X500 FE Lolos TKDN, Siap Menyusul X500 Series Masuk Indonesia?
Evos juga langsung menghadapi ONIC sehari kemudian, sehingga hasil laga melawan anak Dewa bisa menjadi modal penting sebelum menghadapi rival berikutnya.
Secara permainan, laga ini juga mempertemukan dua tim dengan pendekatan yang berbeda. Tim berjuluk macan putih ini membutuhkan konsistensi setelah melewati rangkaian hasil yang tidak selalu stabil, sedangkan Dewa United beberapa kali mampu memberikan perlawanan kepada tim yang secara posisi berada di atas mereka.
Karena masih ada sedikit ruang untuk saling mengejar di klasemen, hasil duel ini berpotensi mengubah jarak antartim dalam perebutan tiket playoff
RRQ Hoshi Jaga Asa ke Playoff MPL ID S18
Bigetron by Vitality dan Onic setelah hasil MPL ID S18 Week 3
RRQ Hoshi juga belum keluar dari persaingan. Mereka akan menghadapi Team Liquid ID pada Jumat, 9 Oktober pukul 17.00 WIB sebelum bertemu ONIC pada Minggu, 11 Oktober pukul 17.00 WIB.
Tantangan RRQ cukup berat karena salah satu lawannya adalah TLID yang tampil konsisten sepanjang Regular Season. Setelah itu, RRQ menghadapi ONIC dalam pertandingan yang bisa memiliki dampak langsung terhadap persaingan papan tengah.
Karena itu, RRQ membutuhkan rangkaian hasil positif sembari berharap pesaing di atas mereka kehilangan poin. Jalur menuju playoff masih terbuka, tetapi ruang untuk melakukan kesalahan semakin kecil.
BTR dan Alter Ego Juga Bertaruh Momentum
Di luar perebutan utama papan tengah, Alter Ego dan Bigetron by Vitality akan bertemu pada jadwal MPL ID S18 Week 8 hari ini. BTR memasuki laga ini dengan modal kemenangan pada Week 7. Hasil tersebut memberi mereka momentum setelah melewati periode yang tidak mudah.
Alter Ego, di sisi lain, perlu menjaga posisi mereka menjelang dua pekan terakhir Regular Season. Pertandingan ini bisa menjadi kesempatan bagi BTR untuk kembali menekan tim di atas mereka sekaligus menguji konsistensi Alter Ego.
NAVI vs Team Liquid ID Jadi Duel Papan Atas
Jadwal MPL ID S18 Hari Ini 18 September: Dewa United Esports Hadapi EVOS dan RRQ
Pada hari yang sama di jadwal MPL ID S18 week 8, Navi akan menghadapi Team Liquid ID pukul 20.00 WIB. Pertandingan ini menjadi salah satu duel papan atas yang menarik di Week 8.
Jadwal resmi MPL ID juga menempatkan TLID menghadapi RRQ sehari setelahnya.
TLID masih berada dalam posisi kuat setelah menjalani Regular Season dengan konsisten. Namun, NAVI menjadi salah satu tim yang bisa menguji mereka dalam perebutan posisi atas.
Bagi NAVI, kemenangan akan menjaga tekanan terhadap pemuncak klasemen. Sementara bagi TLID, hasil positif akan membantu mereka mempertahankan posisi menjelang pertandingan-pertandingan terakhir.
Dengan Regular Season yang memasuki fase akhir, Week 8 bukan lagi sekadar soal menjaga momentum. Hasil dari beberapa duel langsung dapat mengubah persaingan menuju Playoffs Surabaya sebelum seluruh tim memasuki pekan terakhir. MPL ID S18 sendiri menjadwalkan Regular Season berakhir pada 18 Oktober 2026, sementara Playoffs berlangsung pada 4–8 November di Surabaya.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Red Magic has officially revealed the full design of its upcoming Red Magic 12 Pro+ ahead of its October 15 launch in China. The new gaming flagship will focus on a clean design, immersive display and improved cooling for sustained gaming performance.
Red Magic 12 Pro+ Full Design Revealed Ahead of October 15 Launch
The company has shown the phone in three transparent-inspired finishes and highlighted several design changes compared with the previous generation.
Three Transparent Color Options
The Red Magic 12 Pro+ will be available in Transparent Dark Night, Transparent Silver Wing and Transparent Ice Blue. All three versions feature the brand’s familiar flat rear panel.
One of the biggest design changes is the camera setup. The rear camera module sits completely flush with the body instead of protruding from the back. This gives the phone a more uniform profile and a cleaner overall appearance.
Nearly Bezel-Free Display
Red Magic is also continuing its full-screen approach with the new phone. The device uses an under-display front camera, which removes the need for a punch-hole or display notch.
The Red Magic 12 Pro+ will use the company’s ninth-generation under-display camera technology. The bezels have also become thinner, with the black border around the display reduced from 1.25mm on the previous model to 0.96mm.
The slimmer border should provide a more immersive viewing experience, particularly when playing games or watching videos.
RGB Liquid Cooling System
Cooling remains a major focus of the Red Magic 12 Pro+. The phone will feature an RGB liquid cooling system, with the transparent rear panel allowing parts of the internal cooling hardware to be visible.
The device will also use an air-cooling system to help control temperatures during demanding gaming sessions. Red Magic is combining both systems to maintain stable performance during extended workloads.
Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6
The Red Magic 12 Pro+ will be powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 mobile platform.
The smartphone recently appeared on Geekbench 7 under the model number Nubia NX819J. It reportedly scored 3,677 points in the single-core test and 12,679 points in the multi-core test.
These benchmark results place the device among the strongest smartphones tested with the same chipset so far.
Large Battery and Fast Charging
Red Magic has previously confirmed that the 12 Pro+ will have a slimmer, lighter, and narrower body than its predecessor, with more rounded edges.
Leaks have also pointed to an 8,400mAh battery, along with support for 120W wired charging and 80W wireless charging. However, Red Magic has not officially confirmed these battery and charging specifications yet.
Launch Date and Reservations
The Red Magic 12 Pro+ will officially launch in China on October 15 at 2:30 PM local time. The company has already started accepting reservations through its official website and JD.com.
The retail price has not been announced yet. Chinese buyers can pay 100 yuan to reserve the phone and receive promotional benefits worth up to 4,300 yuan. These offers reportedly include a Red Magic Cooler 8 Pro, gaming-related benefits, cashback, and trade-in incentives.
Red Magic has not yet announced the global launch date or international availability of the Red Magic 12 Pro+.
With its nearly bezel-free display, flush cameras, transparent design, and advanced cooling system, the Red Magic 12 Pro+ is shaping up to be a major gaming smartphone for 2026.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The Consumer Protection Court in Peshawar has directed Easypaisa to refund Rs40,000 to a customer after money was transferred from his account through transactions he said he did not authorize.
The court also ordered the digital payment service to pay Rs25,000 in compensation to the customer and another Rs25,000 fine to the government. This brings the total amount payable by Easypaisa to Rs90,000.
Consumer Court Judge Nasrullah Khan Gandapur announced the decision on October 3, 2026.
Peshawar Court Penalizes Easypaisa Over Unauthorized Rs40,000 Transfers From Customer Account
According to the complaint filed by Fahad-ur-Rehman, Rs40,000 was transferred from his Easypaisa account on February 12, 2026, through three separate transactions.
The transactions included Rs10,000 sent to Imran Traders, Rs22,000 transferred to Swift Collect System, and another Rs8,000 sent to Easy Online Service.
The customer told the court that he had not carried out these transactions and had not given permission to anyone to transfer the money from his account.
Court Holds Payment Service Responsible
In its ruling, the court said companies providing financial and electronic payment services must take reasonable steps to protect consumers and their accounts.
The court noted that such institutions have a responsibility to exercise due care, maintain appropriate security measures, and provide services according to the required standards.
The court also observed that no representative of Easypaisa appeared despite receiving notice of the proceedings. As a result, the case proceeded ex parte, meaning the court heard and decided the matter in the absence of the company.
See Also: Easypaisa ATM Card Users Report Failed Withdrawals and Deductions, Seek Faster Dispute Resolution
Easypaisa Ordered to Pay Rs90,000
The court partially accepted the customer’s complaint and issued orders for three separate payments.
Easypaisa must return Rs40,000 to the customer as a refund. It must also pay Rs25,000 as compensation to the customer and Rs25,000 to the government as a fine.
The total financial liability therefore stands at Rs90,000.
The ruling highlights the responsibility of digital payment platforms to maintain adequate security and protect customers from unauthorized transactions. Consumers can also seek legal relief if someone uses their financial accounts without authorization.

items.author: Shrishti Bisht
items.content:
The introduction of a merchant discount rate (MDR) on select UPI transactions may be deferred from October 15 to January 1, 2027, amid pushback from retail traders’ associations.
A proposal to postpone the rollout is under consideration, with a final decision expected in the coming days, Business Standard reported. A deferment would keep eligible merchant payments free of MDR through the festive season.
Members of the UPI and Services Steering Committee, headed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), met yesterday to discuss the rollout and clarify aspects of the framework, the report said.
The committee is also considering exempting businesses with annual turnover of up to ₹40 Lakh, the report added. This would significantly expand the proposed exemption from the earlier framework, under which small merchants receiving up to ₹1 Lakh a month through UPI QR codes directly into their bank accounts were to be spared the fee.
Inc42 has reached out to NPCI for comment on the development. The story will be updated based on its response.
MDR is a fee merchants pay for processing digital payments. Under the announced framework, a 0.40% charge would apply to eligible person-to-merchant (P2M) UPI transactions above ₹2,000, capped at ₹300 per transaction.
Specified categories, including bill payments, utilities, education, and fuel, would attract a flat fee of ₹5 per transaction above ₹2,000. Consumers will not have to pay MDR.
The ₹2,000 transaction threshold is expected to remain unchanged, according to the report. Separately, authorities are considering raising the daily UPI transaction limit for certain categories from ₹1 Lakh to ₹2 Lakh.
Retailers Push Back Against MDR
Retail traders’ associations have opposed the framework, arguing that the charges would increase payment costs for businesses operating on thin margins.
The All India Mobile Retailers Association (AIMRA) and All India Consumer Products Distributors Federation (AICPDF) had called for a ‘No UPI Day’ on October 2. They withdrew the planned protest after meeting finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman on September 30.
AIMRA has sought a fixed, nominal charge for digital transactions instead of the proposed 0.40% MDR. AICPDF, meanwhile, has estimated that the fee could add ₹7,000 Cr–₹9,000 Cr in annual costs across the FMCG distribution and retail ecosystem.
The framework would mark a shift from the zero-MDR regime. Payments up to ₹2,000, person-to-person (P2P) transfers, and eligible small-merchant transactions would remain exempt.
The Centre has told the Supreme Court that around 96% of merchant transactions would remain unaffected, putting the share covered by the framework at about 4%.
The fee would create a revenue stream for banks, payment service providers, and third-party application providers (TPAPs).
Under the standard 0.40% structure, the acquiring bank collects MDR from the merchant and pays 0.28% of the transaction value to the issuing bank as an interchange. The issuing bank then pays 0.12% to the payer-side payment service provider bank, which passes 0.08% to the UPI app provider.
This comes as UPI transactions continue to grow in the country. UPI recorded 24.07 Bn transactions worth ₹29.37 Tn in September. Transaction volume rose 22.6% YoY, while transaction value increased 18% YoY.

items.author: Prasetyo Herfianto
items.content:
Sekitar bulan Mei lalu, Microsoft sempat merilis teaser sebuah laptop pertamanya yang dirancang jauh lebih serius, untuk memberikan kemampuan para kreator hingga profesional lainnya dalam menghasilkan sesuatu yang belum pernah ada sebelumnya. Dan melalui sebuah acara perilisan khusus (7/10), Microsoft akhirnya mengungkap penuh Surface Laptop Ultra, baik secara spesifikasi hingga harganya yang tentu premium.
Secara eksklusif berkolaborasi dengan NVIDIA, Microsoft tidak hanya mengungkap spesifikasi dan harga Surface Laptop Ultra saja, tetapi juga memperkenalkan Surface RTX Spark Dev Box sebagai pelengkap—dirancang untuk para pengembang hingga insinyur AI untuk memberikan performa lebih tinggi lagi dalam setup kerjanya. Kedua perangkat dibangun lewat arsitektur NVIDIA RTX Spark Superchip khusus.
Surface Laptop Ultra menjadi opsi baru bagi konsumen yang menginginkan sebuah perangkat dengan sistem operasi Windows rancangan terbaik dari Microsoft. Tentunya untuk pengguna yang lebih kasual, akan lebih disarankan memilih sejumlah opsi produk lainnya yang juga sudah diperbarui tahun ini. Sebut saja Microsoft Surface Pro dan Surface Laptop dengan cip Qualcomm terbaru, demi efisiensi maksimal serta performa yang sudah cukup kencang untuk penggunaan harian.
Baca juga: Akun X Microsoft Diretas, Sempat Promosikan Token Kripto
Dirancang Eksklusif, Bodi Surface Laptop Ultra Tetap Dibuat Tipis
Membawa embel-embel “ultra”, tidak salah bila spesifikasi Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra benar-benar dirancang maksimal, termasuk performa komputasi AI-nya. Brett Ostrum, Corporate VP, Surface mengatakan bila laptop Microsoft terkencang satu ini dibangun dengan kemitraan mendalam bersama NVIDIA, agar perangkat bisa benar-benar memaksimalkan kinerja hardware dengan sistem operasi Windows.
“Kami merancang perangkat yang sepenuhnya baru di sekitar platform tersebut sejak awal. Di mana insinyur mekanis, listrik, termal, akustik, material, dan desainer industri semua bekerja sama sejak awal untuk sepenuhnya memaksimalkan potensi RTX Spark. Hasilnya adalah laptop Surface paling kuat kami yang pernah ada, dirancang untuk beban kerja kreatif, teknis, hingga AI yang paling menuntut sekalipun.”
Ini dimulai dengan kemitraan yang mendalam untuk mengoptimalkan Windows guna memanfaatkan sepenuhnya RTX Spark Superchip dari NVIDIA. Kemudian, kami merancang perangkat yang sepenuhnya baru di sekitar platform tersebut dari awal. Insinyur mekanis, listrik, termal, akustik, material, dan desainer industri bekerja sama sejak awal untuk sepenuhnya mengekspresikan potensi RTX Spark.
Hasilnya adalah Surface Laptop paling kuat kami yang pernah ada, yang dirancang untuk beban kerja kreatif, teknis, dan AI yang menuntut. Pada aspek performa Surface Laptop Ultra ditenagai CPU NVIDIA Grace hingga 20 inti, sementara GPU NVIDIA Blackwell RTX yang diusungnya bisa membawa sampai lebih dari 6100 inti. Dipasangkan bersama opsi RAM (unified) hingga kapasitas 128GB demi multitasking paling lancar.
Kombinasi hardware tersebut bisa membuat Surface Laptop Ultra menjalankan model AI dengan parameter hingga 120B secara lokal, sementara performa AI-nya bisa mencapai hingga 1 petaflop. Bagian ini penting agar sistem kerja bisa dilakukan lebih banyak secara lokal, sehingga tidak bergantung banyak pada pemrosesan cloud.
Agar performa bisa berjalan maksimal terus menerus, Microsoft juga merancang arsitektur termal dengan kapasitas hingga 2,5 kali lebih besar dibandingkan semua lini perangkat Surface yang sudah pernah ada. Semua dikemas ke dalam bodi berbobot mencapai 2 kilogram, dengan ketebalan yang tidak sampai 18mm. Tentu tidak dapat disamakan dengan laptop portabel layaknya MacBook Air, mengingat komponen hardware yang disematkan juga jauh lebih “serius”.
Diklaim Lebih Kencang dari MacBook Pro M5
Menariknya, Microsoft berani sebutkan bila performa Surface Laptop Ultra bisa tetap 99% maksimal meski sedang tidak dicolok ke sumber listrik—sesuatu yang sebelumnya menjadi salah satu keunggulan laptop Apple dengan cip rancangan sendiri. Bahkan Microsoft juga berani membandingkan performa Surface Laptop Ultra vs MacBook Pro M5, yang disebut bisa berikan performa video generation 6,2 kali lebih kencang, hingga image creation 4,3 kali lebih instan.
Selain aspek penting yang sudah disebutkan di atas, Surface Laptop Ultra juga membawa layar 15 inci PixelSense Ultra yang mendukung input sentuh, serta bisa menyala cerah hingga 2000 nits. Penyimpanan laptop ini juga dapat ditingkatkan secara mandiri oleh penggunanya, dan bisa mendukung kapasitas sampai 2TB.
Harga Surface Laptop Ultra dibanderol mulai USD2599, atau sekitar Rp46 jutaan. Tentu angka tersebut bisa naik secara signifikan bila poin spesifikasi dikustomisasi untuk performa yang lebih maksimal. Sementara itu, Apple dirumorkan siap meluncurkan lini MacBook Pro terbaru dalam beberapa pekan ke depan, sehingga mari kita nantikan mana yang lebih unggul.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Layanan Flip mengalami gangguan dengan beragam keluhan dari pengguna mulai bermunculan sejak Sabtu, 3 Oktober 2026. Sementara itu, Flip sendiri menyebut kendala berlangsung sejak Minggu.
Empat hari Flip error, Rafi Putra Arriyan, CEO sekaligus co-founder Flip akhirnya buka suara dan meminta maaf kepada pengguna.
Baca Juga: Resmi Diluncurkan, Harga HUAWEI WATCH GT 7 Series Dibanderol Mulai Rp3,999 Juta
Dalam video yang diunggah lewat akun resmi media sosial (medsos) Flip pada Rabu, 7 Oktober 2026 kemarin, pria yang akrab disapa Ari tersebut mengungkap perusahaan masih menangani gangguan.
Tak hanya itu, tim Flip juga hingga kini berusaha untuk memastikan saldo pengguna tetap aman selama layanan Flip tumbang hingga kembali beroperasi secara normal lagi.
“Saya ingin meminta maaf kepada teman-teman Flip semua atas kendala yang dialami aplikasi kami sejak hari Minggu kemarin,” ujar Ari di akun medsos Flip. Ia menambahkan, “saldo pengguna saat ini sudah kembali dapat digunakan.”
“Untuk membantu pengguna yang terdampak, Flip juga sudah mulai membuka layanan lain secara bertahap untuk memulihkan operasional platform,” jelasnya.
Ari mengatakan, dia dan tim saat ini telah berkomunikasi dengan Bank Indonesia terkait kondisi Flip down selama beberapa hari terakhir ini.
Refund Flip Error Sudah Dibuka
Selain pemulihan layanan, Flip juga membuka kembali opsi refund bagi pengguna yang membutuhkan pengambilan dana. “Layanan refund Flip juga sudah kami buka sejak kemarin,” kata Ari.
Flip sebelumnya menginformasikan, proses refund imbas layanan Flip error akan dilakunan secara bertahap. Dijelaskan, penyelesaian ini diperkirakan butuh waktu 1 hingga 3 hari kerja setelah data pengguna diterima.
Cara Ajukan Refund Flip:
Buka aplikasi Flip
Klik menu Semua Produk, dan pada sub menu Lainnya pilih Refund
Pilih transaksi yang akan di refund. Jika dana yang ingin dikembalikan tidak ada opsi, maka pilih salah satu alasan yang ada.
Tekan tombol Upload Bukti Transfer, unggah bukti transfer, dan klik Unggah
Pilih bank dan masukan nomor rekening tujuan refund
Klik Simpan dan Lanjutkan
Jangan lupa cek detail Refund, dan klik Ajukan Refund.
Perusahaan juga mengingatkan pengguna untuk memastikan nomor rekening tujuan sudah benar. Pengajuan refund Flip eror dapat tertolak apabila rekening yang dimasukkan tidak sesuai.
Flip Belum Ungkap Penyebab Gangguan
Aplikasi Flip. (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)
Hingga kini, Ari masih belum menjelaskan secara detail tentang penyebab gangguan yang membuat layanan Flip error selama beberapa hari ini.
Perusahaan juga belum memberikan penjelasan tentang jenis gangguan yang terjadi ataupun seluruh layanan yang terdampak ketika Flip error.
Walau begitu, sejumlah pihak di internet menduga saat ini sedang ada masalah internal di Flip. Selain itu, ada pula teori yang menyebutkan alasan layanan fintech ini tumbang karena volume transaksi yang membludak berakibat sistem bermasalah.
Lainnya, ada warganet yang mengklaim insiden Flip error berhubungan dengan aksi penipuan di dalam perusahaan atau sistem dibobol oleh pihak yang tidak berkepentingan.
Flip Masih Dalam Proses Perbaikan
Aplikasi Flip. (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)
Sebelumnya, Flip melalui akun resmi di X beberapa kali menyampaikan tim sedang berupaya memulihkan layana Flip error. Dalam salah satu pembaruan pada 5 Oktober, perusahaan memastikan saldo pengguna tetap aman.
Sehari kemudian, Flip kembali memberikan pembaruan dan menyebut proses pemulihan masih berlangsung. Pada saat yang sama, perusahaan mulai membuka layanan refund bagi pengguna.
Flip juga menyebut layanan Flip Saldo (Dutamoney) dan SuperFlip (Aladin) tetap menjadi bagian dari informasi yang disampaikan dalam pembaruan tersebut.
Perkembangan selanjutnya terkait Flip error, menurut Ari, akan disampaikan melalui kanal media sosial resmi Flip.
Fitur Minta Uang Lewat Flip
Seluruh pengguna Flip dapat menikmati fitur terbaru ini sejak Oktober 2022. Caranya dengan cara membuka aplikasi Flip, klik menu ‘Minta’ di halaman utama kemudian klik ‘Tambah Rekeningmu’ dan pilih bank yang digunakan untuk menerima uang.
Setelah itu, masukan nomor rekening dan klik Cek Rekening. Pastikan nomor rekening sesuai kemudian ‘Simpan Rekening’. Pengguna juga bisa memilih tautan yang diinginkan, kemudian salin tautan untuk membagikan tautan ke pengguna Flip lainnya.
Hanya dengan klik satu tautan, pengguna lainnya dapat langsung memasukan nominal uang yang hendak ditransfer tanpa perlu memasukan nomor rekening lagi. “Uang akan langsung masuk ke rekening pengguna apabila sudah melakukan transfer,” imbuh Head of Marketing Flip Andri Rahmad Wijaya.
Fitur Minta Uang juga memudahkan pengguna Flip untuk mengelola dan memantau riwayat penerimaan uang sehingga pengguna tidak perlu khawatir terhadap kesalahan transfer. Sourabh berharap fitur Minta Uang ini dapat membuat proses transfer yang lebih efisien bagi para pengguna Flip.
“Dengan lisensi dari Bank Indonesia, Flip senantiasa melakukan inovasi dan inisiatif demi menciptakan jasa pembayaran berbasis teknologi yang nyaman, mudah, dan aman bagi masyarakat Indonesia,” tutur dia.
Artikel berjudul Flip Error Berhari-hari, CEO Flip Akhirnya Buka Suara yang ditulis oleh Yus Lianson pertama kali tampil di Gizmologi.id
