items.content:
Vivo baru saja mengumumkan lini HP Android terbarunya, X500, X500 Pro, dan X500 Pro Max di China pada 21 September 2026. Walau tidak diungkap secara langsung dalam acara tersebut, tanda-tanda kehadiran Vivo X500 FE di pasar global mulai ramai di internet.
Setelah terdaftar dalam database GSMA dan Eurasian Economic Commision (EEC), ponsel yang diduga menggunakan nomor model V2653 kini juga muncul di Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri (TKDN) Kementerian Perindustrian.
Baca Juga: GTA 6 Bisa Dimainkan di PC Lewat Cloud, Ini Klarifikasi Xbox
Pantauan tim Gizmologi di situs P3DN, Rabu (7/10/2026), ponsel diduga Vivo X500 FE tersebut sudah tercatat memiliki nilai TKDN sebesar 40,33 persen.
Kemunculan HP baru Vivo di TKDN ini menjadi sinyal positif, perusahaan asal China tersebut kemungkinan tengah menyiapkan varian FE untuk pasar Indonesia. Kini, Vivo tinggal menanti diterbitkannya sertifikasi Postel dari Komdigi untuk bisa menjual ponsel ini secara resmi di Tanah Air.
Kehadiran HP Vivo X500 FE, akan melengkapi lini smartphone baru Vivo yang akan meluncur menjelang akhir tahun ini mulai dari X500, X500 Pro, hingga X500 Pro Max.
Bocoran Spesifikasi Vivo X500 FE
Sayangnya, informasi terkait spesifikasi Vivo X500 FE ini masih terbatas. Sejumlah rumor di internet menyebutkan, ponsel berkonsep compact ini akan menggunakan layar 6,31 inci, chipset Snapdragon 8 Gen 5, dan baterai 6.500mAh.
Meski begitu, kemunculan vivo X500 FE menarik karena menunjukkan perusahaan tampaknya terus mempertahankan lini FE dalam keluarga smartphone flagship seri X.
Sebelumnya, perusahaan telah menghadirkan X200 FE dan X300 FE untuk pasar global. Kedua perangkat tersebut dikenal mengusung pendekatan sedikit berbeda dibanding model utama, yakni menawarkan desain lebih ringkas tanpa mengorbankan performa kelas flagship.
Jika pola tersebut berlanjut, vivo X500 FE berpotensi kembali mengisi segmen pengguna menginginkan smartphone flagship dengan ukuran lebih compact.
Yang sudah dapat dipastikan, kehadiran nomor model V2653 atau Vivo X500 FE di database TKDN menjadi indikasi Indonesia kemungkinan masuk dalam salah satu pasar sedang dipersiapkan untuk perangkat tersebut.
Vivo X500 Series Diresmikan
Setelah merilis teaser resmi sejak beberapa pekan terakhir, akhirnya vivo secara resmi menghadirkan jajaran flagship terbarunya yang kini tersedia dalam tiga opsi berbeda. Ya, vivo X500 Series kembali hadir membawa setup kamera superior, tetap berkolaborasi dengan ZEISS, dan andalkan cip rilisan terbaru dari MediaTek.
Kalau generasi sebelumnya hanya tersedia dalam dua varian berbeda, vivo kini kembali menawarkan lini vivo X500 Series dalam tiga opsi; vivo X500, vivo X500 Pro, dan vivo X500 Pro Max. Varian standar justru hadir dalam penyegaran desain dengan dimensi layar sedikit membesar, sementara varian Pro tetap andalkan desain kompak, dan varian Pro Max membawa setup kamera paling superior—termasuk sensor Sony LYT-910 terbaru yang mendukung arsitektur LOFIC.
Melalui kehadiran vivo X500 Series, vivo ingin mengedepankan kemampuan perekaman video tingkat lanjut, sekaligus memberikan pengalaman fotografi yang juga ikut disempurnakan. Tidak hanya lewat peningkatan sensor, namun fitur yang ikut ditambahkan, serta aksesori pelengkap di mana varian standar juga membawa dukungan aksesori teleconverter.
Kamera vivo X500 Pro Max Bawa Peningkatan Hardware & Software
Dari ketiga varian yang diluncurkan hari ini, vivo X500 Pro Max tentu menjadi opsi tertinggi dan paling menggoda. Desain vivo X500 Pro Max sendiri masih tergolong mirip, namun dengan perbedaan pada opsi warna, di mana permukaan bodi belakang kini mengadopsi gaya dual tone. Tetap membawa sertifikasi hingga IP69, sementara bagian lensa terproteksi lapisan “ultra hard AR” khusus.
Layar vivo X500 Pro Max mengadopsi panel OLED 2K ZEISS Master Color Display berukuran 6,85 inci yang sudah berjenis BOE Q11 terbaru, membawa refresh rate hingga 144Hz, serta tingkat kecerahan maksimum sampai 4400 nits. Chipset yang digunakan adalah Dimensity 9600 Pro terbaik dari MediaTek, dipasangkan bersama RAM 12GB.
Bagaimana dengan setup kameranya? Sensor utama kamera vivo X500 Pro Max kini mengusung Sony LYT-910, beresolusi 50MP, dengan dimensi sensor besar 1/1,28 inci dan sudah mendukung teknologi LOFIC, sehingga mampu menangkap cahaya lebih optimal dalam skenario lebih ekstrem seperti backlight dan sejenisnya. Tetap memiliki stabilisasi gimbal-grade hingga 3 derajat.
Sensor telefoto 200MP-nya juga ikut diperbarui, berjenis HP0 yang mendukung standar stabilisasi CIPA 7.0. Kedua sensor ini mendukung autofocus tracking hingga 60fps, dan vivo X500 Pro Max membawa dukungan 8K Live serta 4K 240fps yang bisa memberikan efek slow-motion dalam kualitas visual jauh lebih tajam.
Kedua sensor andalan tersebut dipasangkan bersama sensor 50MP ultra-wide JN5 yang mendukung autofokus, serta 50MP JN1 (20mm) dengan autofokus di sisi depan (alias kamera selfie). Dan untuk memberikan kemampuan zoom lebih jauh, kamera vivo X500 Pro Max dirancang kompatibel dengan lensa 400mm ZEISS Teleconverter G2 Ultra. Plus, sistem empat mikrofon untuk perekaman audio lebih superior.

The body of 23-year-old medical student Sultan Zafar, who died last year after allegedly falling from a moving vehicle at Karachi's Sea View, was exhumed on Wednesday, nearly 15 months after his death, following a request by his family.
A nine-member medical board, comprising seven doctors and two mortuary attendants, exhumed the body at Kohi Goth Graveyard and conducted a post-mortem examination. Samples were collected and sent for chemical examination, while the final post-mortem report will be prepared after the chemical examination results are received.
The exhumation was ordered by a magistrate on an application filed by Sultan’s family.
Read: Court grants three-day remand of two suspects in Karachi DHA assault case
Professor of Radiology Dr Saba Sohail was appointed chairperson of the medical board. The board included Dr Mehreen Fatima of the Department of Forensic Medicine at Dow Medical College, neurosurgeon Dr Imran, Jinnah Hospital Medico-Legal Officer Dr Mumtaz, Police Surgeon’s Office administrative in-charge Dr Yasin, Additional Police Surgeon at Abbasi Shaheed Hospital Dr Kamran Sheikh and Police Surgeon Dr Summaiya Syed. Mortuary attendants Shoaib and Anees were also part of the board.
Zafar had gone to Dau Darya with friends on July 23, 2025, where he sustained serious injuries in what was initially described as an accident. He remained under treatment at a hospital for about a week before succumbing to his injuries.
His mother, Dr Mehr Afroz, later donated his organs. On July 31, both of Zafar’s kidneys were transplanted into two patients undergoing dialysis at the Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation (SIUT), where Dr Mehr works as a doctor.
According to the family, CT scans and X-rays conducted after the incident had revealed fractures in different parts of Sultan’s body, including a nasal bone fracture. The family said it approached police over the injuries but received no cooperation.
Speaking to the media after the exhumation, Sultan’s maternal aunt Mehr Feroz said the family suspected that he had been murdered.
Also Read: Two dead, one injured in Do Darya car crash
She said three girls and four boys were accompanying Sultan when the incident occurred. According to the family, they travelled in two vehicles from Dau Darya towards an under-construction building beyond the area.
Sultan’s friends had allegedly told the family that he got out of the vehicle while it was travelling at around 20 kilometres per hour and sustained injuries. However, Mehr Feroz said the family had found no evidence at the alleged site to support the account of an accident.
Police registered a case under Section 320 of the Pakistan Penal Code at Sahil police station nearly six months after the incident, on the complaint of Sultan’s mother. The family has now sought to establish the circumstances surrounding Sultan’s death through the post-mortem examination and subsequent forensic analysis.

items.title: New month, new binge: Here's what's landing on Netflix this October
items.summary:
Netflix is welcoming October with a packed lineup of new films, original series, returning favourites and documentaries, giving subscribers plenty to watch throughout the month.
The streaming giant's October schedule includes Ben Affleck's Animals, a new adaptation of John Steinbeck's East of Eden, the Victorious spin-off Hollywood Arts, and new seasons of popular shows including Nobody Wants This, Lupin and The Diplomat.
The month will also bring a collection of documentaries focusing on comedians and entertainers, including Martin Mull, Norm Macdonald, Maria Bamford and Matthew Perry.
Here are some of the biggest new titles coming to Netflix in October:
East of Eden — October 1
One of Netflix's most ambitious October releases is East of Eden, a seven-episode adaptation of John Steinbeck's celebrated novel.
The period drama follows the complicated lives of two brothers and Cathy Ames, a fiercely independent woman whose arrival has lasting consequences for the family.

items.author: Life And Style Desk
items.content:
Netflix is welcoming October with a packed lineup of new films, original series, returning favourites and documentaries, giving subscribers plenty to watch throughout the month.
The streaming giant's October schedule includes Ben Affleck's Animals, a new adaptation of John Steinbeck's East of Eden, the Victorious spin-off Hollywood Arts, and new seasons of popular shows including Nobody Wants This, Lupin and The Diplomat.
The month will also bring a collection of documentaries focusing on comedians and entertainers, including Martin Mull, Norm Macdonald, Maria Bamford and Matthew Perry.
Here are some of the biggest new titles coming to Netflix in October:
East of Eden — October 1
One of Netflix's most ambitious October releases is East of Eden, a seven-episode adaptation of John Steinbeck's celebrated novel.
The period drama follows the complicated lives of two brothers and Cathy Ames, a fiercely independent woman whose arrival has lasting consequences for the family.
Florence Pugh stars as Cathy, with Christopher Abbott and Mike Faist also leading the cast. Created by Zoe Kazan, the series explores family, rivalry, love, ambition and the ways personal choices can shape generations.
Steinbeck's novel, first published in 1952, is considered one of the author's defining works and was itself inspired in part by the biblical story of Cain and Abel.
Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke — October 1
Netflix's October comedy slate begins with Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke, which centres on the wealthy AlThahabi family.
The family has built its identity around luxury and social status, but its comfortable existence begins to unravel when it discovers that its financial situation is far worse than expected.
Rather than immediately acknowledge their problems, the family attempts to keep up appearances, creating a series of comic situations as they try to protect their reputation.
Who Is Martin Mull? — October 7
Netflix's documentary lineup includes Who Is Martin Mull?, a look at the life and career of the late actor, comedian, musician and artist.
Mull built a career that crossed several creative fields, appearing in television and film while also pursuing music and visual art. The documentary explores his unconventional career and features contributions from people who knew and worked with him.
Animals — October 9
One of October's biggest film releases is Animals, starring Ben Affleck and Kerry Washington.
Affleck plays Mark Kimball, a Los Angeles mayoral candidate whose family is thrown into turmoil when his son is kidnapped. His wife, Abigail, played by Washington, joins him as they attempt to secure their son's release.
The situation forces the couple to make increasingly difficult decisions while confronting secrets within their own lives.
Affleck also directed and co-wrote the thriller. The cast includes Gillian Anderson, Steven Yeun, Adriana Paz and Luis Gerardo Méndez.
The film arrives on Netflix on October 9, giving subscribers one of the month's most prominent new movie releases.
Hollywood Arts — October 15
Fans of Nickelodeon's Victorious will recognise a familiar face in Hollywood Arts.
Daniella Monet returns as Trina Vega in the new sitcom, which revisits the performing-arts school from the original series but introduces a new generation of students. Trina is no longer a student herself. After failing to achieve the acting career she had hoped for, she finds herself back at Hollywood Arts as a substitute teacher.
The series also brings back Yvette Nicole Brown as Principal Helen while introducing several new young performers.
The Diplomat Season 4 — October 15
Keri Russell returns as diplomat Kate Wyler for the fourth season of Netflix's political thriller The Diplomat.
Kate continues dealing with the fallout from the political and personal upheaval of previous seasons as tensions between the United States and Britain become increasingly complicated.
Her relationship with husband Hal, played by Rufus Sewell, remains another major part of the story as Kate faces new political challenges and threats.
Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald — October 16
Comedian Norm Macdonald is the subject of another major Netflix documentary arriving this month.
Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald looks at the comedian's career, from his rise in stand-up to his celebrated run on Saturday Night Live and his later work in television and film.
Directed by Judd Apatow, the documentary draws on archival material and personal footage to examine Macdonald's distinctive approach to comedy and his influence on other performers.
It arrives on October 16.
Nobody Wants This Season 3 — October 22
Kristen Bell and Adam Brody return as Joanne and Noah in the third season of Nobody Wants This.
After the twists and complications of their relationship in the earlier seasons, the new episodes move the couple into another stage of their romance.
Season 3 explores what happens when Joanne and Noah attempt to build a life together rather than simply trying to figure out whether they should be together.
Lupin Part 4 — October 23
French crime series Lupin returns with Omar Sy once again playing master thief Assane Diop.
Part 4 takes place four years after the events of the previous chapter. Assane remains in prison and appears ready to accept his situation, but circumstances soon threaten to pull him back into the world of crime and deception.
The series, inspired by the fictional gentleman thief Arsène Lupin, has become one of Netflix's most successful French-language productions since its debut in 2021.
Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story — October 23
Comedian Maria Bamford becomes the focus of Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story.
The documentary explores Bamford's career, family life and experiences with mental health while examining the personal experiences that have influenced her comedy.
The One About Matthew Perry — October 27
Netflix will also look back at the life of Matthew Perry in the three-part documentary series The One About Matthew Perry.
Perry became an international star through his role as Chandler Bing on Friends, but his life away from the sitcom was marked by struggles with addiction and efforts to maintain his career while dealing with his personal challenges.
The documentary draws on interviews, photographs and footage from Perry's life and explores both his fame and the difficulties he faced away from the screen.
Older Halloween favourites also return
While the focus of Netflix's October schedule is on new releases, the platform is also bringing back several older titles that fit the Halloween season.
The Twilight films will return for viewers looking for supernatural romance, while Alfred Hitchcock's classic Psycho offers a more traditional psychological thriller.
The original Friday the 13th will also be available for horror fans, alongside A Haunted House and its sequel for viewers who prefer their Halloween scares mixed with comedy.
Netflix's October lineup offers a mix of major new productions, returning series and documentaries, giving viewers plenty of options throughout the month. From the literary drama of East of Eden and the suspense of Animals to new chapters of The Diplomat, Nobody Wants This and Lupin, the schedule covers a wide range of genres.

items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
Microsoft mulai memberikan gambaran lebih jelas mengenai arah perangkat Xbox generasi berikutnya yang dikenal dengan nama kode Project Helix. Dalam sebuah town hall internal, CEO Xbox Asha Sharma disebut mengatakan bahwa generasi ke-10 Xbox akan hadir sebagai sebuah keluarga perangkat, bukan hanya satu konsol. Konsol rumahan akan menjadi perangkat utama yang lebih dulu dikembangkan.
Pernyataan tersebut diperoleh dan diverifikasi oleh Windows Central melalui transkrip acara internal. Sharma mengatakan Microsoft tetap akan menghadirkan konsol yang menjadi bagian penting dari generasi berikutnya, tetapi juga menyadari bahwa banyak pemain menggunakan perangkat mereka saat bepergian. Microsoft disebut akan membuat sebagian perangkat sendiri dan bekerja sama dengan mitra untuk produk lainnya.
Pernyataan soal pemain yang bermain saat bepergian kemudian memunculkan dugaan bahwa keluarga Helix juga akan mencakup perangkat handheld. Namun, Sharma tidak secara langsung menyebut kata handheld. Karena itu, keberadaan perangkat portabel tersebut belum bisa dianggap sebagai konfirmasi resmi. Microsoft sendiri saat ini sudah bekerja sama dengan ASUS melalui lini ROG Xbox Ally.
Baca Juga: Xbox Disc-to-Digital Sudah Hadir! Lisensi Game Fisik Punya Sejumlah Batasan
Project Helix Bukan Sekadar Satu Konsol
Konsep keluarga perangkat sebenarnya bukan hal baru untuk Project Helix. Microsoft sebelumnya telah mengungkap bahwa generasi Xbox berikutnya dirancang sebagai beberapa perangkat dengan karakteristik berbeda. Pendekatan ini memungkinkan perusahaan menjangkau pemain yang menggunakan konsol rumahan maupun perangkat untuk bermain saat bepergian.
Helix juga dikabarkan akan menggunakan chip AMD kustom dan memiliki kemampuan menjalankan game Xbox sekaligus game PC. Sistem operasi menjadi bagian penting dari rencana tersebut karena Microsoft tengah mengembangkan pengalaman yang dapat menjembatani ekosistem Xbox dan Windows. Sharma mengatakan perkembangan sistem operasi Helix sejauh ini terlihat menjanjikan.
Handheld Masih Belum Dikonfirmasi Microsoft
Jika perangkat portabel benar-benar menjadi bagian dari keluarga Helix, belum diketahui apakah Microsoft akan memproduksinya sendiri atau menggandeng perusahaan lain. Pernyataan Sharma mengenai beberapa perangkat yang akan dibuat melalui kemitraan memang membuka kemungkinan tersebut, tetapi belum ada informasi mengenai bentuk perangkat, spesifikasi, maupun mitra yang terlibat.
Microsoft juga belum mengumumkan harga maupun tanggal peluncuran Project Helix. Berdasarkan informasi yang disebut dalam laporan terkait, perangkat pengembangan atau dev kit Helix baru diperkirakan tersedia mulai akhir 2027. Artinya, konsumen masih kemungkinan harus menunggu cukup lama sebelum mendapatkan gambaran final mengenai perangkat generasi berikutnya tersebut.

items.author: Anne Florentyna
items.content:
Voice AI startup Desible.ai has raised ₹32 Cr (around $3.7 Mn) in a seed funding round led by Prime Venture Partners, with participation from existing backer Invention Engine.
The Bengaluru-based startup, which offers agentic AI workflows for companies in the BFSI sector, plans to use the fresh capital to deepen its agentic AI capabilities, strengthen compliance infrastructure, expand its go-to-market efforts and accelerate product development.
Founded in 2025 by Uttam Tiwari and Omkar Raikar, Desible.ai currently orchestrates over 25 agentic AI workflows spanning revenue, risk and compliance, collections, underwriting, service and claims.
The startup initially uses voice AI as an entry point into the BFSI ecosystem but is expanding its platform across WhatsApp, SMS and email. Beyond voice AI, the startup’s platform is designed to automate customer engagement, servicing, operations and compliance workflows for banks, NBFCs and insurance companies.
Its use cases include persistence and renewal management, collections, lead qualification, welcome calling, TeleMER, claims intimation and cross-selling, among others.
Desible.ai claimed that its platform currently handles more than 10 Mn customer engagements every month and is being used or evaluated by 40+ BFSI institutions.
“Voice AI is our entry point, not our destination. We are building an outcome-driven agentic workflow orchestration platform for BFSI enterprises,” Tiwari said.
The funding comes at a time when the rise of generative and agentic AI is pushing financial services companies to automate increasingly complex workflows. However, deploying AI in a regulated environment comes with additional challenges around compliance, auditability, customer consent and data security.
This creates an opening for vertical AI platforms that can combine automation with industry-specific controls. The opportunity for AI in BFSI is also shifting from conversational applications towards agentic systems capable of executing multi-step workflows.
Betting on this growing opportunity, voice AI startups like Navana.ai recently raised ₹40 Cr ($4.2 Mn) in a Series A funding round to scale its voice AI platform’s deployment across the BFSI sector, earlier in September. Additionally, voice AI startup Arrowhead raised $3 Mn (₹27 Cr) funding in its seed round earlier in January, for hiring and technology development.

items.author: Tom Jackson
items.content:
South African startup Vambo AI has released MORENA, an open weight 1.5-billion-parameter language model trained from scratch for 12 African languages, as well as English and French.
Founded by Chido Dzinotyiwei and Isheanesu Misi in April 2023, Vambo AI builds AI that “understands the languages of people in the rest of the world”.
Individual users can write, search, translate and transcribe, while businesses and innovators can use the startup’s API and developer tools to build solutions for people across multiple geographies, and localise solutions that “have solved pertinent problems in other regions”.
The platform already understood 11 languages, including Arabic, KiSwahili, IsiZulu and French, but it has now released MORENA, which Misi claims is the largest open African AI model trained from scratch.
MORENA understands 12 African languages – ChiShona, Kiswahili, Hausa, Yorùbá, Igbo, isiZulu, isiXhosa, Kinyarwanda, Setswana, Afrikaans, isiNdebele and Nigerian Pidgin – as well as English and French. Misi said it beats a Google model eight times its size on African text modelling.
“It tokenises African languages more efficiently so it’s both cheaper to run in African contexts and cheaper to adapt, which means startups in Nigeria, or researchers in Kenya, will spend less to make their own models and use them in real world settings, with fine-tuning being our recommended way to use this,” he said.
“It’s over three times the size of the second largest African language model, which gives other researchers a a new point of reference. It also proved that other African initiatives from scratch do not necessarily need billion dollar budgets.”

“As far as local grounds are concerned, there you get tough pitches and play different bowlers,” he said.
“I think we all should play cricket there, and when you get a good pitch, it becomes easy to perform.”
Hasan’s return against India carried added significance because of how his previous spell had ended.
“I think I was dropped while underperforming against India, and I made a comeback against the same opposition,” he said.
Pakistan were unable to turn Hasan’s return into victory, suffering a narrow defeat after failing to make the most of key moments in the final against India in the Asian Games.
“We couldn’t win the match, which was a sad feeling,” Hasan said.
“It was a close game, we lost it by making some silly mistakes,” Hasan was quick to add.
Despite the disappointment, Hasan believes facing India can provide an important confidence boost, particularly given their current standing in international cricket.
“There is no hiding that they (India ) are the number one team in the world currently, and performing against them gives me a lot of confidence,” he said.
He said he also travelled to Japan after the CPL with a clear motivation to contribute to Pakistan, but admitted the side ultimately allowed the match against India to slip away.
“When I was on my way to Japan after playing the Caribbean Premier League (CPL) I had the motivation to do something for the country,” Hasan said.
“But some mistakes cost us the game.”
India had downed Pakistan in the 20th Asian Games final by 19 runs.
Pakistan were reduced to 192-6 while chasing a stiff target of 212 in Nisshin and had to content with a silver medal.

items.author: Michael Robuck
items.content:
Nvidia highlighted work to help operators rethink dependence on closed AI systems, promoting open-source models to give carriers direct control over network automation and customer workflows.
In a blog, Nvidia stated operators including SoftBank Corp, AT&T and Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison are increasingly deploying open models alongside proprietary systems, explaining they retain full visibility over sensitive network data and can fine-tune models for their specific operational needs.
The move reflects a broader shift across telecommunications.
Nvidia highlighted the findings of its State of AI in Telecommunications 2026 survey in which 89% of operators deemed open-source software critical to their AI strategy, driven in part by independent benchmarks showing open models closing performance gaps in reasoning, coding and autonomous network triage.
Operators are dividing their workloads rather than relying on a single system. Expensive, proprietary models are reserved for complex tasks where closed platforms still hold an edge, while lower-cost open foundation models handle day-to-day operations.
SoftBank used Nvidia’s Nemotron family as the foundation for its Large Telecom Model, employing years of internal operational data.
Rajeev Koodli, principal fellow at SoftBank and SVP of SB Telecom America, explained open models allow it to capitalise on rapid global AI progress and its accumulated network expertise.
AT&T is also taking a multi-model approach. Chief data and AI officer Andy Markus said the goal is to intelligently match “every workload to the right combination of performance, cost and control.”
Nvidia highlighted Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison tailored its open models to Indonesian language and culture.

items.title: ChatGPT dan Gemini Palsu Dipakai untuk Curi Password serta Kode MFA
items.summary:
Perkembangan kecerdasan buatan (AI) yang semakin pesat ternyata menjadi ladang basah penipuan internet, di mana ChatGPT dan Gemini palsu dipakai pelaku kejahatan.
Baru-baru ini, tim peneliti keamanan siber mengungkap kampanye phishing memanfaatkan popularitas layanan, seperti ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, hingga Meta Muse.
Baca Juga: 26 Tahun Biznet, dari Internet hingga Bangun Infrastruktur Digital untuk Era AI
Berbekal situs palsu berkedok platform periklanan berbasis AI, pelaku kejahatan mampu mencuri kredensial akun bisnis dan kode authentikasi multi-faktor (MFA) tanpa disadari oleh korban, sebagaimana dilansir The Hacker News, Rabu (7/10/2026).
Perusahaan keamanan tersebut menjelaskan, situs-situs tersebut diklaim dapat membantu pengguna mengelola kampanye iklan, menghubungkan akun bisnis, hingga melakukan audit pengeluaran iklan. Pada kenyataannya, tujuan utama portal ChatGPT dan Gemini palsu itu adalah mengambil alih akun korban.
Portal ChatGPT dan Gemini Palsu
Men
items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Perkembangan kecerdasan buatan (AI) yang semakin pesat ternyata menjadi ladang basah penipuan internet, di mana ChatGPT dan Gemini palsu dipakai pelaku kejahatan.
Baru-baru ini, tim peneliti keamanan siber mengungkap kampanye phishing memanfaatkan popularitas layanan, seperti ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, hingga Meta Muse.
Baca Juga: 26 Tahun Biznet, dari Internet hingga Bangun Infrastruktur Digital untuk Era AI
Berbekal situs palsu berkedok platform periklanan berbasis AI, pelaku kejahatan mampu mencuri kredensial akun bisnis dan kode authentikasi multi-faktor (MFA) tanpa disadari oleh korban, sebagaimana dilansir The Hacker News, Rabu (7/10/2026).
Perusahaan keamanan tersebut menjelaskan, situs-situs tersebut diklaim dapat membantu pengguna mengelola kampanye iklan, menghubungkan akun bisnis, hingga melakukan audit pengeluaran iklan. Pada kenyataannya, tujuan utama portal ChatGPT dan Gemini palsu itu adalah mengambil alih akun korban.
Portal ChatGPT dan Gemini Palsu
Menurut laporan Island, setiap situs menggunakan pendekatan hampir sama. Pengunjung akan disambut halaman menawarkan fitur pengelolaan iklan berbasis AI dengan tombol “Connect”, terlihat seperti proses integrasi layanan resmi pada umumnya.
Saat tombol diklik, korban akan melihat jendela login resmi tampak berasal dari Google, Meta, TikTok, atau Okta. Namun jendela tersebut sebenarnya merupakan bagian dari halaman phishing dirancang menggunakan teknik Browser-in-the-Browser (BitB).
OpenAI Upgrade ChatGPT Voice
Teknik ini membuat penyerang dapat menampilkan jendela login ChatGPT dan Gemini palsu sangat mirip dengan halaman asli, lengkap dengan alamat domain yang terlihat meyakinkan.
Akibatnya, korban dapat memasukkan username, password, hingga kode MFA tanpa menyadari data tersebut sedang dikirim ke pelaku.
Hacker Kendalikan Serangan Secara Real-Time
Berbeda dari phishing pada umumnya adalah keterlibatan operator manusia di balik layar. Riset Island menemukan, pelaku dapat memantau proses login di portal ChatGPT dan Gemini palsu secara langsung dan menentukan langkah berikutnya berdasarkan respons korban.
Jika korban memasukkan password, operator dapat meminta kode MFA. Jika autentikasi menggunakan aplikasi autentikator atau notifikasi persetujuan, tampilan yang sesuai akan ditampilkan secara real-time.
Dengan cara tersebut, pelaku berupaya menyelesaikan proses login di portal ChatGPT dan Gemini palsu pada akun asli korban saat serangan masih berlangsung.
Peneliti juga menemukan perangkat korban lebih dulu dipindai dan diidentifikasi sebelum proses pencurian kredensial dilakukan.
Setiap Brand AI Memiliki “Cerita” Berbeda
Claude Opus 5.5. (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)
Menariknya, kampanye ini tidak hanya menyalin satu merek. Para penyerang membuat narasi berbeda untuk setiap layanan AI agar terlihat lebih meyakinkan. ChatGPT, misalnya, diposisikan sebagai alat yang dapat membantu menyusun ringkasan performa Google Ads.
Gemini disebut mendukung pengelolaan akun iklan dalam skala besar. Sementara Claude, Perplexity, hingga Manus diberi identitas produk dan manfaat yang berbeda-beda. Island menilai pendekatan ini menunjukkan pelaku aktif mengikuti perkembangan industri AI dan menyesuaikan umpan serangan dengan tren yang sedang berkembang.
Salah satu contoh ditemukan adalah museads.ai yang muncul tidak lama setelah Meta memperkenalkan Muse, agen AI untuk produktivitas personal.
Target Utama Hacker Bukan Pengguna Biasa
Ilustrasi (Foto: 123rf/master1305)
Kampanye phishing portal ChatGPT dan Gemini palsu ini lebih berfokus pada pengguna bisnis dibandingkan konsumen umum. Target yang disebut dalam laporan mencakup staf agency, media buyer, administrator akun iklan, hingga pengelola manager account yang memiliki akses ke banyak akun klien.
Motif phishing ChatGPT dan Gemini palsu ini diduga berkaitan dengan pembajakan akun iklan yang kemudian digunakan untuk menjalankan kampanye ilegal atau dijual kembali di pasar gelap.
Menurut laporan Mimecast yang terbit pada Juli 2026, pencurian akun iklan telah berkembang menjadi aktivitas kriminal yang semakin umum. Berbagai malware seperti DuckTail, NodeStealer, VietCredCare, dan PXA Stealer sebelumnya juga diketahui digunakan untuk mengambil alih akun periklanan digital.
Dalam banyak kasus, kerugian terbesar bukan hanya hilangnya metode pembayaran, melainkan proses pemulihan akun yang dapat berlangsung berminggu-minggu hingga berbulan-bulan.
ChatGPT untuk Remaja Resmi Meluncur
Head of Policy Southeast Asia OpenAI, Sandy Kunvatanagarn, ungkap ChatGPT untuk Remaja. (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)
Di sisi lain, OpenAI resmi menghadirkan ChatGPT untuk Remaja, layanan khusus dirancang untuk pengguna yang masih berusia di bawah 18 tahun. Versi ini membawa sejumlah perlindungan tambahan, fitur pembelajaran, serta kontrol memungkinkan orang tua ikut mendampingi penggunaan AI di rumah.
Peluncuran tersebut dilakukan di tengah meningkatnya penggunaan AI oleh kalangan anak muda. Data OpenAI mengungkap, sembilan dari sepuluh pengguna remaja memakai ChatGPT setiap minggu.Adapun anak muda memakai ChatGPT untuk berbagai keperluan, mulai dari membantu proses belajar hingga mendukung produktivitas sehari-hari. Head of Policy Southeast Asia OpenAI, Sandy Kunvatanagarn, mengatakan perusahaan ingin memastikan remaja tetap bisa memanfaatkan AI untuk belajar tanpa mengabaikan aspek keamanan.
“Kami baru saja meluncurkan ChatGPT untuk Remaja, yaitu versi ChatGPT yang memiliki perlindungan dan pengaturan keamanan yang aktif secara otomatis,” dalam sesi acara bersama media di Jakarta, (30/9/2026).
Menurut Sandy, OpenAI secara khusus merancang pengalaman tersebut agar sesuai dengan kebutuhan pengguna yang masih remaja.
“Kami percaya, desain produk harus mempertimbangkan kebutuhan remaja secara khusus, sehingga mereka tetap bisa memperoleh manfaat AI untuk belajar, mengembangkan keterampilan baru, mengeksplorasi berbagai konsep, hingga mempersiapkan diri masuk universitas atau dunia kerja.”
Artikel berjudul ChatGPT dan Gemini Palsu Dipakai untuk Curi Password serta Kode MFA yang ditulis oleh Yus Lianson pertama kali tampil di Gizmologi.id

items.author: Albert Cuesta
items.content:
Nvidia ha destacado su trabajo para ayudar a los operadores a reducir su dependencia de los sistemas de IA cerrados.
La firma promueve los modelos de código abierto para que las teleoperadoras controlen directamente la automatización de la red y los flujos de trabajo con los clientes.
En una entrada de blog, Nvidia afirma que operadores como SoftBank Corp, AT&T e Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison aplican cada vez más modelos abiertos junto con sistemas propietarios.
Explica que así mantienen una visibilidad total sobre los datos confidenciales de la red y pueden ajustar los modelos a sus necesidades operativas concretas.
La tendencia refleja un cambio más amplio en el sector de las telecomunicaciones.
Nvidia ha dado a conocer los resultados de su encuesta “Estado de la IA en las telecomunicaciones 2026”, según la cual el 89 % de los operadores considera el software de código abierto crucial para su estrategia de IA.
La firma atribuye este resultado en parte a unas pruebas comparativas independientes que muestran que los modelos abiertos están reduciendo la distancia en razonamiento, programación y clasificación autónoma de la red.
Los operadores reparten sus cargas de trabajo en lugar de depender de un solo sistema: reservan los modelos propietarios, más costosos, para las tareas complejas en las que las plataformas cerradas aún tienen ventaja, y confían las operaciones diarias a modelos de base abierta, más baratos.
SoftBank ha utilizado la familia Nemotron de Nvidia como base de su gran modelo de telecomunicaciones, entrenado con años de datos operativos internos.
Rajeev Koodli, investigador principal de SoftBank y vicepresidente sénior de SB Telecom America, ha explicado que los modelos abiertos les permiten aprovechar el rápido avance global de la IA junto con su experiencia acumulada en redes.
AT&T también apuesta por un enfoque multimodelo. Su director de datos e IA, Andy Markus, ha afirmado que el objetivo es asignar con criterio “cada carga de trabajo a la combinación adecuada de rendimiento, coste y control”.
Nvidia ha subrayado asimismo que Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison ha adaptado sus modelos abiertos al idioma y la cultura de Indonesia.
Con información de Michael Robuck.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Qualcomm and MediaTek have introduced their latest flagship smartphone chipsets, bringing major upgrades in performance, efficiency, artificial intelligence, graphics, cameras, and connectivity. This vs article contains all the necessary information that one needs to know when selecting a chipset between the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and Dimensity 9600 Pro.
The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro are both built using TSMC’s advanced 2nm N2P process. The move from the 3nm generation to 2nm is one of the biggest changes in these new processors and is expected to improve both performance and power efficiency.
Despite targeting the same flagship smartphone segment, Qualcomm and MediaTek have taken different approaches to CPU, GPU, and AI processing. Early benchmark results show that the Snapdragon chip has an advantage in single-core performance and overall AnTuTu scores, while the Dimensity 9600 Pro performs slightly better in multi-core testing and GPU performance.
Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 vs Dimensity 9600 Pro Specs
Both chipsets feature eight-core CPU designs, but their architectures and clock speeds are different.
The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 uses two prime cores clocked at up to 5.0GHz and six performance cores running at up to 4.0GHz. It supports LPDDR5X and LPDDR6 memory at speeds of up to 5,300MHz, along with UFS 4.1 and UFS 5.0 storage.
The Dimensity 9600 Pro uses a 2+3+3 CPU configuration. It has two C2-Ultra cores running at up to 4.55GHz, three C2-Pro cores at up to 4.35GHz, and another three C2-Pro cores clocked at up to 3.1GHz. It supports LPDDR6 memory at up to 5,333MHz and also supports UFS 4.1 and UFS 5.0 storage.
For graphics, Qualcomm uses the Adreno 850 GPU with dedicated AI matrix cores, Adreno Neural Fusion, and 18MB of Adreno HPM. MediaTek relies on the Mali-G2 Ultra NX MP12 GPU and an AI-assisted neural upscaling engine.
The Snapdragon chipset also includes Qualcomm’s Hexagon NPU, dual Micro NPUs, and dual always-sensing ISPs. The Dimensity 9600 Pro features a dual-NPU architecture with MediaTek’s NPU 1090 and Super Efficient NPU 2.0, supporting up to 30 billion parameters.
Benchmark Performance
Early benchmark results provide an interesting comparison between the two flagship processors. The tests were conducted using the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and the Vivo X500 Pro Max with the Dimensity 9600 Pro.
Geekbench 7
The Snapdragon chipset takes a clear lead in single-core performance.
The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 scored 3,163 points in the Geekbench 7 single-core test, compared with 2,600 points for the Dimensity 9600 Pro. This gives Qualcomm’s chipset an advantage of around 21%.
However, the situation changes in the multi-core test. The Dimensity 9600 Pro scored 10,634 points, while the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 recorded 10,172 points.
This gives MediaTek a roughly 4% advantage in multi-core performance. The difference is relatively small, meaning both processors should offer strong performance for demanding applications and multitasking.

AnTuTu
The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 performs better in the overall AnTuTu test.
Qualcomm’s chipset achieved 4,592,331 points, while the Dimensity 9600 Pro scored 4,324,196 points. This gives Snapdragon an overall lead of around 6%.
The detailed results show that the Snapdragon chip also leads in CPU, memory, and UX performance. However, the Dimensity 9600 Pro performs better in the GPU portion of the test.

The numbers show that neither chipset dominates every category. Snapdragon has a stronger overall result, while MediaTek has an edge in GPU testing.
Major CPU Efficiency Improvements
The switch to the 2nm process is one of the biggest upgrades in both chipsets.
Qualcomm has pushed its flagship mobile processor to a 5GHz peak clock speed for the first time. The company claims a 37% improvement in power efficiency and a 13% increase in CPU performance.
The Snapdragon chip continues with a 2+6 CPU configuration, but its six performance cores can now reach up to 4.0GHz.
MediaTek has taken a different approach with the Dimensity 9600 Pro. It uses a 2+3+3 arrangement designed to increase peak performance. Its two C2-Ultra cores reach up to 4.55GHz, while three C2-Pro cores run at up to 4.35GHz.
MediaTek claims a 17% increase in single-core performance and a 15% improvement in multi-core performance. It also claims major efficiency improvements, including up to 37% better single-core power efficiency and a 61% improvement in multi-core power efficiency.
Qualcomm Brings AI Processing Directly to the GPU
One of the most important changes in the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 is the integration of dedicated AI processing blocks directly into the GPU.
On previous-generation Snapdragon chips, some AI workloads had to move between the Adreno GPU and Hexagon NPU. Qualcomm’s new architecture allows certain AI workloads to be processed directly inside the Adreno 850 GPU.
This approach is designed to reduce processing latency and improve real-time neural rendering. Qualcomm claims a 44% improvement in GPU performance and a 40% increase in GPU power efficiency.
MediaTek has taken a different route with the Dimensity 9600 Pro. Instead of placing dedicated AI blocks directly into the GPU, the company has improved communication between the CPU, GPU, NPU, and ISP.
The NPU 1090 acts as a centralized AI processing hub, providing AI assistance to different parts of the chipset.
MediaTek claims up to 27% higher peak performance and 24% better power efficiency at peak performance. The company also claims an 18% improvement in ray-tracing performance and support for gaming at more than 185 frames per second.
Camera and Video Improvements
Both processors bring major improvements to smartphone photography and video recording.
The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 features Qualcomm’s Spectra Triple AI-ISP with a 20-bit architecture. It supports cameras with resolutions of up to 320MP and can handle three 64MP cameras simultaneously with zero shutter lag.
The chipset supports 8K video recording at 60fps and 4K slow-motion recording at 240fps. It also adds hardware acceleration for Qualcomm’s Advanced Professional Video codec.
The Dimensity 9600 Pro uses MediaTek’s Imagiq 1290 ISP and supports cameras with resolutions of up to 200MP. It can also record 8K video at 60fps and 4K slow-motion video at 240fps.
MediaTek additionally highlights a 17-stop exposure range, along with support for 4K/60fps HDR recording and 4K/120fps recording with electronic image stabilization.
Connectivity
Qualcomm also has an advantage in connectivity specifications.
The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 includes the Snapdragon X105 5G modem, offering peak download speeds of up to 14.8Gbps and upload speeds of up to 4.2Gbps. It also supports Wi-Fi 8 with peak speeds of up to 11.6Gbps and Bluetooth 6.0.
The Dimensity 9600 Pro uses a 3GPP Release-17 5G modem with download speeds exceeding 7.4Gbps. It supports Wi-Fi 7 with peak speeds of up to 7.3Gbps and Bluetooth 6.2.
Which Chipset Is More Powerful?
The early benchmark results suggest that the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 has a small overall advantage, particularly in single-core CPU performance and the overall AnTuTu score.
The Dimensity 9600 Pro, however, should not be overlooked. It delivers slightly better multi-core performance and a higher AnTuTu GPU score. Its new CPU configuration and AI architecture also bring significant improvements in efficiency and performance.
In practical use, both chipsets should provide flagship-level performance for gaming, photography, video recording, multitasking, and AI applications. The final experience will also depend on smartphone cooling systems, software optimization, battery capacity, and other hardware.
The first smartphones featuring these 2nm processors, including the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max and Vivo X500 Pro Max, are currently limited to the Chinese market. More devices powered by these chipsets are expected to reach international markets, with a much wider range of 2nm flagship smartphones likely to appear over the coming year.

items.content:
Dehradun-based medtech startup Sunfox Technologies has raised $7 Mn (around ₹67 Cr) in a Series A funding round led by Ashish Kacholia, Lashit Sanghvi, Alchemy Capital, and 3one4 Capital.
The startup will use the fresh capital to expand its portable cardiac diagnostics platform Spandan across India, grow its team, and invest in R&D, clinical evidence, engineering, and new cardiac technologies.
It will also build regulatory, distribution, and commercial capabilities across the US, Europe, and Africa, the startup said in a statement.
Sunfox said it has regulatory approvals in India, Ghana, Kenya, Tanzania, and South Africa, and is pursuing clearances in the US and the European Union.
The fundraise follows a ₹15 Cr (around $1.8 Mn) round led by Venture Catalysts in 2024.
Founded in 2016 by Rajat Jain, Arpit Jain, Sabit Rawat, Nitin Chandola, and Saurabh Badola, Sunfox develops portable and AI-enabled cardiac diagnostic solutions for hospitals, clinics, telemedicine networks, public health programmes, and home-based monitoring.
Its Spandan devices allow users and healthcare workers to record ECGs using a smartphone and share them with doctors for remote interpretation. According to the startup, the platform can flag cardiac patterns requiring urgent attention, helping healthcare teams identify patients who need further assessment or treatment.
Its digital service platform, Spandan One, supports remote ECG reviews, case coordination, and tele-ECG network management. In public health settings, nurses or health workers can record ECGs at primary and community health centres and send them to doctors or cardiologists at district hubs for review.
Sunfox claims around 60,000 Spandan devices have been deployed across India, reaching more than 20,000 villages. Its Spandan One platform is used to screen around 5 Mn patients annually, it added.
The startup, which secured investment from all five participating investors on the first season of Shark Tank India, also claims a presence in more than 15 countries.
Sunfox competes in the portable ECG segment with the likes of Agatsa, which offers SanketLife devices, and Cardiotrack, which provides handheld ECG devices and remote interpretation solutions.

items.author: Rizwana Omer
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
You insert your card, enter your PIN and wait. The machine gives you nothing, but your account balance drops. For some Easypaisa customers, that is the problem behind a growing round of complaints.
Reportedly, users of the Easypaisa ATM/debit card have raised several issues in recent days. They are asking for better service and a clearer way to get their problems fixed, reports from Islamabad say.
What Customers Are Reporting
The most serious complaint is money deducted from an account when the ATM did not dispense cash. For a customer who relies on a small balance, even a short delay in getting it back can cause real trouble.
Users have also reported problems with:
Card activation
Card delivery
Reaching customer support
Some customers said filing a complaint over an ATM transaction dispute is itself difficult. That makes a bad experience worse. A user who cannot easily report a failed withdrawal has little chance of getting a quick fix.
Easypaisa’s Complaint Channels
Easypaisa has pointed to the ways customers can file complaints. These include a helpline, email and in-app support.
According to the company, a customer receives a complaint number after filing, along with the expected time to resolve it. That gives users a reference to track their case.
The reports do not say how many complaints have been received. They also do not say how long resolutions currently take or whether the complaint channels have been working for the affected customers. Those answers would show whether the gap is in the system or in how well people can reach it.
What SBP Rules Say
Under State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) rules, banks and related financial institutions must maintain a proper system to resolve customer complaints effectively.
Customers also have the option of going to the regulator over ATM-related complaints. In practice, this means a user who is not satisfied with the company’s response does not have to stop there. The consumer app, Sunwai, is specifically designed for banking complaints.
What Users Are Asking For
The demands are specific:
Quick resolution of ATM card disputes
Automatic return of money after a failed transaction
Simpler card activation
Easier, more effective customer support
The aim, users say, is to avoid financial loss and needless delay.
Why Automatic Refunds Matter
The call for automatic refunds is the most important demand. Right now, a customer whose withdrawal fails must usually notice the deduction, find a way to complain and then wait.
That puts the burden on the person who lost the money. An automatic reversal would shift it to the system, which already has the record that the cash was not dispensed. Whether Easypaisa’s current process already works this way is not stated in the reports.
This matters more in Pakistan because Easypaisa serves many people who use mobile wallets as their main financial account. For them, a debit card is not a convenience. It is how they reach their own cash.

items.title: 26 Tahun Biznet, dari Internet hingga Bangun Infrastruktur Digital untuk Era AI
items.summary:

items.author: Bambang Dwi Atmoko
items.content:
Memasuki usia ke-26 tahun, Biznet mulai memperluas fokus bisnisnya dari penyediaan konektivitas menuju pembangunan infrastruktur digital yang mendukung kebutuhan komputasi dan kecerdasan buatan (AI). Langkah tersebut terlihat dari pengembangan AI-Ready Data Center di Bali serta ekspansi jaringan fiber optic, termasuk kabel bawah laut Biznet Nusantara Cable System (BNCS).
Perubahan ini sejalan dengan meningkatnya kebutuhan terhadap kapasitas konektivitas dan komputasi di Indonesia. Biznet mengutip PwC Global Workforce Hopes & Fears Survey 2025 yang menyebut 69% pekerja di Indonesia telah menggunakan AI untuk pekerjaan mereka dalam 12 bulan terakhir. Sementara itu, penetrasi internet Indonesia disebut mencapai 81,72% pada 2026 berdasarkan survei APJII.
Bagi Biznet, perkembangan tersebut menunjukkan bahwa kebutuhan infrastruktur digital tidak lagi berhenti pada tersedianya akses internet. Kapasitas jaringan, pusat data, dan kemampuan pemrosesan data menjadi bagian yang semakin penting ketika penggunaan AI terus berkembang.
AI Data Center Biznet di Bali Disiapkan untuk Kebutuhan Komputasi Besar
Salah satu langkah Biznet adalah mengoperasikan AI-Ready Data Center di Bali, yang disebut sebagai AI-Ready Data Center pertama milik perusahaan.
Berbeda dari data center konvensional yang terutama melayani kebutuhan penyimpanan dan pemrosesan data, fasilitas ini dirancang dengan kapasitas listrik yang lebih besar untuk mendukung server-server AI.
Biznet menyebut fasilitas tersebut menggunakan sistem pendingin cair atau liquid cooling. Kapasitas power-nya mencapai hingga 145 kW per rak, sementara konektivitasnya juga dirancang untuk mendukung kebutuhan data center.
Penggunaan liquid cooling menjadi relevan karena beban komputasi AI dapat menghasilkan panas yang tinggi. Sistem pendinginan berbasis cairan memungkinkan panas dari perangkat komputasi ditangani lebih efektif dibandingkan pendekatan pendinginan udara pada skenario tertentu.
Biznet juga menyebut AI Center tersebut tidak hanya difungsikan sebagai pusat data, tetapi sekaligus sebagai area pengembangan teknologi AI. Perusahaan melihat fasilitas ini sebagai salah satu fondasi untuk menghadapi kebutuhan komputasi yang semakin besar.
Namun, Biznet belum mengungkapkan secara rinci jenis GPU, kapasitas komputasi AI, maupun spesifikasi infrastruktur AI yang digunakan di fasilitas tersebut. Karena itu, dampak kapasitas AI Center terhadap ekosistem AI Indonesia belum dapat diukur hanya berdasarkan informasi dalam siaran pers.
BNCS-2 Disiapkan untuk Memperkuat Konektivitas Antarwilayah
Selain pusat data, Biznet juga memperkuat lapisan infrastruktur jaringan melalui Biznet Nusantara Cable System (BNCS).
BNCS merupakan jaringan kabel fiber optic bawah laut yang dibangun, dimiliki, dan dioperasikan Biznet sejak 2024. Perusahaan kini menyiapkan pembangunan jaringan baru, Biznet Nusantara Cable System-2 (BNCS-2).
BNCS-2 direncanakan menghubungkan Surabaya–Banjarmasin–Samarinda–Bali (Buleleng)–Sumbawa–Lombok–Kupang.
Menurut Biznet, pembangunan kabel laut tersebut diarahkan untuk meningkatkan kecepatan dan kualitas layanan sekaligus memperkuat pemerataan akses internet di wilayah yang terhubung.
Strategi ini menarik karena pengembangan data center dan jaringan kabel bawah laut sebenarnya saling berkaitan. Data center membutuhkan konektivitas berkapasitas besar dan stabil, sementara jaringan backbone memungkinkan data bergerak antarwilayah dengan kapasitas yang lebih tinggi.
Dengan demikian, ekspansi Biznet tidak hanya menyasar sisi last mile atau koneksi yang digunakan pelanggan, tetapi juga infrastruktur di belakangnya.
Jaringan Biznet Sudah Menjangkau Lebih dari 200 Kota dan Kabupaten
Ekspansi infrastruktur juga terus dilakukan pada jaringan fiber optic Biznet.
Perusahaan menyebut jaringannya telah menjangkau lebih dari 200 kota/kabupaten di Pulau Jawa, Bali, Sumatra, Bangka, Batam, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, dan Flores.
Biznet juga mencatat lebih dari 3 juta homepass serta dukungan lebih dari 300 kantor cabang. Angka tersebut menunjukkan skala jaringan yang dibangun perusahaan setelah 26 tahun beroperasi.
Di sisi pelanggan, Biznet menyatakan terus meningkatkan kapasitas bandwidth. Khusus selama Oktober 2026, pelanggan Biznet Home mendapatkan peningkatan kapasitas bandwidth hingga 100 Mbps selama satu bulan tanpa biaya tambahan sebagai bagian dari rangkaian perayaan ulang tahun ke-26.
Langkah tersebut menjadi bagian yang lebih langsung dirasakan konsumen dibandingkan pembangunan infrastruktur backbone atau data center.
MyBiznet Mulai Didorong dengan AI
Pengembangan teknologi Biznet juga menyentuh sisi layanan pelanggan melalui MyBiznet App.
Aplikasi tersebut digunakan pelanggan untuk mengelola layanan, mengakses informasi, dan mendapatkan dukungan pelanggan. Biznet menyebut pengembangan MyBiznet kini turut memanfaatkan AI agar pelanggan dapat memperoleh informasi dan solusi layanan dengan lebih cepat, responsif, dan personal.
Ini menunjukkan bahwa penggunaan AI di Biznet tidak hanya diarahkan pada infrastruktur komputasi, tetapi juga mulai masuk ke lapisan layanan.
Dengan kata lain, strategi AI perusahaan memiliki setidaknya dua sisi: menyiapkan infrastruktur untuk kebutuhan komputasi AI sekaligus menggunakan AI dalam interaksi dengan pelanggan.
Biznet Perluas Akses Internet lewat Program CSR
Ekspansi infrastruktur tersebut juga dibarengi program untuk memperluas akses digital bagi masyarakat.
Dalam program tanggung jawab sosial perusahaan (CSR), Biznet menyebut telah memberikan layanan internet gratis bagi lebih dari 300 kepala keluarga (KK) di sekitar area landing point kabel bawah laut miliknya. Program tersebut disebut berjalan di Kabupaten Jembrana, Serang, Karawang, dan Gresik.
Biznet juga menyebut program ini ditujukan agar keberadaan infrastruktur tidak hanya memberikan manfaat kepada pelanggan, tetapi juga masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasional.
Pendekatan tersebut menjadi relevan karena pembangunan infrastruktur digital tidak hanya berkaitan dengan seberapa luas jaringan perusahaan menjangkau pelanggan, tetapi juga bagaimana infrastruktur tersebut terhubung dengan masyarakat di wilayah yang dilewatinya.
President Director Biznet Adi Kusma mengatakan kebutuhan digital saat ini tidak lagi terbatas pada konektivitas, tetapi juga membutuhkan kapasitas besar untuk mempercepat komputasi dan pengolahan data.
“Kami memahami betul bahwa saat ini kebutuhan digital tidak terbatas pada konektivitas semata, namun juga kapasitas besar untuk mengakselerasi segala kegiatan komputasi dan pengolahan data yang lebih besar untuk mendukung implementasi AI yang sedang berkembang saat ini,” ujar Adi.
Pernyataan tersebut menggambarkan perubahan fokus yang sedang dibangun Biznet. Setelah selama bertahun-tahun memperluas jaringan internet dan fiber optic, perusahaan kini mulai menempatkan data center, kabel bawah laut, cloud, dan AI sebagai bagian dari infrastruktur yang menopang ekosistem digital.
Bagi Indonesia, tantangannya bukan lagi sekadar memperluas jumlah pengguna internet. Ketika penggunaan AI, cloud, dan layanan digital dengan kebutuhan komputasi tinggi terus berkembang, kapasitas infrastruktur di belakang koneksi pengguna akan ikut menentukan seberapa jauh ekosistem tersebut dapat tumbuh.
Perjalanan 26 tahun Biznet karena itu tidak hanya dapat dilihat dari bertambahnya cakupan jaringan. Arah investasi perusahaan juga menunjukkan perubahan kebutuhan industri internet Indonesia: dari membangun akses, menuju membangun infrastruktur yang memungkinkan semakin banyak data diproses, disimpan, dan dipertukarkan.
Artikel berjudul 26 Tahun Biznet, dari Internet hingga Bangun Infrastruktur Digital untuk Era AI yang ditulis oleh Bambang Dwi Atmoko pertama kali tampil di Gizmologi.id

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Belakangan ini beredar rumor menyebutkan Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6), di mana pemilik PC Windows dapat dimainkan di PC lewat layanan cloud gaming saat peluncuran game tersebut pada November mendatang.
Sebelumnya, The Verge melaporkan Xbox berhasil mendapatkan hak streaming GTA 6 melalui cloud. Sontak informasi tersebut memicu spekulasi, gamer PC bisa memainkan game baru Rockstar Games itu tanpa harus menunggu versi PC resmi dirilis.
Ramai di media sosial (medsos), Xbox Chief Strategy Officer, Matthew Ball, membantah rumor tersebut. Lewat akun medsos pribadi miliknya, Matthew mengatakan, sejumlah laporan tentang GTA 6 dan Xbox telah disalahartikan.
Baca Juga: Daftar Harga iPhone 18 Pro & Pro Max Resmi Indonesia, Mulai Rp27 Jutaan!
“Walau euforia GTA 6 dan Xbox ini sangat menarik untuk dilihat, ada beberapa hal yang disalahartikan oleh banyak pihak,” tulis Matthew di akun X, Rabu (7/10/2026).
Ia menegaskan, GTA 6 memang akan hadir di Xbox pada 19 November. Akan tetapi, game tersebut tidak akan tersedia dan tidak bisa langsung dimainkan lewat streaming eksklusif untuk PC saat peluncuran.
Sebelumnya, The Verge melaporkan bahwa Xbox memperoleh hak streaming GTA 6 melalui layanan cloud gaming miliknya.
Karena Xbox Cloud Gaming dapat diakses melalui berbagai perangkat, termasuk PC, smartphone, tablet, dan smart TV, laporan tersebut memunculkan dugaan gamer PC akan memiliki jalur alternatif untuk memainkan seri baru GTA ini tanpa harus membeli konsol Xbox Series X|S atau PlayStation 5.
Spekulasi tersebut menarik perhatian karena Rockstar Games sejauh ini hanya mengonfirmasi GTA VI untuk PlayStation 5 dan Xbox Series X|S.
Hingga saat ini, Rockstar belum mengumumkan versi PC maupun jadwal peluncurannya.
Bisa Main GTA 6 Xbox Cloud Gaming? 
Meski telah mengklarifikasi laporan yang beredar, Xbox belum memberikan rincian lebih lanjut mengenai rencana cloud gaming untuk penerus GTA 5 ini.
Belum diketahui apakah akan ada bentuk integrasi cloud setelah peluncuran, kerja sama khusus antara Xbox dan Rockstar Games, maupun model distribusi yang berbeda di masa mendatang.
IGN juga melaporkan telah menghubungi Xbox dan Rockstar Games untuk meminta komentar tambahan terkait laporan tersebut.
Di sisi lain, Sony diketahui memiliki kerja sama pemasaran untuk GTA 6. Perusahaan tersebut sebelumnya memperkenalkan aksesori bertema GTA 6 dan beberapa materi promosi game juga menampilkan branding PlayStation 5.
Untuk saat ini, gamer yang ingin memainkan seri baru GTA saat peluncuran masih perlu menggunakan konsol yang didukung secara resmi, yakni PlayStation 5 atau Xbox Series X|S.
Sementara itu, pengguna PC tampaknya masih harus menunggu pengumuman resmi dari Rockstar Games terkait versi platform tersebut.
Pre-order GTA 6 Didominasi PS5, Xbox Malah Bilang Hasilnya Memuaskan
Di sisi lain, Microsoft rosoft angkat bicara tentang laporan yang menyebutkan mayoritas pre-order GTA 6 datang dari PlayStation 5 (PS5), dengan menegaskan pre-order GTA 6 di platform Xbox berada di atas ekspektasi perusahaan.
Pernyataan ini disampaikan langsung oleh Xbox Chief Strategy Officer, Matthew Ball. Lewat akun media sosial X (dulu bernama Twitter). Sabtu (26/9/2026), Ball menyebut GTA 6 turut memecahkan rekor pre-order di ekosistem Xbox.
Menurut Ball, distribusi pre-order GTA 6 mencerminkan kondisi pangsa pasar konsol saat ini, bukan indikasi Xbox tertinggal. Ia menyebut porsi pre-order yang diterima Xbox kurang lebih sejalan dengan pangsa pasar konsol Xbox dibanding PlayStation, sehingga Microsoft tidak melihat angka tersebut sebagai masalah.
“Klaim bahwa Xbox tertinggal jauh menjadi kurang relevan jika dibandingkan dengan ukuran basis pengguna masing-masing platform,” kata Matthew Ball.
Sejauh ini, Microsoft tidak mengungkap angka pasti pre-order GTA 6 di Xbox, termasuk rekor yang diklaim Ball.
Pre-order GTA 6 Didominasi PS5
Sebelumnya, laporan yang beredar menyebut pre-order GTA baru ini jauh lebih banyak berasal dari PS5 dibanding Xbox. Namun angka tersebut berasal dari estimasi pihak ketiga dan bukan data resmi yang dirilis Rockstar Games maupun Take-Two Interactive.
Karena itu, hingga saat ini belum ada gambaran resmi mengenai distribusi penjualan GTA VI di masing-masing platform.
GTA 6 diperkirakan menjadi salah satu peluncuran game terbesar dalam sejarah industri video game. Tingginya antusiasme pemain membuat performa pre-order game ini ikut menjadi indikator yang diperhatikan pelaku industri.
Bagi PlayStation, dominasi pre-order dapat memperkuat posisi platform tersebut sebagai rumah bagi sebagian besar pemain konsol.
Sementara bagi Xbox, fokusnya tampaknya bukan mengejar angka absolut, melainkan memastikan performa penjualan tetap sejalan dengan ukuran ekosistem yang dimiliki saat ini.
Karena itu, Microsoft menilai hasil pre-order GTA baru masih berada dalam jalur yang sesuai ekspektasi perusahaan, meski berbagai laporan menunjukkan PS5 memiliki porsi yang lebih besar.
Sejauh ini Rockstar Games maupun Take-Two Interactive belum mengungkap data resmi terkait distribusi pre-order GTA 6 di masing-masing platform.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
WhatsApp is developing a new dedicated Contacts tab for Android that could make it easier for users to find contacts and see who’s online. The feature is still under development and is not yet available to beta testers.
According to WhatsAppBetaInfo, the new tab will bring several contact-related tools into one place. Users will be able to search their contacts, check online activity, sort the contact list, view birthday reminders, and invite new people to WhatsApp.
WhatsApp Android to Get a Dedicated Contacts Tab With Online Status
WhatsApp previously worked on a feature that would show a list of contacts who were online. The original plan was to place this list inside the app’s settings.
The company now appears to be expanding the idea into a dedicated Contacts tab. The feature was spotted in the WhatsApp beta for Android 2.26.40.3 update.
The new tab will provide a central location for viewing contacts and their availability. Users will also be able to access other contact-related options without going through the settings menu.
Green Dot Shows Online Contacts
A search bar will appear at the top of the Contacts tab. Users will be able to search for people using their name, phone number or username.
The tab will show the full contact list. Contacts who are currently online will have a green dot displayed over their profile picture. For contacts who are offline, WhatsApp may show their last seen information when it is available.
Users will also be able to sort the list in two ways: Activity and Alphabetical.
The Activity option will place online contacts at the top. Other contacts will appear below them, with recently active users appearing higher in the list.
The Alphabetical option will arrange contacts by name regardless of their online status. The green dot will still help users identify contacts who are currently online.
Birthday Reminders May Also Be Included
WhatsApp is also preparing birthday reminders for the Contacts tab. When a contact has a birthday, the app may display a cake emoji along with a “Birthday today” message next to their name.
This could make it easier for users to remember birthdays and send a message directly through WhatsApp.
The birthday information will reportedly come from the phone’s address book. Users will therefore need to save a contact’s birthday in their address book for the reminder to appear.
Meta AI and Invite Options
The new Contacts tab may also include shortcuts to other WhatsApp features. A shortcut for starting a chat with Meta AI could appear below the contact list.
At the bottom of the page, WhatsApp may add an Invite a friend option. This will allow users to share an invitation link with people who are not yet using WhatsApp.
Privacy Settings Will Remain Important
The Contacts tab will follow WhatsApp’s existing privacy settings. Users will not be able to see information that their contacts have chosen to hide.
For example, contacts who disable their online status will not show the green online indicator. Similarly, people who hide their last seen information may not appear when the list is sorted according to recent activity.
This means the new tab will not override a user’s privacy choices. If many contacts have restricted their online or last seen information, there may be limited activity information available in the Contacts tab.
See Also: WhatsApp Blocks Logins on Some Devices Running Outdated Operating Systems
Feature Still Under Development
The new Contacts tab is currently being developed for WhatsApp on Android. It has not yet been released for beta testing, and regular users cannot access it at this time.
WhatsApp has also not confirmed when the feature will be released publicly. The company could make additional changes to the design and functionality before rolling it out in a future update.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Spam calls continue to be a common problem for smartphone users. Unwanted calls can range from marketing messages to suspected scams and repeated calls from unknown numbers. However, both iPhone and Android now offer built-in tools that can help users identify and block many of these calls without needing a third-party app. In this article, we will tell you how to stop spam calls on iPhone and Android in easy ways.
How to Stop Spam Calls on iPhone and Android – A Quick Guide
Mobile carriers may also provide their own spam protection services. These features can sometimes be enabled by default, while others may require users to turn them on through the carrier’s app or online account.
How to Stop Spam Calls on iPhone
iPhone users can access several options to reduce unwanted calls. Go to Settings > Apps > Phone and look for the call filtering settings.
The Spam option can automatically identify calls that your carrier considers spam or junk. When enabled, these calls will not ring your phone. Instead, they are sent directly to voicemail. You can still find them in the Phone app under the Spam section.
Apple also provides an Unknown Callers option that helps organize calls from numbers that are not saved in your contacts. This keeps your main call list cleaner and makes it easier to review calls from unfamiliar numbers.
Another useful feature is Screen Unknown Callers. iPhone users can choose from different options depending on how aggressively they want to filter calls. The Silence option sends calls from unknown numbers directly to voicemail without ringing the phone.
For users who do not want to silence every unknown caller, Ask Reason for Calling can be a better option. The iPhone asks the caller why they are calling and displays a live transcript of the response. Users can then decide whether they want to answer the call.
Call screening is available only in supported countries on iPhones running iOS 26 or later.
Users should also save important numbers in their contacts. This includes numbers belonging to doctors, workplaces, schools, delivery services or other organizations that may regularly call from numbers that are not immediately familiar.
How to Block Spam Calls on Android
Android phones also offer built-in tools for detecting and filtering unwanted calls. The exact options can vary depending on the phone manufacturer, Android version, and dialer app.
Google’s Phone app includes caller ID and spam detection. On supported devices, open the Phone app, tap the three-line menu, and go to Settings > Caller ID & spam under the Call Assist section.
Turn on See caller and spam ID to receive warnings when an incoming call may be spam. Users can also enable Filter spam calls to automatically silence calls that are identified as suspected spam.
Filtered calls can still be reviewed later through the Phone app, including missed calls and voicemails from unknown numbers.
Google’s spam protection features require a phone running Android 6.0 or newer, along with the latest version of Google’s Phone app set as the default dialer.
Call Screening on Supported Android Phones
Some Android devices also offer more advanced call-screening features. Google Pixel phones, for example, provide additional controls for screening unknown callers.
On a Pixel 6 or newer, users can open the Phone app and go to Settings > Spam and Call Screen > Call Screen to configure the feature.
Certain Samsung phones also offer call-screening tools. Users can open the Phone app, tap the three-dot menu, select Settings and look for Call screening.
These features can help users understand why an unknown person is calling before deciding whether to answer.
Use Your Carrier’s Spam Protection
Phone settings are not the only way to reduce spam calls. Many mobile carriers provide their own spam detection and blocking services. Depending on the carrier, the feature may already be active or may need to be enabled manually.
Users should check their carrier’s mobile app or online account for available spam protection settings.
While built-in tools can significantly reduce unwanted calls, no system can identify every spam call perfectly. Users should still be careful when answering calls from unknown numbers and avoid sharing sensitive personal or financial information over the phone.

items.author: Anjali Jain
items.content:
Wealthtech startup Zomint has raised ₹36 Cr (about $3.7 Mn) in a seed funding round from Lightspeed and Prime Venture Partners.
The startup plans to use the fresh capital to strengthen its technology and investment capabilities, expand its team of wealth and investment experts, and grow its content-led distribution across new formats and regional languages.
Founded in 2025 by Aman Mittal and Shavir Bansal, Zomint is a wealth management platform targeting working professionals and families building long-term wealth. It pairs customers with dedicated wealth experts, supported by investment research and AI tools.
Mittal, the startup’s CEO, previously held product leadership roles at Flipkart and Pine Labs. Bansal, its COO, also founded personal finance content platform Bekifaayati, which claims to have more than 50 Lakh subscribers.
Zomint allows customers to start with a monthly SIP of ₹25,000 or a lump sum investment of ₹5 Lakh, positioning its services beyond the high-net-worth individuals (HNIs) traditionally served by wealth managers.
The platform provides a dashboard to track investments, while its experts review portfolios and recommend actions based on customers’ goals and fund performance. Its technology brings together portfolio information, financial goals, past conversations, and investment research to flag issues and track agreed actions.
According to its website, Zomint operates as an AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor. Its listed offerings span equity, debt, hybrid, gold and silver, and global funds, including GIFT City funds. The startup said it plans to broaden its services beyond domestic mutual funds to address other investment and financial needs.
Zomint claims to have acquired its entire customer base organically, led by Bekifaayati’s presence on YouTube and Instagram, without spending on paid customer acquisition.
The startup said it has retained 97% of its clients since launch, while nearly one in three clients made additional investments through the platform within three months of their initial engagement. Each relationship manager currently serves more than 250 families, supported by investment specialists and AI tools, it added.
The fundraise comes amid investor interest in startups offering wealth management, investment research, and portfolio tools. The broader segment includes platforms such as Centricity, Novelty Wealth, Tijori, and StockGro, although their offerings and target customers differ.
Inc42 reported yesterday that IPO-bound StockGro has raised ₹110 Cr as part of its ongoing Series B round. This follows earlier tranches comprising ₹150 Cr from Param Capital founder Mukul Agarwal and $13 Mn from existing investor BITKRAFT Ventures.

items.author: Shrishti Bisht
items.content:
Hyderabad-based B2B edtech startup byteXL has raised $9 Mn (about ₹86.7 Cr) in a funding round led by Elevar Equity, with participation from existing investors Kalaari Capital and The Michael & Susan Dell Foundation.
The startup will use the capital to expand its college network, strengthen its technology and AI learning platform, build its academic and delivery teams, and introduce industry-aligned skilling programmes.
Over the next two years, byteXL plans to grow its network from 40 institutions to 120 and expand its reach from 2 Lakh students to 5 Lakh across 15 states. It also plans to strengthen its institutional partnership teams to support the expansion.
The latest investment follows its $5.9 Mn Series A round in July 2024, led by Kalaari Capital, with participation from the Dell Foundation.
Founded in 2019 by brothers Karun and Sricharan Tadepalli, byteXL works with engineering colleges, particularly in Tier II and III cities, to integrate industry-relevant technology and AI training into students’ regular coursework.
Its B2B model combines curriculum, hands-on learning, technology platforms, and trained educators within the college system. The startup said 7,600 of its graduates secured IT and engineering jobs last year.
byteXL operates in the broader skilling and employability segment alongside players such as Emversity, Seekho.ai, SmartBridge, iNurture, Board Infinity, and Imarticus Learning.
The fundraise comes amid a prolonged funding slowdown and consolidation in India’s edtech sector. According to Inc42’s ‘Indian Tech Startup Funding Report, Q3 2026’, the sector recorded three acquisitions during the quarter, including upGrad’s $200–210 Mn acquisition of Unacademy and Imarticus Learning’s $84 Mn acquisition of BELLS.
Meanwhile, IMARC estimates India’s edtech market to grow from $4.60 Bn in 2026 to $33.31 Bn by 2034, at a CAGR of 27.94% during 2026-2034
