items.author: Anjali Jain
items.content:
Ola Electric founder and CMD Bhavish Aggarwal has pledged a 4.32% stake in the electric two-wheeler maker to fund his participation in the company’s proposed rights issue of up to ₹1,000 Cr.
In an exchange filing yesterday, the company said the pledge was solely meant to finance Aggarwal’s subscription to the issue and that there were no other pledges outstanding on his securities.
“No shares are being sold. The promoter will invest alongside all other shareholders on the same terms,” Ola Electric said.
Citing the promoter’s disclosures under SAST regulations, PTI reported that the arrangement involves pledging 20 Cr shares in favour of CTL Trusteeship Limited to secure non-convertible debentures issued by Krutrim Data Centre Pvt Ltd.
The report described Krutrim Data Centre as a non-operative promoter group entity owned by Aggarwal, separate from Krutrim SI Designs, which operates the AI and cloud infrastructure businesses. The debenture proceeds will fund Aggarwal’s participation in Ola Electric’s rights issue, it added.
Ola Electric’s statement did not disclose the amount raised against the shares or the financing terms.
According to the draft letter of offer filed last week, Aggarwal held a 26.52% stake in Ola Electric as of June 30, 2026. The 20 Cr pledged shares represent about 16.3% of that holding.
The draft document said Aggarwal has committed to subscribing to his full rights entitlement, subject to provisions allowing him to renounce entitlements in favour of promoter group members or specified investors. He may also subscribe to additional shares or any portion left unsubscribed, subject to minimum public shareholding requirements.
The disclosure comes after Ola Electric’s board cleared the rights issue on September 28. The issue is part of a broader ₹1,500 Cr fundraising plan approved by the board on September 5. The company has not announced whether or how it will raise the remaining ₹500 Cr.
Ola Electric said it chose the rights issue route to enable participation by eligible retail, institutional, and promoter group shareholders.
Debt Repayment, Expansion Drive Fundraise
Of the proceeds, the company plans to deploy ₹350 Cr towards repaying or prepaying borrowings of Ola Electric and its material subsidiaries, including accrued interest and applicable prepayment penalties.
Another ₹400 Cr is earmarked for organic growth initiatives across its electric mobility and energy storage businesses, including manufacturing, R&D, stores, dealerships, service infrastructure, and sales and marketing.
The remaining net proceeds will go towards general corporate purposes. The company expects to deploy the funds during FY27 and FY28.
As the shares will be partly paid-up, shareholders will pay a portion on application and the balance through a subsequent call. The draft document envisages completing the first and final call by October 31, 2027, although the board can revise the schedule.
The proposed issue follows Ola Electric’s ₹780.2 Cr QIP in June. Of the ₹744.9 Cr net proceeds, it earmarked ₹225 Cr for debt repayment, ₹335 Cr for organic growth initiatives, and ₹184.9 Cr for general corporate purposes.
Fundraising Amid Falling Revenue, Market Share
The fundraising push comes amid continued pressure on Ola Electric’s business. Its consolidated operating revenue fell 45% to ₹455 Cr in Q1 FY27 from ₹828 Cr in the year-ago quarter, while net loss narrowed 21.5% to ₹336 Cr from ₹428 Cr.
For FY26, operating revenue halved to ₹2,253 Cr from ₹4,514 Cr in FY25, while E2W deliveries fell to 1.74 Lakh units from 3.59 Lakh units.
More recently, Ola Electric recorded 13,449 registrations in September, down 3.5% MoM, giving it around 6.5% of the E2W market, according to Vahan data as of October 1.
The company described FY26 as a “year of structural reset”, during which it rationalised its retail network, cut costs, strengthened service operations, and focused on improving unit economics.
It has since opened its first dealer-operated stores across seven states. Last month, it outlined plans to build a network of more than 500 dealerships over the following two quarters, with dealer partners handling local sales and service and company-owned outlets transitioning into product experience centres.
Beyond E2Ws, Ola Electric is expanding its battery cell manufacturing and battery energy storage businesses. It also launched the S1Z escooter range in August, powered by its internally developed Bharat Cell LFP technology.
At 13:20 IST, Ola Electric’s shares were trading at ₹36.76, down 0.89% from the previous day’s close.

items.author: Usama Anjum
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Pakistan Customs has uncovered an alleged Rs 3.2 billion WiFi router import scam involving two companies suspected of operating as fake or paper entities, prompting calls for a wider investigation into possible trade-based money laundering.
The case surfaced after Customs officials examined imports of 71,815 internet routers that were brought into the country without the mandatory certificates required by the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority.
Investigators identified 10 goods declarations covering the routers, which had been cleared through the Airport Facilitation Unit despite the absence of required PTA certification. The consignments were subsequently confiscated following adjudication.
The investigation widened when several individuals separately claimed ownership of portions of goods covered under the same declarations and sought their release. This prompted Customs to scrutinize the companies behind the imports in greater detail.
According to the investigation, both firms showed signs of having little genuine business presence. One company’s registered address was found to be a rice and flour shop, while the other was linked to a rented family residence.
One of the firms was also registered with the Federal Board of Revenue as a service provider and general order supplier, rather than as an importer.
Customs officials also flagged unusual activity linked to the companies’ WeBOC accounts. Their user IDs were reportedly accessed from 2,983 and 2,732 unique IP addresses, with 1,048 IP addresses shared by both firms.
Investigators said the access pattern suggested that multiple unidentified operators may have been using the companies’ tax and customs identities to conduct imports, misdeclare goods, violate import rules, and potentially move funds.
The financial capacity of the companies has also raised questions. Their combined declared capital reportedly stood at only Rs 2.2 million when the imports began, later reaching a maximum of about Rs 77.7 million.
According to Customs, even the higher figure appeared insufficient to support the scale of import activity recorded by the two firms.
The investigation also uncovered substantial valuation discrepancies. Customs increased the declared value of imported goods by around Rs 1.3 billion during assessment.
For the routers alone, the declared value was raised from Rs 97 million to Rs 565 million, which investigators cited as an indication of possible systematic under-invoicing.
The companies also recorded local sales of approximately Rs 2.9 billion, while reportedly paying minimal sales tax. Several buyers were either blacklisted, suspended, or inactive, while others were registered for businesses unrelated to the goods they purchased.
Further scrutiny showed the two firms shared 108 local buyers and 12 foreign suppliers. One overseas supplier accounted for around 61% of their combined imports, while their sales tax filings were also reportedly submitted within minutes of each other on several occasions.
Customs authorities believe the pattern may point to coordinated control behind the two entities.
The Collectorate of Customs Airport Karachi has recommended forming a Joint Investigation Team involving anti-money-laundering officials from Customs, Inland Revenue and potentially the Federal Investigation Agency.
The proposed investigation would examine possible violations of the Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010, including beneficial ownership, the source of funds, and whether international trade transactions were used to facilitate illicit financial transfers.
Customs has also recommended suspending or cancelling the companies’ WeBOC user IDs and referring the matter to RTO-II Karachi for further income tax and sales tax proceedings.
The case has brought renewed attention to the risks posed by shell companies, under-invoicing and misuse of import documentation in high-value telecom equipment trade.

Customs Revises Import Values for 70 Mobile Phone Accessories After Two-Year Gap

items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
Bermain game di laptop tidak hanya soal seberapa tinggi frame rate yang mampu dihasilkan. Pengalaman gaming juga dipengaruhi oleh banyak aspek lain, mulai dari layar, respons perangkat, sistem pendinginan, hingga fitur yang membantu pengguna mengatur performa. Kombinasi berbagai aspek tersebut yang pada akhirnya menentukan apakah sebuah laptop terasa nyaman digunakan untuk bermain dalam waktu lama.
Acer Nitro V15 menjadi salah satu laptop gaming yang mencoba menawarkan pengalaman tersebut. Perangkat ini menggabungkan hardware yang ditujukan untuk gaming dengan sejumlah fitur pendukung yang membantu menjaga pengalaman bermain tetap responsif. Pada konfigurasi tertentu, Nitro V15 ANV15-52 menggunakan prosesor Intel Core 7 240H dan GPU NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU dengan VRAM 6GB GDDR6.
Namun, pengalaman gaming yang ditawarkan Nitro V15 tidak hanya bergantung pada kombinasi CPU dan GPU. Acer juga membekali laptop ini dengan layar refresh rate tinggi, sistem pendinginan dual-fan, serta aplikasi NitroSense yang memungkinkan pengguna mengatur berbagai aspek performa. Kombinasi inilah yang membuat pengalaman bermain game pada Nitro V15 terasa lebih menyeluruh.
Baca Juga: Acer Nitro V15, Menawarkan Pengalaman Laptop Gaming yang All-Round
Performa yang Mendukung Berbagai Game
Bermain game sekelas Black myth: Wukong masih terasa mulus dan nyaman (Louis/Gizmologi)
Acer Nitro V15 dibekali NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU dengan VRAM 6GB GDDR6 pada salah satu konfigurasi yang tersedia. GPU ini juga sudah mendukung teknologi NVIDIA seperti DLSS dan Frame Generation, yang dapat membantu meningkatkan performa pada game yang kompatibel. Dengan dukungan tersebut, pengguna memiliki opsi untuk menyesuaikan pengaturan grafis sesuai kebutuhan permainan.
Di sisi prosesor, Nitro V15 ANV15-52 dapat menggunakan Intel Core 5 210H yang memiliki 8 core dan 12 thread. Kombinasi CPU dan GPU tersebut memberikan fondasi performa yang cukup untuk menjalankan berbagai jenis game, mulai dari judul kompetitif yang membutuhkan frame rate tinggi hingga game AAA dengan kebutuhan grafis yang lebih berat.
Kapasitas RAM dan penyimpanan juga ikut berpengaruh terhadap kenyamanan penggunaan. Nitro V15 mendukung RAM DDR5 hingga 32GB dan penyimpanan PCIe NVMe SSD, tergantung konfigurasi. Kapasitas tersebut memberikan ruang bagi pengguna untuk menjalankan game sekaligus melakukan aktivitas lain seperti membuka browser, Discord, atau aplikasi pendukung tanpa harus terlalu sering menutup aplikasi.
Layar 180Hz Bikin Gerakan Lebih Mulus
Penggunaan layar dengan 180Hz sudah cukup memberikan pengalaman kompetitif yang maksimal (Louis/Gizmologi)
Salah satu aspek yang langsung dirasakan ketika bermain game adalah layar. Pada konfigurasi tertentu, Acer Nitro V15 menggunakan panel 15,6 inci Full HD dengan refresh rate hingga 180Hz dan response time 3ms. Refresh rate tinggi membuat pergerakan objek di layar terlihat lebih mulus, terutama ketika memainkan game dengan tempo cepat.
Keuntungan tersebut tidak hanya terasa pada game kompetitif. Pergerakan kamera pada game action, racing, maupun shooter juga dapat terlihat lebih responsif ketika layar mampu menampilkan lebih banyak frame setiap detiknya. Bagi pengguna yang terbiasa dengan refresh rate tinggi, perbedaannya bahkan bisa terasa ketika melakukan aktivitas sederhana seperti scrolling halaman atau berpindah antar jendela.
Menariknya, konfigurasi layar tertentu pada Nitro V15 juga menawarkan cakupan warna hingga 100% sRGB. Artinya, layar tidak hanya diarahkan untuk mengejar refresh rate tinggi, tetapi juga dapat memberikan reproduksi warna yang lebih luas. Hal ini membuat Nitro V15 tetap relevan ketika digunakan untuk menikmati film, mengedit foto, atau melakukan aktivitas multimedia lainnya setelah sesi gaming selesai.
Sistem Pendinginan dan Fitur Gaming
Vapor Chamber yang berfungsi membuang udara panas guna memberikan suhu yang lebih optimal untuk Acer V15 (Louis/Gizmologi)
Performa tinggi tentu menghasilkan panas, sehingga sistem pendinginan menjadi bagian penting dari laptop gaming. Acer Nitro V15 menggunakan konfigurasi dual-fan dengan sistem intake dan exhaust yang dirancang untuk membantu menjaga suhu komponen ketika perangkat digunakan dalam beban berat. Sistem tersebut menjadi salah satu bagian yang mendukung penggunaan laptop untuk sesi gaming yang lebih panjang.
NitroSense yang berfungsi dalam memonitor kondisi laptop (Louis/Gizmologi)
Acer juga menyediakan aplikasi NitroSense yang memungkinkan pengguna memantau dan mengatur sejumlah aspek performa laptop. Melalui aplikasi ini, pengguna dapat menyesuaikan mode penggunaan dan memantau kondisi perangkat. Fleksibilitas tersebut membuat pengguna tidak harus selalu menggunakan konfigurasi performa yang sama untuk setiap aktivitas.
Pada akhirnya, kenyamanan bermain game tidak hanya ditentukan oleh angka performa. Acer Nitro V15 mencoba menggabungkan kemampuan hardware, layar refresh rate tinggi, sistem pendinginan, dan berbagai fitur pendukung dalam satu perangkat. Kombinasi tersebut membuat pengalaman gaming terasa lebih lengkap, sekaligus memberikan fleksibilitas bagi pengguna yang ingin menggunakan laptop untuk berbagai aktivitas di luar bermain game.
Dengan harga mulai dari Rp18.499.000 untuk era harga yang kian semakin nak, maka sudah bisa dikatakan bahwa laptop dengan GeForce RTX 4050 ini sudah cukup mumpuni untuk kegiatan bermain game, baik untuk bermain game kompetitif atau game AAA.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Realme is gearing up to launch the Realme Note 80 in Pakistan, with local teasers now appearing several months after the phone first debuted internationally.
The upcoming handset is being positioned around three key selling points: a 6,300mAh battery, a relatively slim 7.94mm body, and claimed 1.8-meter drop protection. Together, those features give the Note 80 a clear focus on battery endurance and durability in the budget segment.
Despite carrying a large battery, the device remains under 8mm thick. Realme has also equipped it with IP54-rated protection against dust and splashes, while the company says the phone has been tested to withstand drops from heights of up to 1.8 meters.
The 6,300mAh battery supports 15W wired charging and 6W reverse wired charging. Given the phone’s modest hardware, users with lighter usage patterns could potentially stretch a full charge well beyond a day.
Performance, however, is where the Note 80 keeps expectations modest. It is powered by the Unisoc T7250 chipset, an octa-core platform clocked at up to 1.8GHz, paired with 4GB of LPDDR4X RAM.
Storage is based on eMMC 5.1, which is slower than the UFS storage now appearing on some newer budget smartphones. While the international version has also been offered with 128GB storage, current local information points to a 4GB + 64GB configuration for Pakistan.
On the software side, the Realme Note 80 runs Android 15 with Realme UI 6. Realme has not yet confirmed how many major Android upgrades the phone will receive after launch.
The front of the device features a 6.74-inch HD+ display with a 90Hz refresh rate. Brightness peaks at around 563 nits, while the panel uses a conventional waterdrop-style notch for the selfie camera.
Photography hardware is basic, with an 8MP primary rear camera capable of recording 1080p video at 30 fps. A 5MP front-facing camera handles selfies and video calls, while biometric security is provided through a side-mounted fingerprint sensor.
In Thailand, the Realme Note 80 with 4GB RAM and 64GB storage was priced at 3,599 baht, equivalent to roughly Rs 32,000. If Realme follows a similar pricing strategy in Pakistan, the handset could land in the low-Rs 30,000 range, though official local pricing has not yet been announced.
With its 6,300 mAh battery, slim 7.94 mm profile, IP54 protection, and 1.8 m drop resistance, the Realme Note 80 appears aimed at buyers who value long battery life and everyday durability more than raw performance or camera capability.

items.author: Adesewa Olofinko
items.content:
Young Nigerians still face structural and financial barriers to contesting and winning elections
Originally published on Global Voices
A section of young delegates at the West Africa Youth Democracy Conference held in Dakar, Senegal. 8-10 September, 2026. Photo by Legis360. Used with permission.
This post is part of Global Voices’ September 2026 Spotlight series, “Protest in Democracy.” With this Spotlight, we seek to explore the many forms of protest, the tactics states use to delegitimize and suppress them, and the complex relationship between protest and democracy. You can support this coverage by donating here.
In 2018, young Nigerians won a fight that had taken years to organise. The Not Too Young To Run campaign helped push through a constitutional amendment lowering the age limits for several elective offices. Eight years on, the legal victory has not made politics much easier for them. Party nomination and expression-of-interest forms can cost as much as 100 million naira (USD 75,000). Earlier this year, one Nigerian state set the nomination fee for a local government chairmanship at NGN 30 million (USD 22,000), reportedly more than the office’s official earnings over a full four-year term.
At the legal ceiling, election campaign spending is now at an all-time high in Nigeria. In February 2026, President Bola Tinubu signed the Electoral Act 2026 into law, doubling the presidential spending limit from NGN 5 billion to 10 billion (about USD 7.5 million) and raising the governorship limit from NGN 1 billion to 3 billion (USD 2.2 million). These are no small numbers for a young candidate.
That gap between being allowed to run and being able to run hung over a conference room in Dakar from September 8 to 10. Convened by the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) Commission and Legis360, the West Africa Youth Democracy Conference brought delegates from 12 countries together to discuss the barriers to young people’s political participation in the region.
Nelson Asusiya, a young parliamentarian from Ghana, described a generation told to wait its turn while being used as poster children for political parties and civic movements, and rarely given actual power.
Yet, the people being asked to wait are the majority. Young people make up about 70 percent of the region’s population, according to the conference communiqué.
Nelson Asusiya, a young delegate from Ghana, speaking at the West Africa Youth Democracy Conference held in Dakar, Senegal. 8-10 September, 2026. Photo by Legis360. Used with permission.
Barriers to youth participation in West African politics
Across West Africa, young people remain largely absent from decision-making bodies despite their demographic weight. Political parties remain important gatekeepers, controlling who gets nominated, how candidates are selected and, in many cases, whose networks and resources can carry them through an election.
The Not Too Young To Run campaign in Nigeria showed what organised pressure can achieve. But it also exposed that changing the rules is not the same as changing who can afford to use them.
Cynthia Mbamalu, director of programmes at Yiaga Africa, which led the campaign, told the conference that while the amendment lowered the legal barrier, the political space remained more open on paper than in practice, with young aspirants still facing structural and financial barriers to contesting and winning.
Ezenwa Nwagwu, a Nigerian civil society leader, called the result a contradiction: Young people are old enough to vote and old enough to protest, but are often told they need experience before they can hold political office. He also rejected the idea that young Africans are impatient and drifting from democracy. Democracy, he argued, is measured not by its “dividends” of roads, hospitals and jobs, but by the freedom to question power.
Protests in West Africa
Across West Africa, protest has long been one of the ways citizens challenge political power. In 2012, Senegal’s Y’en a Marre movement mobilised young people against poor governance and President Abdoulaye Wade’s bid for a third term. In Burkina Faso, Le Balai Citoyen (“The Citizen’s Broom”) drew on young urban citizens to oppose Blaise Compaoré’s attempt to change presidential term limits. These movements showed how street politics could turn constitutional questions into issues people could see and feel in everyday life.
But protest has also met repression and contributed to distrust in formal institutions, as the #EndSARS protests in Nigeria showed.
An estimated 577 protests took place across West Africa in 2020 alone, according to a 2025 study of social movements in Africa. The frequency of such mobilisation points to a region where citizens, particularly young people, are repeatedly demanding a greater say in how they are governed.
But the region’s political institutions are themselves under strain. On January 29, 2025, Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger formally withdrew from ECOWAS, the regional bloc that convened the Dakar conference. The three countries, all under military rule, had formed the Alliance of Sahel States (AES) and established a confederation in 2024, deepening a political rupture that has reshaped West Africa’s regional order.
Director of political affairs, Dr Babatunde Afolabi, speaking at the close of the West Africa Youth Democracy Conference held in Dakar, Senegal. 8-10 September, 2026. Photo by Legis360. Used with permission.
For young West Africans, the withdrawal means millions of young people in Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger now live outside the regional bloc that convened the Dakar conference. Yet many of the questions discussed there: political participation, democratic governance and youth inclusion, remain relevant to them.
Speaking with Global Voices in Dakar, Babatunde Afolabi, director of political affairs at the ECOWAS Commission, said negotiations with the Sahel states are progressing cautiously. He said:
One of the benchmarks for measuring progress is the ability of the parties to engage. We’ve already started on that trajectory. It’s still early days.
He said a July summit in Freetown, Sierra Leone, called for the talks to expand to peace and security, because “we’re still the same people. Although the AES countries have left, we have a lot in common.”
But the most concrete measure he offered was a year away.
“One year from now,” Afolabi said, he wants the West Africa Youth Observer Network (WAYON), the conference’s main outcome, established, operating and partnered with ECOWAS. “That would be a good measure of progress,” he said.
Nigeria’s campaigners proved in 2018 that young people can rewrite the rules. The harder test, in Dakar and far beyond it, is whether anyone will rewrite the price.
For now, getting through the door can cost as much as NGN 100 million (USD 75,000).
Written by Adesewa Olofinko

items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
Kembalinya Formula 1 ke Sirkuit Internasional Sepang pada 2–4 Oktober 2026 setelah sembilan tahun absen menjadi momentum yang kembali menarik perhatian penggemar di Malaysia. Namun, antusiasme terhadap balapan juga dimanfaatkan pelaku penipuan online. Kaspersky menemukan sejumlah situs web palsu yang menyamar sebagai toko merchandise F1 dan menawarkan pakaian tim maupun memorabilia.
Situs-situs tersebut menggunakan identitas visual F1, foto pembalap dan tim, serta klaim sebagai toko merchandise resmi atau bersertifikat. Beberapa bahkan dibuat menyerupai toko online pada umumnya, lengkap dengan fitur pencarian produk, akun pengguna, keranjang belanja, hingga opsi pengiriman internasional.
Masalah utama muncul ketika calon pembeli masuk ke tahap checkout. Informasi pribadi dan data pembayaran yang dimasukkan ke situs palsu berpotensi jatuh ke tangan penipu. Dalam skenario lain, pembayaran bisa tetap dilakukan meski barang yang dipesan tidak pernah dikirim. Karena itu, tampilan profesional sebuah toko online belum cukup menjadi indikator bahwa situs tersebut benar-benar resmi.
Baca Juga: Micron Cetak Rekor 2026, Pendapatan Tahunan Tembus Rp2.388 triliun
Branding F1 Dimanfaatkan untuk Meyakinkan Korban
Menurut Kaspersky, penggunaan merek F1, pembalap, dan tim menjadi salah satu cara situs palsu membangun kepercayaan. Ketika penggemar menemukan merchandise tim atau pembalap favorit, rasa antusias dapat membuat mereka mengabaikan proses verifikasi sebelum melakukan transaksi.
Adrian Hia, Managing Director Kaspersky untuk wilayah Asia Pasifik, mengatakan momentum acara besar dapat membuat konsumen kurang teliti. Ia menilai penggemar sebaiknya memastikan identitas penjual terlebih dahulu, terutama sebelum memasukkan informasi pribadi atau melakukan pembayaran.
Risiko dalam skema seperti ini bukan hanya kehilangan uang. Data yang diberikan ketika melakukan transaksi juga dapat menjadi target, termasuk informasi pribadi dan pembayaran. Karena itu, konsumen sebaiknya tidak hanya melihat harga atau desain situs, tetapi juga memeriksa alamat URL, ejaan nama merek, serta status penjual atau mitra yang menawarkan merchandise tersebut.
Cara Menghindari Toko Merchandise Palsu
Kaspersky menyarankan penggemar memeriksa kembali keaslian toko sebelum membeli. Berbelanja melalui platform resmi atau pengecer yang sudah dikenal juga dapat mengurangi risiko penipuan pembayaran maupun pencurian data. Pengguna juga disarankan memakai solusi keamanan yang mampu mendeteksi halaman berbahaya dan upaya phishing.
Selain itu, aktivitas pembayaran perlu dipantau setelah transaksi dilakukan. Mengaktifkan notifikasi transaksi dan memeriksa mutasi rekening secara berkala dapat membantu pengguna mengetahui adanya transaksi yang tidak dikenal lebih cepat.
Kasus ini menunjukkan bahwa popularitas sebuah ajang olahraga dapat ikut dimanfaatkan untuk penipuan digital. Bagi penggemar F1, memastikan tempat membeli merchandise sama pentingnya dengan memastikan barang yang dibeli sesuai dengan yang diinginkan.

items.content:
Samsung Innovation Campus (SIC) Batch 8 mulai memasuki tahap awal pembelajaran dengan membekali 6.000 peserta terpilih kemampuan dasar pemrograman. Dari 14.806 pendaftar, peserta yang lolos mengikuti Stage 1: Code Kick-Start: Python Programming yang berlangsung pada 27 Agustus hingga 28 September 2026.
Tahap ini tidak hanya berfokus pada kemampuan menulis kode. Peserta diperkenalkan dengan konsep dasar pemrograman seperti variable, data types, operators, conditional statements, looping, functions, serta collections seperti lists dan dictionaries. Python digunakan sebagai bahasa pemrograman untuk membantu peserta memahami bagaimana konsep-konsep tersebut diterapkan dalam sebuah program.
Pendekatan tersebut menjadi dasar sebelum peserta melanjutkan ke materi yang lebih kompleks, yakni Internet of Things (IoT) dan Artificial Intelligence (AI). Selain pembelajaran bertahap, SIC juga menggunakan pendekatan project-based learning dan menyediakan technical mentoring untuk membantu peserta menghadapi tantangan ketika mempelajari coding.
Baca Juga: Galaxy Buds On Debut di Korea, Jadi TWS Open Ear Perdana Samsung
Coding Jadi Fondasi Sebelum Masuk IoT dan AI
Menurut Rahmat Fajri, AI Engineer dan SIC Trainer, pembelajaran coding tidak berhenti pada pemahaman syntax. Peserta juga diarahkan memahami kapan dan mengapa sebuah konsep digunakan, kemudian menerjemahkan permasalahan menjadi logic sebelum mengubahnya menjadi kode.
Proses tersebut berkaitan dengan kemampuan problem solving dan computational thinking. Peserta dilatih memecah permasalahan menjadi bagian yang lebih sederhana, mengenali pola, serta menyusun langkah penyelesaian secara terstruktur. Melalui proyek yang dikerjakan, berbagai konsep seperti variable, conditional, looping, dan function dapat diterapkan secara langsung.
Setelah Stage 1 selesai, peserta akan melalui proses seleksi untuk melanjutkan ke tahap berikutnya. Sebanyak 1.500 peserta akan masuk Stage 2: IoT – Device Hardware Discovery, kemudian 700 peserta melanjutkan ke Stage 3: AI Crafting sebelum memasuki Stage 4: Final Integration dan Final Judging.
Tak Hanya Peserta, Pengajar Juga Dibekali Teknologi
Program SIC juga mencakup pengembangan kemampuan tenaga pendidik. Samsung menyebut lebih dari 500 guru dan dosen telah mengikuti program tersebut untuk memperluas pemahaman mengenai keterampilan teknologi.
Keterlibatan pengajar menjadi bagian penting karena perkembangan teknologi juga membawa perubahan terhadap kebutuhan pembelajaran. Kemampuan seperti coding, computational thinking, serta pemahaman mengenai AI dan IoT semakin relevan untuk diperkenalkan dalam lingkungan pendidikan.
Samsung Innovation Campus Batch 8 pada akhirnya menempatkan coding sebagai titik awal sebelum peserta berhadapan dengan teknologi yang lebih kompleks. Dengan jumlah peserta yang menyusut di setiap tahap, program ini juga menggunakan proses seleksi untuk menentukan talenta yang dapat melanjutkan pembelajaran hingga tahap integrasi akhir.

Reports that the federal government has announced holidays on October 14, 15 and 16 are false. Sources say no new notification has been issued for those dates in October 2026.
The claim has been spreading on social media for days. The notification behind it is real, but it is two years old.

items.author: Rizwana Omer
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Reports that the federal government has announced holidays on October 14, 15 and 16 are false. Sources say no new notification has been issued for those dates in October 2026.
The claim has been spreading on social media for days. The notification behind it is real, but it is two years old.
Where the Viral Notice Came From
On October 14, 15 and 16, 2024, authorities in Islamabad and Rawalpindi announced a three-day holiday. The reason was a Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) meeting held in the twin cities.
The Cabinet Division’s website still carries a record of those 2024 holidays. That is likely the source of the confusion.
The dates are identical. Only the year has changed. A reader scrolling quickly can easily miss it.
What the Official Record Shows
The Cabinet Division’s current website lists the government’s official holidays for 2026. It contains no notification for October 14, 15 or 16, 2026.
That applies to the whole country and also to Islamabad and Rawalpindi on their own. No order announcing a three-day closure appears on the site.
Sources also confirmed that no fresh notification has been issued. Citizens, they said, are being misled by the older document.
Why the Rumour Spread So Easily
October 14, 15 and 16 this year fall on a Wednesday, Thursday and Friday. A holiday on those days would have joined the regular weekend and given many families a five-day break.
That makes the claim attractive. People want it to be true, and they share it before they check it.
An old government notification is also more convincing than a typical rumour. It has a letterhead, a reference number and official language. Those details make it feel authentic even when the date is wrong.
The Practical Cost of a Fake Holiday
False holiday news is not harmless. Parents may make travel plans or keep children home from school. Staff may skip work. Businesses and offices may face confusion.
Students are especially at risk. A missed class or exam because of a rumour is a real loss, and no one issues a correction afterwards.
How to Check a Holiday Announcement
The government’s advice is simple: rely only on fresh official announcements.
A few quick checks help:
Look at the year on the notification before sharing it
Search for the same notice on the Cabinet Division’s website
Check whether trusted news outlets are reporting it
Wait for confirmation from your school, university or employer
If a notification does not carry a verifiable 2026 date, treat it as unconfirmed.
Old Information Is the Cheapest Fake News
This case did not need a forged document or an edited screenshot. It needed only an old notice and a calendar that happened to match.
Fabricated claims can often be disproved by one search. Recycled genuine ones are harder, because the source is real, and only its timing is wrong. Social media platforms rarely flag them, and readers rarely look at the year.
Government offices could reduce the problem by publishing holiday announcements in one clear, easily searchable place and by responding quickly when a false notice spreads. Until then, the responsibility sits with readers. Before forwarding a holiday notice to a family group, check the date. It takes seconds and saves others from planning around a break that does not exist.

A new HomePod mini

Why the Event Detail Matters
items.author: Rizwana Omer
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Apple’s long-rumored smart home hub may finally get its moment on Tuesday, October 13. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman says the company is planning an event that day to show off the device, along with a new HomePod mini and a new Apple TV 4K.
Gurman first reported the three products and the date last week, as MacRumors noted at the time. In his Power On newsletter on October 4, he went a step further. He wrote that Apple is planning to hold an event on that day.
Apple has not announced anything. Until it sends invitations, the date and the lineup remain a report, not a fact.
What Gurman Says Is Coming
The report names three products:
An all-new smart home hub
A new HomePod mini
A new Apple TV 4K
Gurman’s reporting, as relayed in the material available so far, does not include prices, specifications or release dates. Anything beyond the three product names would be guesswork at this stage.
Why the Event Detail Matters
The earlier report said Apple was preparing to unveil these products on October 13. It did not say how. Apple often launches smaller devices through press releases, with no stage and no stream.
Gurman’s newsletter changes that picture. A planned event suggests Apple wants more attention for this group of products than a quiet web update would bring. That is a useful signal about how much weight the company puts on its home line-up.
A Category Apple Has Left Waiting
The home category has moved slowly at Apple. The original HomePod mini arrived in 2020. The current Apple TV 4K dates to 2022. Both have gone years without a hardware refresh.
The hub is the bigger question. Apple has been linked to a home display for a long time, and the product has been reported as delayed more than once. If it does appear on October 13, it will end a long wait.
That is why this event deserves a closer look than a routine accessory update. Three products in one day would amount to a reset of Apple’s living room and kitchen strategy.
Editorial Analysis: The Hub Is Really a Software Test
The most important question on October 13 is not what the hub looks like. It is how well it talks.
A home device lives or dies by its voice assistant. Rivals have spent years refining theirs. Apple’s hub will be judged less on its screen or speaker and more on whether Siri feels capable in daily use.
That makes the event an early test for Apple’s broader plans. If the demo is convincing, the hub could become a central piece of its home line. If it is not, the hardware will not rescue it.
There is also a caution for readers. Gurman has a strong track record on Apple’s plans, but a rumor is not a launch. Dates move, and products slip. The honest position this week is to expect an event, watch for Apple’s invitation, and keep any buying decisions until real prices and features are public.

items.content:

Sebelumnya, Bagus Hernawan, eks-MakeMac dan founder Appleisme ini mengunggah kapan iPhone 18 Pro series ini masuk ke Indonesia. Dalam cuitannya di X, ia menyebutkan iPhone 18 Series siap meluncur resmi di Indonesia pada 16 Oktober 2026.
Baca Juga: Hasil MPL ID S18 Week 7: TLID Kembali ke Puncak, RRQ Menang Derby Klasik
Selain duo iPhone 18 Pro dan iPhone 18 Pro Max, deretan perangkat Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, hingga AirPods 5 bakal ikut diluncurkan pada tanggal tersebut.
Berhubung jadwal preorder iPhone 18 Pro dan iPhone 18 Pro Max sudah dikonfirmasi, maka kabar yang sedang dinanti oleh banyak fans Apple di Tanah Air adalah harga resmi iPhone 18 Pro dan iPhone 18 Pro Max.
Preorder iPhone 18 Pro Indonesia, Bocoran Harganya?
Walau masih belum diungkap secara resmi oleh Apple dan reseller di Tanah Air, bocoran tentang harga ponsel baru Apple ini sudah beredar di internet sebelum preorder iPhone 18 Pro dan Pro Max dibuka
Bagus Hernawan sempat mengatakan, perkiraan harga awal perangkat Apple tersebut di Indonesia adalah sebagai berikut:
iPhone 18 Pro: mulai Rp 27.999.000
iPhone 18 Pro Max: mulai Rp 29.999.000
Perlu dicatat, angka tersebut belum merupakan harga resmi Apple Indonesia. Harga final, konfigurasi penyimpanan, serta ketersediaan setiap model masih menunggu pengumuman resmi Apple setelah fase preorder iPhone 18 Pro dan Pro Max ini dibuka.
Pendaftaran Minat Sebelum Preorder iPhone 18 Pro Dibuka
iPhone 18 Pro dan iPhone 18 Pro Max akan hadir di Indonesia, tetapi Apple belum mengumumkan tanggal penjualan. (Foto: Apple)
Tanda-tanda kehadiran flagship terbaru Apple secara resmi ke Tanah Air seperti sudah mulai mendapatkan titik terang. Pasalnya, sejumlah peritel resmi produk Apple mulai menampilkan gambar baik iPhone 18 Pro Series hingga iPhone Duo.
Termasuk iBox yang sudah membuka “daftar ketertarikan” sekaligus memberikan potongan khusus berupa voucher pembelian senilai hingga Rp1,5 juta.
Ya, iPhone 18 Pro Series memang sudah mulai dijual secara perdana setidaknya sejak pekan kemarin di sejumlah negara, termasuk China dan negara tetangga seperti Malaysia maupun Singapura.
Sayangnya, Gizmo friends memerlukan waktu lebih lama untuk dapat membelinya secara resmi. Meski nampaknya tidak membutuhkan waktu lama, dengan bocoran tanggal pemesanan yang disebut bakal berlangsung pada bulan Oktober ini.
Hadir dalam dua bentuk alias form factor berbeda, Apple memutuskan untuk hadirkan iPhone 18 Pro Series terlebih dahulu. Sementara iPhone Duo masih menyusul beberapa pekan kemudian, menjadi smartphone lipat pertama Apple yang memang sudah dinanti-nanti oleh para penggemar smartphone Apple. Siap bersaing dengan flagship lipat lainnya termasuk dari rilisan Samsung hingga HUAWEI.
iPhone 18 Pro dan iPhone Duo Lolos Postel Komdigi
Trio iPhone baru Apple, iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max dan iPhone Duo diketahui sudah mengantongi sertifikat Postel dari Kementerian dan Digital (Komdigi).
Dari data yang tim Gizmologi dapat, Minggu (20/9/2026), sertifikat untuk ketiga perangkat itu terbit pada 17 September. Ketiganya terdaftar atas nama PT Apple Indonesia.
Ada tiga model yang tercatat, mulai dari A3717 untuk iPhone 18 Pro, A3714 merupakan iPhone 18 Pro Max, dan A3720 untuk iPhone Duo. Sesuai dengan sertifikat TKDN Kemenperin, ketiga iPhone baru tersebut didaftarkan oleh PT Apple Indonesia dengan nilai TKDN 40 persen.
Dengan demikian, Apple telah melewati dua tahap penting untuk mempersiapkan iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, dan iPhone Duo untuk masuk pasar Indonesia. Meski begitu, Apple belum mengungkap secara resmi tanggal preorder iPhone 18 Pro series, kapan penjualan maupun harga ketiga ponsel tersebut di Indonesia.
iPhone Duo Bakal Jadi Lini Sendiri dari Apple
John Ternus, CEO Apple dengan iPhone Duo (Sumber: BBC)
Apple ternyata punya alasan tersendiri memilih nama iPhone Duo untuk perangkat foldable pertamanya. Sebelumnya, smartphone ini lebih sering disebut sebagai iPhone Ultra dalam berbagai rumor. Namun, menurut laporan Bloomberg, nama Duo dipilih bukan sekadar untuk membedakan perangkat tersebut dari lini iPhone lain, melainkan karena Apple disebut punya rencana memperluas keluarga foldable di masa depan.
Nama Duo dinilai lebih mudah dikembangkan menjadi beberapa varian. Laporan yang disampaikan Mark Gurman menyebut Apple sedang mempertimbangkan model seperti iPhone Duo Max dengan ukuran lebih besar, iPhone Duo mini yang lebih kecil, hingga iPhone Duo SE sebagai model yang lebih terjangkau. Strategi ini membuat nama Duo lebih fleksibel dibandingkan Ultra.
Selain itu, kata “Duo” juga cukup jelas menggambarkan karakter utama perangkat, yakni dua layar dalam satu bodi. Penamaan tersebut juga membuatnya konsisten dengan nama seperti Air dan Pro yang sama-sama singkat. Meski demikian, belum diketahui apakah Apple mempertimbangkan fakta bahwa Microsoft sebelumnya sudah menggunakan nama Surface Duo untuk perangkat dual-screen miliknya.

items.author: Rizwana Omer
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
A fake German woman on Instagram has led to the arrest of five suspects and a Rs18 million fraud case in Hazara. The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) says the group used false female identities to win people’s trust and then talked them into business investments.
Deputy Director Abdul Wahab of NCCIA’s Hazara Circle shared the details at a press conference in Abbottabad. He said Rs5.5 million has been recovered from the arrested suspects.
That is roughly 30 percent of the amount the main victim lost.
How the Instagram Fraud Worked
According to the agency, the suspects created Instagram profiles that appeared to belong to women. They contacted citizens through these accounts and built a conversation over time.
The next step was the pitch. Victims were encouraged to put money into what were described as business projects.
NCCIA identified one victim as Malik Haider Manzoor, a resident of Havelian. Officials say one suspect contacted him on Instagram and posed as a German woman. He was later persuaded to hand over Rs18 million for a supposed business investment.
A Wider Network Than Five Arrests
The investigation points to a larger operation. NCCIA says about 25 people from Abbottabad and Islamabad appear to be involved in the fraud.
Investigators have collected bank records and other evidence against the suspects. Officials say raids are continuing to arrest the remaining people named in the case, and further legal action against those in custody is under way.
The agency has not said how the money moved between accounts or whether the 25 suspects worked as one group or several. Those answers will likely come out as the case moves through the courts.
Why a Fake Foreign Identity Works
This case is a useful example of how online fraud has changed. The suspects did not need to hack anything. They needed a convincing story.
A foreign identity does several jobs at once. It makes a stranger’s friendly message feel exciting rather than suspicious. It explains why the person cannot meet in real life. And it makes a request for money, framed as a shared business opportunity, feel like a joint plan instead of a request.
This pattern is often called a romance or relationship-investment scam. The fraudster builds emotional trust first and brings up money later. By then, the victim sees a partner, not a stranger.
For readers, the warning signs are simple:
A stranger who becomes warm very quickly
Reasons why a video call or meeting is never possible
Any conversation that moves from friendship to money
Pressure to invest fast or to keep the deal private
The Scale of Cybercrime in Hazara
The numbers shared by NCCIA show how large the problem is. In 2026, the Hazara Circle has received nearly 5,000 complaints about different kinds of cybercrime.
Authorities have helped victims recover about Rs40 million across various cases. Put beside this case, the gap is clear. One victim alone lost Rs18 million, while the circle’s total recoveries across all cases stand at Rs40 million.
Recovery is possible, but it is slow and partial. Prevention is far cheaper than a court case.
What Citizens Can Do
NCCIA encourages people to report online fraud quickly. Speed matters because bank records and digital trails are easier to trace in the first days.
Victims should save chat screenshots, account details and payment receipts, and avoid deleting the conversation. A report can be filed with NCCIA directly.
Before sending money to anyone you met online, check the person’s identity through a channel you control. A live video call and an independent search of their business are a good start.
The Real Target Is Trust
The arrests are good news, and the Rs5.5 million recovery matters to the victim. But the larger lesson is about how these schemes work.
Pakistan has seen years of warnings about phishing links and fake apps. This case shows that the most effective tool may be a friendly conversation. A person who ignores a suspicious link may still respond to a warm message from a “foreign professional” with a business idea.
Scams like this also depend on shame. Many victims stay silent because they feel embarrassed about being fooled by a stranger online. That silence helps fraudsters. The fact that this case reached a press conference, with the victim named by the agency, may encourage others to come forward.

items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
Biwin memperkenalkan varian Black Opal DW100 DDR5-6000 CL28 berkapasitas 48 GB (24 GB × 2) yang telah mendapatkan sertifikasi untuk AMD EXPO Ultra Low Latency (ULL). Memori ini ditujukan untuk pengguna platform AMD yang menginginkan latensi lebih rendah tanpa harus melakukan penyetelan timing secara manual melalui BIOS.
Berbeda dari profil memori yang hanya berfokus pada frekuensi dan timing utama, EXPO ULL juga membawa pengaturan sub-timing yang telah disesuaikan. Pada DW100 DDR5-6000 CL28, pengaturan tersebut dirancang untuk mengoptimalkan latensi pada kecepatan memori yang sama. Pengguna dengan prosesor AMD, motherboard, dan BIOS yang kompatibel dapat mengaktifkan profil tersebut langsung melalui BIOS.
Pendekatan dari Biwin ini membuat konfigurasi memori lebih praktis bagi pengguna yang ingin mengejar performa tanpa masuk terlalu jauh ke pengaturan overclocking manual. Meski demikian, manfaatnya tetap bergantung pada kompatibilitas platform dan dukungan BIOS yang digunakan, sehingga tidak semua sistem AMD otomatis akan mendapatkan pengalaman yang sama.
Baca Juga: SK Hynix Dikabarkan Gandeng Intel untuk Produksi Chip Memori di AS
Fokus pada Latensi dan Platform AMD
AMD EXPO ULL pada dasarnya memperluas optimasi yang dapat dilakukan melalui profil memori. Selain frekuensi dan timing utama, konfigurasi sub-timing turut disesuaikan untuk membantu menekan latensi. Dalam kasus DW100, profil tersebut dipadukan dengan kecepatan DDR5-6000 dan timing CL28.
Biwin menyebut konfigurasi ini dapat memberikan akses memori yang lebih cepat dan respons sistem yang lebih baik pada platform AMD yang kompatibel. Namun, klaim tersebut tidak disertai angka peningkatan performa spesifik dalam materi yang diberikan, sehingga dampak nyatanya terhadap aplikasi atau game masih perlu dilihat melalui pengujian langsung.
Mengandalkan Komponen dan Pendinginan DW100
Dari sisi perangkat keras, modul ini menggunakan IC Hynix yang dipilih untuk kebutuhan DDR5 berperforma tinggi. Biwin juga membekali modul dengan PMIC yang tidak dikunci untuk mendukung kebutuhan overclocking memori tingkat lanjut. Namun, konfigurasi tersebut lebih relevan bagi pengguna yang memang ingin melakukan penyetelan manual di luar profil EXPO.
Sistem pendinginnya menggunakan desain heatsink tiga sirip yang diklaim membantu memperluas area pelepasan panas ketika memori bekerja dengan beban tinggi. Modul ini juga dilengkapi pencahayaan RGB yang dapat disesuaikan melalui software kontrol motherboard utama. Secara keseluruhan, DW100 DDR5-6000 CL28 48 GB menawarkan kombinasi kapasitas, frekuensi, dan timing yang cukup agresif, dengan EXPO ULL menjadi fitur utama bagi pengguna AMD yang ingin mengejar latensi tanpa konfigurasi manual yang rumit.

items.content:
Banking’s AI Investment Playbook
No longer content with buying AI tools, banks are moving to co-build and invest in AI startups. As partnerships deepen and automation reshapes banking jobs, are financial institutions rewriting the playbook for enterprise innovation?
Bankers’ Logic: Across the 50 largest global banks, investments in AI companies have grown at a 21% CAGR since 2023. But why? Financial workflows demand more than a standard software. Banks need systems adapted to their compliance requirements, risks and internal data. An investment or co-development arrangement gives them greater influence over product architecture and roadmap.
The Desi Model: Back home, financial institutions are actively backing domain-specific AI platforms. HDFC Bank and Canara Bank have invested in AI startup CoRover, while IDFC FIRST Bank’s partnership with Sarvam aims to develop a “self-improving bank” via frontier research and AI safety. Meanwhile, Bajaj Finance has set aside ₹1,500 Cr to back AI platforms.
Axis Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank are also collaborating directly with specialised voice AI startups to build niche operational workflows that are difficult to replicate in-house.
Win-Win For All: Banks bring more than capital. They offer access to proprietary data, large customer bases, operational feedback and regulated environments in which AI systems can be tested. For startups, these assets can accelerate product development while providing credibility that is difficult to establish through conventional enterprise sales.
The Human Layer: The AI transition within banks is also changing the workforce. Axis Bank reduced its workforce by 3,100 employees in FY26, while other lenders have linked AI-related investments to productivity improvements and slower headcount growth. Yet as AI handles more decisions and workflows, human accountability becomes more and more important.
As banks become investors, customers and co-developers, what does it mean for the domestic AI ecosystem? Let’s find out…
From The Editor’s Desk
Weekly Funding Rundown
Indian startups cumulatively managed to secure $233.6 Mn last week, up nearly 15% from $203 Mn raised in the preceding week. However, deal count declined 23.8% week-on-week to 16. Simple Energy emerged as the most funded startup last week.
Cleantech topped the funding charts last week and attracted $180 Mn across just one round. Ecommerce yet again led in deal activity, with four startups collectively raising a mere $3.8 Mn.
Early stage funding activity remained lukewarm as seed-stage and pre-seed startups raised $3.3 Mn across four deals. Alteria Capital emerged as the most active investor last week, backing three startups.
Kuku’s Profitable FY26
The OTT platform reported a profit of ₹182.7 Cr in FY26 against a loss of ₹152.6 Cr in the year ago fiscal. The profitability came on the back of a deferred tax credit of ₹98.2 Cr and operating revenue zooming 6X YoY to ₹1,484.2 Cr.
At the operating level, Kuku Technologies swung to an EBITDA profit of ₹82.9 Cr in FY26 from an EBITDA loss of ₹159.8 Cr in the year ago fiscal. Meanwhile, expenses continued to bite and surged 3.5X YoY to ₹1,421.8 Cr in the fiscal under review.
The profitable show comes as Kuku is gearing up to list on the bourses. The startup has already received SEBI nod for its likely ₹2,500 Cr IPO, which could potentially value it at ₹15,000 Cr. It has raised over $156 Mn to date.
Bearish Week For Startup Stocks
Of the 65 new-age tech stocks under Inc42’s coverage, 47 ended last week in the red and fell between 0.08% and 20.1%. The remaining 18 stocks gained between 0.17% and 22.55%.
Zappfresh and Aequs emerged as the biggest gainers last week, while Turtlemint and ESDS shed the most. The combined m-cap of 66 new-age tech stocks, including recently listed Moneyview, stood at $153.61 Bn at the end of the last week.
The subdued performance unfolded against a weak market backdrop, with FII selling and crude oil concerns weighing on sentiment. Investors will now be looking for RBI’s policy decision, PMI readings and Q2 FY27 earnings for market cues next week.
AceVector All Set For Listing
The Snapdeal parent is all set to list on the bourses today, bringing mixed gains for some of its early backers. SoftBank-backed Starfish is selling 2.76 Cr shares for about ₹88.3 Cr at a 0.08X return multiple.
Nexus Venture Partners will book an average 0.4X multiple on its sold shares. However, individual shareholders like Kenneth Glass and Laurent Bernard Amouyal are sitting on 5.42X and 4.3X gains, respectively.
AceVector’s ₹420 Cr public issue comprised a fresh issue worth ₹287 Cr and an OFS of up to 4.16 Cr shares. The issue values the company at about ₹1,741 Cr at the upper end of its ₹30-₹32 IPO price band. Its public issue was oversubscribed 4.93X.
Bitchat Goes Offline In India
Both Google Play Store and Apple App Store have taken down the decentralised messaging platform following a government directive. Apple said that the takedown order was issued under Section 69A of the IT Act over content deemed illegal in India.
Without specifying what content had triggered the takedown order, Apple further noted that beta-testing access via TestFlight has also been blocked. The app would, however, remain available on its App Store outside India.
Launched by Twitter founder Jack Dorsey in 2025, Bitchat is a messaging app that enables P2P communication through Bluetooth mesh networks without internet access. The app does not require users to make accounts and has no central identity system.
Inc42 Markets
Inc42 Startup Spotlight
Solving Labour Shortage Challenge For Indian Factories
Factories can lose hours of production if workers are absent or demand suddenly spikes. Yet finding skilled blue-collar staff at short notice remains difficult. Factrika is turning this gap into an on-demand workforce platform that matches verified workers with factory shifts in real time.
Staffing For Factories: Founded in 2024, Factrika helps manufacturers source, deploy and manage workers by skill, location and shift timing. It offers same-day staffing, absentee replacement, project-based hiring and full-time recruitment. The startup claims to have so far completed 65,000+ shifts and can deploy workers within two hours of a request.
Factrika’s Gig Strength: The startup maintains a pool of more than 10,000 workers across over 20 skill categories, sourced through partnerships with more than 5,000 polytechnic institutes. Besides sourcing, the platform also coordinates deployment, tracks attendance digitally and manages payments. It is building a verified work history for each worker.
Focusing On Key Clusters: Factrika currently operates across major factory clusters such as Bhiwadi, Bawal, Kharkhoda, Gurugram and Bahadurgarh. Its customers include the likes of Lenskart, Asahi India Glass and Jubilant FoodWorks. Going forward, it plans to expand its team, scale tech stack and expand its presence.
So, can Factrika make on-demand staffing reliable enough for India’s factories?
Infographic Of The Day
India runs on two parallel dating markets: swipe-to-date apps and a much bigger matrimony industry your parents actually trust. From Flutrr to Aisle, here are the apps nobody’s parents have heard of yet…

The auction will be conducted on the Reserve Bank of India Core Banking Solution (E-Kuber) system on October 06, 2026 (Tuesday). The Government Stock up to ten per cent of the notified amount of the sale of each stock will be allotted to eligible individuals and institutions, subject to a maximum limit of one per cent of its notified amount for a single bid per stock as per the 'Scheme for Non-competitive Bidding Facility'. Individual investors can also place bids as per the non-competitive scheme through the Retail Direct portal (https://rbiretaildirect.org.in).
Both competitive and non-competitive bids for the auction should be submitted in electronic format on the Reserve Bank of India Core Banking Solution (E-Kuber) system on October 06, 2026 (Tuesday). The competitive bids should be submitted between 10:30 A.M. and 11:30 A.M. and non-competitive bids should be submitted between 10:30 A.M. and 11:00 A.M.
In case of technical difficulties, Core Banking Operations Team may be contacted (email; Phone no: 022-69870466, 022-69870415).
For other auction related difficulties, IDMD Auction Team can be contacted (email; Phone no: 022-22702431, 022-22705125).
Only in the event of system failure, physical bids would be accepted. Such physical bids should be submitted to the Public Debt Office (email; Phone no: 022-22603456, 022-22603457, 022-22603190) in the prescribed form obtainable from RBI website (https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_ViewForms.aspx) before the auction timing ends.
The yield per cent per annum or the price as the case may be, expected by the bidder should be expressed up to two decimal points. An investor can submit more than one competitive bid at same/different rates of yield or prices in electronic format on the Reserve Bank of India Core Banking Solution (E-Kuber) system. However, the aggregate amount of bids submitted by a bidder should not exceed the notified amount for each State.
The Reserve Bank of India will determine the maximum yield / minimum price at which bids will be accepted. Stock will be issued for a minimum nominal amount of ₹10,000.00 and in multiples of ₹10,000.00 thereafter.
The results of the auction will be announced on October 06, 2026 (Tuesday) and payment by successful bidders will be made during banking hours on October 07, 2026 (Wednesday) at Mumbai and at respective Regional Offices of RBI.
The new State Government Stocks will bear interest at the rates determined by RBI at the auctions. For the new stock, interest will be paid half yearly on April 07 and October 07 of each year till maturity. For the re-issued Government Stock, interest will be paid at the rate as determined on the date of original issue of Government Stock and will be paid on half yearly basis till maturity. The Stocks will be governed by the provisions of the Government Securities Act, 2006 and the Government Securities Regulations, 2007.
The investment in State Government Stocks will be reckoned as an eligible investment in Government Securities by banks for the purpose of Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) under Section 24 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949. The stocks will qualify for the ready forward facility.

The Reserve Bank, vide Press Release dated July 14, 2026, had issued the draft "Reserve Bank of India (Acquisition and Holding of Shares or Voting Rights) Amendment Directions, 2026”, seeking comments / feedback from the regulated entities and members of public / other stakeholders on or before August 4, 2026. The draft Amendment Directions proposed to simplify approval process for subsequent acquisitions of major shareholding in a banking company by mutual funds, insurance companies and pension funds.
2. Feedback received on the above draft Amendment Directions has been examined and the consequent modifications have been suitably incorporated in the final Amendment Directions. A statement on the feedback received on the aforementioned draft Amendment Directions is provided in the Annex.
3. Accordingly, the Reserve Bank has today issued the following Amendment Directions, which shall come into immediate effect:
Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Acquisition and Holding of Shares or Voting Rights) Amendment Directions, 2026.
Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks – Acquisition and Holding of Shares or Voting Rights) Amendment Directions, 2026.
Reserve Bank of India (Payments Banks – Acquisition and Holding of Shares or Voting Rights) Amendment Directions, 2026.
Reserve Bank of India (Local Area Banks – Acquisition and Holding of Shares or Voting Rights) Amendment Directions, 2026.
(Brij Raj)          
Chief General Manager

items.title: Oil prices ease slightly as G7 and Middle East crude supplies set to hit market
items.summary: Oil prices saw a modest decline as fresh shipments from the Middle East hit the market. The G7's move to tap into emergency reserves reflects growing energy apprehensions. Nevertheless, the crude oil market stays turbulent, as conflicts in the Gulf region persist. Notably, Yemen's Saudi-backed government has initiated a military operation against the Houthis, further complicating the situation. This evolving landscape continues to impact global energy supplies and market pricing.

items.content:
MPL ID S18 Week 7 berakhir dengan perubahan besar=besaran di papan klasemen. Team Liquid ID (TLID) semakin memperkokoh posisi mereka di puncak setelah menundukkan Alter Ego 2-0.
Berkat kemenangan tersebut, TLID dipastikan menjadi tim esports MLBB pertama yang lolos ke babak playoff MPL ID S18 di Surabaya mendatang. Sementara itu, Onic berhasil naik ke peringkat kelima usai mengalahkan Navi dengan skor 2-1.
Baca Juga: Resmi di Indonesia, Harga Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Series Mulai Rp21,999 Juta dengan Bonus Hingga Rp6,3 Juta
Di tengah persaingan tersebut, zona menuju playoff juga semakin panas. Onic, Evos, dan Dewa United sama-sama mengoleksi lima match point sehingga satu kemenangan pada pekan depan berpotensi mengubah posisi mereka.
Satu kesalahan kecil bisa membuat ketiga tim semakin sulit untuk keluar dari zona merah, karena enam tim teratas berhak menuju playoff MPL ID S18.
Team Liquid ID Kuasai Puncak Klasemen MPL ID S18
TLID menutup Week 7 dengan kemenangan 2-0 saat berhadapan dengan Alter Ego pada Minggu, 4 Oktober 2026. Hasil ini membawa Team Liquid ID ke puncak dengan 10 match point dari rekor 10-3.
Kemenangan atas Alter Ego menjadi respons penting setelah TLID sebelumnya kalah 1-2 dari Dewa United pada awal Week 7. Dewa sempat membalikkan keadaan setelah kalah pada game pertama, sebelum mengunci dua game berikutnya untuk menang 2-1.
Week 5 MPL ID S18 dibuka dengan pertandingan EVOS vs Dewa United dan Geek Fam vs ONIC pada Jumat, 11 September 2026.
Dengan hasil tersebut, TLID tidak hanya bertahan di papan atas, tetapi juga memperlebar jarak menjadi satu match point dari Navi.
Navi Tetap Kuat, Tapi Gagal Tutup MPL ID S18 Week 7
Navi harus menerima kekalahan 1-2 dari Onic pada laga terakhir Week 7. Sebelum pertandingan itu, NAVI berada di posisi teratas, tetapi hasil seri tersebut membuat mereka turun ke peringkat kedua.
Navi sebenarnya memulai pertandingan dengan kemenangan pada game pertama dan mampu menyamakan skor setelah Onic bangkit di game kedua. Namun, tim berjuluk Raja Langit itu kembali unggul pada game penentu dan menutup seri dengan skor 2-1.
Onic Masuk Lima Besar Klasemen
Kemenangan atas Navi menjadi salah satu hasil paling penting bagi Onic pada Week 7. Tim berjuluk Landak Kuning tersebut kini berada di posisi kelima. Posisi itu menempatkan Onic tepat di atas Evos dan Dewa United sama-sama mengoleksi lima match point.
Perbedaannya ditentukan oleh rekor pertandingan dan selisih kemenangan game. Artinya, persaingan zona playoff belum aman bagi tiga tim tersebut. Evos berada di posisi keenam dengan rekor 5-6, sedangkan Dewa United menempati peringkat ketujuh.
BTR menjaga posisi empat besar
Bigetron by Vitality (BTR) menjadi salah satu tim yang menikmati Week 7 dengan dua kemenangan. BTR lebih dulu mengalahkan Geek Fam 2-1 dalam laga panas dan sengit, lalu menundukkan RRQ Hoshi dengan skor yang sama sehari kemudian.
Berbekal dua kemenangan tersebut, BTR bertahan di posisi keempat. Bagi BTR, konsistensi pada dua pekan terakhir akan menjadi penting untuk mempertahankan posisi di papan atas menjelang akhir Regular Season.
RRQ Menang Derby Klasik, Masih Ada Peluang
RRQ Hoshi juga mendapat hasil penting pada hari terakhir Week 7. Mereka menundukkan EVOS 2-1 dalam Derby Klasik setelah pertandingan berlangsung hingga game ketiga.
Kemenangan tersebut membuat RRQ naik ke posisi kedelapan. Mereka masih berada di zona merah dan di bawah Geek Fam yang juga memiliki tiga match point, tetapi mencatat rekor 3-10.
Jarak RRQ ke zona playoff memang masih cukup lebar. Namun, kemenangan atas Evos setidaknya menghentikan laju buruk dan memberi mereka modal untuk menghadapi sisa Regular Season.

items.title: Blockbuster Accenture show holds out hope for battered Indian IT
items.summary: Mumbai: Accenture surged more than a fifth Thursday - a record for the global technology services leader and rare for a company with more than $100 billion in market value. items.content: Mumbai: Accenture surged more than a fifth Thursday - a record for the global technology services leader and rare for a company with more than $100 billion in market value. It holds out hope for Indian IT - still the Nifty's third largest by weighting after financials and energy - and is a timely reminder to investors that they may have written the $315-billion industry's obituary rather prematurely.Yet, it would be equally premature to assume Accenture's standout FY26 performance and robust guidance for next year would trigger an immediate re-rating for India's listed outsourcing pureplay.134683373Investor enthusiasm for Infosys and Wipro American Depositary Receipts (ADRs), which climbed up to 8% on Oct 1, reflects scarcity premium rather than belief in an immediate sectoral turnaround, although some analysts believe the depressed valuations (table attached) adequately reflect the industry's AI-spawned revenue risks.Against this backdrop, Accenture's earnings at least helped re-establish the industry's commercial viability in the AI era.Read more: Will Nifty, Sensex plunge for 9th straight week? TCS Q2, RBI MPC among 4 factors to drive Dalal Street from MondayIts healthy book-to-bill ratio shows that tech services companies have regained the ability to translate promises (orders) into reality (sales). Those harnessing AI to make a strategic difference to their clients should see their addressable universe expand - not shrink. Accenture's last FY performance proved that even managed services engagements - or pure-play, cost-focused outsourcing, the mainstay of Indian IT - are becoming more value-loaded."Our managed services-led work also includes significant consulting and AI expertise, as many clients use this work to both reinvent and to get greater certainty around outcomes, including cost savings," Accenture CEO Julie Sweet told analysts in the conference call after the earnings. "Against this backdrop, two things stand out. First, our largest client relationships continue to expand as clients take on broader, more strategic transformations. The second standout is how our AI demand is broadening because of both the depth and breadth of our expertise."Read more: After Nifty’s longest losing streak in 25 years, what should investors do now?AI-Era ExpertiseThe key for Indian IT to extract a re-rating from analysts, following this year's 14% retreat in the Nifty IT index, is to help expand this 'depth and breadth of expertise' - something Accenture harnessed for 141 quarterly client bookings exceeding $100 million each. Separately, stable and improving margins close to 16% indicate moderation in pricing pressures, while a 6% revenue guidance - matching the highest in four years - suggests a modest revival in discretionary spending by clients."Accenture's results, commentary and guidance are slightly positive for Indian IT. Guidance of recovery in consulting business alludes to early signs of possible recovery in discretionary spends, though not in the immediate future," Nuvama said in a report. "We... maintain that Gen AI will eventually lead to expansion of TAM for Indian IT companies." Not long ago, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) trumped both Accenture and IBM in the market capitalization sweepstakes. So, re-establishing relevance in the AI era - with billions of dollars in idle cash on balance sheets - shouldn't be beyond the reach of top companies in a sector where India remains the unchallenged global leader.

items.author: Gargi Sarkar
items.content:
One of India’s earliest ecommerce marketplaces has finally trotted onto D-Street. After a relatively muted 4.93X subscription to its IPO, Snapdeal’s parent AceVector is all set to make its stock market debut on Monday.
AceVector’s ₹420 Cr IPO, which opened on September 25 and closed on September 29, comprised a fresh issue of ₹287 Cr and an offer for sale (OFS) of around ₹133 Cr, with shares priced in the ₹30-32 band.
The company’s IPO response is a far cry from its once-lofty standing in India’s ecommerce race. At its peak, the company was valued at $6.5 Bn, backed by heavyweight investors, including SoftBank Group, Alibaba Group and Foxconn.
Then, as Amazon poured billions into building its India business and Flipkart emerged as a formidable rival, the ecommerce battle grew increasingly intense. Snapdeal eventually stepped away from its ambition of competing across the broader market and shifted its focus to affordable fashion, home and beauty products, catering to shoppers in Tier II and Tier III India looking for low-priced goods rather than premium brands.
But is value commerce really working for it? Let’s find out in this edition of Inc42 Markets.
How AceVector Makes Money
Snapdeal is only one part of AceVector’s portfolio. The company has two other businesses: Unicommerce, an ecommerce enablement software business, and Stellaro Brands, its consumer-brands arm.
According to an expert tracking the consumer internet sector, Snapdeal has grown its net merchandise value and customer base of value-conscious shoppers, but its scale remains quite modest compared with larger ecommerce platforms, especially Meesho.
The expert added that Snapdeal may not be generating enough revenue per transaction to cover customer acquisition, technology and logistics costs.
Unlike an inventory-led retailer, Snapdeal operates an asset-light marketplace. Sellers own and list products, while Snapdeal facilitates discovery, transactions and associated services. It earns money through seller-related marketplace fees, advertising and marketing services, freight and collection fees, and charges for return shipments. This structure limits the need to purchase and hold inventory, but leaves the company dependent on transaction volumes, seller participation and the economics of fulfilling orders.
 
The marketplace revenue rose to ₹293.7 Cr in FY26 from ₹249.9 Cr in FY25. Net merchandise value (NMV), the value of delivered merchandise after excluding cancellations and returns, increased 25.7% to ₹1,093.1 Cr, from ₹869.6 Cr in FY25. In FY24, NMV stood at ₹633.3 Cr, even as marketplace revenue remained relatively flat between FY24 and FY25 before rising in FY26.
The gap between NMV and revenue is important. NMV measures the value of merchandise transacted on the platform; it is not the amount Snapdeal earns. In FY26, marketplace revenue was roughly 26.9% of NMV, down from 28.7% in FY25.
Meanwhile, marketplace marketing and business promotion expenses climbed to ₹84.4 Cr in FY26, from ₹63.2 Cr in FY25 and ₹58.5 Cr in FY24.
The company’s ecommerce enablement arm, Unicommerce, has emerged as a significant growth driver within the group. Its SaaS revenue rose 51.6% to ₹204.3 Cr in FY26 from ₹134.8 Cr in FY25, compared with Snapdeal’s marketplace revenue growth of 17.5% during the same period. The business provides order, inventory and warehouse management software through Uniware, alongside shipping and logistics automation through Shipway and marketing automation through Convertway. Its acquisition of Shipway Technology added to this portfolio, extending its services across more stages of the ecommerce lifecycle.
Meanwhile, AceVector’s consumer brands business, housed under Stellaro Brands, remains smaller but expansion-heavy. It operates Rangita, a women’s ethnic wear brand sold online and through an omnichannel retail network. Stellaro’s revenue from operations rose to ₹12.8 Cr in FY26 from ₹11.4 Cr in FY25.
What Does Snapdeal Offer Beyond Brand Recall?
Snapdeal has been in the game since 2010, one of the early players that helped open the floodgates to online shopping in India.
According to Karan Taurani, executive vice president at Elara Capital, Snapdeal has an edge in terms of brand recall. He said the company has remained relevant through multiple changes in its business model, from deal-led discounting to a broader marketplace and, more recently, a value-commerce platform.
“Its longevity gives it an established identity among consumers, but that alone may not be enough to sustain growth in a market where customer acquisition, transaction frequency and operational efficiency are increasingly important,” Taurani said.
He is of the view that Snapdeal’s focus on value-conscious shoppers does give it a clear customer segment to serve, but it also operates in a crowded market where affordability is not exclusive to one platform.
Meesho, which has built a much larger marketplace around value-conscious consumers, is a key example. In FY26, Snapdeal clocked an NMV of ₹1,093.1 Cr, while Meesho’s marketplace raked in ₹41,560 Cr. This is a staggering 38X scale gap.
The gap also extends beyond merchandise value to the number of customers and transactions each platform handles. Snapdeal reported 12.16 Mn annual transacting users and 25.98 Mn delivered units in FY26. Meesho reported 264.29 Mn annual transacting users and 1.71 Bn delivered units.
Therefore, Snapdeal’s central challenge is scale, even in its value segment.
Snapdeal Has AI Tools But Is There A Real Competitive Edge?
At a time when Meesho has an extensive technology stack, including AI-led tools, Snapdeal is trying to take steps in a similar direction. Snapdeal recently introduced a multi-solution AI suite aimed at making fashion discovery more personalised, visual and conversational for Indian shoppers. The suite brings together AI-powered recommendations, conversational search, image-based discovery and customer experience tools across the marketplace.
According to its RHP, 72.69% of orders in FY26 were placed without users entering a search term. The company attributes this to its recommendation engine and personalised product feeds, which use browsing history, product interactions and other data to tailor the shopping experience.
Overall, its tech stack supports processes such as seller onboarding, catalogue ingestion and fraud detection. AI-supported customer service is available through channels including calls, WhatsApp, IVR and in-app support.
Snapdeal may have added AI to the shopping cart, but that does not necessarily give it a competitive edge. Recommendation engines, conversational search and AI-powered support are increasingly becoming standard ecommerce features. For Snapdeal, AI is currently an ongoing bet. What it needs to solve immediately is the puzzle of scale.
MARKETS WATCH: NEW ISSUES, POST-IPO JOURNEY & MORE
TPG Sells ₹114 Cr Shadowfax Shares: The PE giant has sold another ₹113.6 Cr worth of Shadowfax shares through an open-market transaction, marking its third stake sale in the logistics company in as many months. The latest deal comes as Shadowfax’s stock has surged over 143% in six months.
StockGro Pre-Files IPO Papers: The Investment advisory startup has confidentially pre-filed its DRHP with SEBI for an IPO that could raise ₹2,000 Cr-₹2,500 Cr, including a potential ₹800 Cr fresh issue and an OFS by existing shareholders.
Moneyview Debuts At 64% Premium: The digital lender made a strong stock market debut, listing at ₹55.6 on the BSE and ₹55 on the NSE against its ₹34 issue price. The company’s market capitalisation stood at ₹9,789 Cr at listing.
IdeaForge Faces ₹109 Cr GST Demand: The drone maker has received a GST demand and penalty order totalling ₹109.2 Cr over alleged tax underpayment on drone sales between January 2022 and March 2024. The order includes a ₹54.6 Cr tax demand and an equal penalty.
