He alleged that some foreign-owned iron-smelting companies had been reducing the prices they paid for scrap metal, resulting in losses of between N3 million and N4 million on a single truckload.
According to him, the companies had failed to provide satisfactory explanations for the frequent price reductions, which he said were causing serious difficulties for scrap dealers across the country.
Soja also accused the companies of manipulating weighing scales, alleging that dealers who supplied one tonne, equivalent to 1,000 kilogrammes, could receive payment based on substantially lower weights.
He further alleged that some companies were producing substandard iron rods by manipulating the sizes and quantities of materials used in production.
He claimed that 12mm rods were sometimes produced as 10mm, alleging that such practices could have implications for the quality of construction materials and building safety.
Another grievance, he said, was what the association described as “extra dose”, which he alleged involved deductions of between one and five per cent from the weight of scrap supplied to the companies on the grounds of impurities.
Soja also accused some foreign companies of opening scrap collection points and dump sites in communities, saying the development was pushing indigenous scrap dealers out of business.
He said the association had repeatedly complained to relevant government departments and ministries but that its efforts had so far failed to resolve the issues.
“This is not just about us. These foreign companies are taking away our jobs. They are sending a lot of youths out of jobs,” he said.
He described the scrap industry as one of the country’s major employers of labour, particularly among young people, and called for government intervention to protect indigenous operators.
Soja said the association had already received an invitation from the Federal Government through the Executive Secretary of the National Steel Council, Ambassador Abdelkader Fadi, who listened to their grievances and received their complaints in writing.
He said the official assured the association that the matter would be presented to the relevant minister, adding that the dealers were awaiting the government’s response.
The NASWDEN leader said members across the country had complied with the strike directive, claiming that trucks carrying scrap metal had been parked in various locations.
He said the association was seeking government intervention to formalise the informal scrap industry and provide financial support that would enable indigenous operators to establish and expand their own businesses.
“We want the Federal Government to come in and formalise it. To collaborate with us, give lots of scrap traders intervention funds, so that indigenous people can also establish the kind of companies these foreigners are establishing,” he said.
He appealed to the government to intervene before the dispute escalated, saying the association’s demands were aimed at protecting jobs and ensuring greater participation of indigenous businesses in the steel and recycling industry.

items.content:
As Nigeria marks its 66th Independence Anniversary, Peter Obi, the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), has issued a sobering address demanding an immediate structural overhaul of the nation’s governance.
He warned that persistent leadership failures have pushed over 140 million Nigerians into severe hardship and abject poverty.
In an official Independence Day message released on Thursday, Obi declared that while October 1 should naturally serve as a moment of thanksgiving, unity, and gratitude for the country’s vast human and agricultural potential, the occasion must not be reduced to mere ceremonial festivities.
Instead, he described the anniversary as a crucial moment for deep, honest national reflection.
“Independence anniversaries must never be reduced to mere celebration. They are moments for honest national reflection. We must look back, examine where we stand today, and ask ourselves whether we are moving in the direction our founding fathers envisioned,” Obi stated.
Nigeria @66: Gov Aliyu Pays Tribute to Founding Fathers, Seeks More Collaboration to End Insecurity
Independence broadcast: Atiku Knocks Tinubu’s Prosperity Claim, Demands Relief For Nigerians
Critiquing the performance of the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) administration, the former Anambra State governor highlighted a catalog of systemic crises deteriorating across major sectors of the nation:
He said over 140 million citizens live in extreme poverty, with projections indicating more than 40 million Nigerians face acute starvation by the end of 2026.
According to him, out-of-school children have surged past 18 million, alongside an estimated 35 million unemployed or underemployed youths.
The NDC presidential candidate said drug abuse among Nigerian youth has reached 14%, more than double the global benchmark of 6%, adding that high infant and maternal mortality rates persist, while national life expectancy stands at 54 years—significantly trailing the global average of 74 years.
Obi noted that escalating terrorism, banditry, and mass abductions continue to jeopardize lives, citing a recent incident where 37 young Nigerians lost their lives.
Recalling his recent two-day joint visit to Sokoto State alongside Senator Rabiu Kwankwaso, Obi detailed the harrowing conditions they witnessed at the Ramin Kura Internally Displaced Persons (IDP) camp near Sokoto metropolis.
He described thousands of displaced women and children living without basic access to healthcare, clean water, or schooling—a situation he termed a microcosm of widespread displacement and insecurity across the country.
“What we saw in Ramin Kura is not an isolated story; it is a reflection of the suffering experienced across many parts of Nigeria. While ordinary Nigerians struggle with these realities, this present government often behaves as though these problems belong to another country. Political leaders have failed our country and, most importantly, we have failed our children,” Obi noted.
Rejecting the notion that Nigeria is naturally cursed, Obi argued that the nation’s core tragedy stems from leadership failures in converting abundant national wealth into productivity, human safety, and shared welfare.
Detailing a vision for a potential presidency, Obi committed to actionable reforms designed to shift Nigeria from a consumption-led model to a productive economy driven by agriculture, manufacturing, and human development.
He promised to eliminate terrorism and banditry so that farmers can safely return to their fields and displaced families can leave IDP camps.
Obi said as President, he would spend all official holidays within Nigerian states—including Zamfara, Borno, Kwara, Ebonyi, Edo, and Ekiti—to remain connected to the daily realities of citizens.
Obi concluded his statement with a call to action for the citizenry, emphasizing that real change demands sustained civic accountability and principled leadership.
“The Nigeria we desire will not be built by prayers alone, nor by promises alone,” Obi urged.
“It will be built by leadership that understands that public office is a sacred trust, by citizens who demand accountability, and by all of us who refuse to accept failure as our destiny.”

items.author: Our Correspondent
items.content:
Inflation in Pakistan slowed down to 10.3% in September but it remained higher than the official forecast due to increasing prices of electricity and fuel, which offset the positive impact of a significant slowdown in prices of food commodities.
According to the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics (PBS), the energy-group prices further increased compared to a year ago. This kept the overall annual inflation rate at 10.3%, which was slightly higher than the official projection of the Planning Commission.
The commission's assumption had been used to project a 7% to 8% average inflation during the current fiscal year despite the Middle East conflict. However, the monthly inflation marginally inched up to 1.3% due to a constant increase in fuel prices, which was the highest rate since April this year.
Pakistan on Tuesday informed the International Monetary Fund (IMF) that despite price pressure from the Middle East war, the inflation rate would remain below the official target of 8.2%. The government's assessment is based on the assumption that if the situation normalises until October 2026 and the average Brent crude price stabilises at $80 per barrel in the current fiscal year, the inflation will remain at 7.5%.
If the oil price remains at around $100 per barrel till December, the projected inflation may increase to 8.2% for the fiscal year. The government has set the inflation target for this fiscal year at 8.2% but it said that due to an anticipated moderation in global crude oil prices, improved agricultural output, exchange rate stability, effective administrative measures and a favourable base effect during the second half, the inflation is projected to stay within the 7% to 8% range, with the most likely outcome being around 7.5%.
Its assessment was that price pressures would remain elevated till December but thereafter, they were expected to moderate gradually over the course of the year, reflecting improving domestic supply conditions and a relatively favourable external outlook.
According to the PBS, the inflation went down both in urban and rural areas, standing in the range of 10.1% in urban areas and 10.5% in rural areas. Food inflation significantly slowed down from 12.1% to 8.1% in urban areas while it went down to 7.7% in rural areas. However, the energy group saw a northbound trend in both urban and rural areas. The pace accelerated to 11.5% in urban areas and 13.1% in rural areas.
During the ongoing review talks, the IMF has urged Pakistan to adjust both exchange rate and interest rate policies to tame inflation and keep the current account deficit under check. However, the federal and central bank authorities were of the view that the policies were appropriate in the given macroeconomic environment. Last month, the central bank kept its policy rate unchanged at 11.5% with a seven to three majority vote.
Core inflation, excluding food and energy prices, slowed down both in urban and rural areas, ranging from 8.1% to 8.6%, much below the policy rate. But the cost of housing, water, electricity, gas and fuel remained the main concern in addition to transportation charges, according to the official bulletin.
PBS reported that petrol price was 39% higher in September compared with a year ago. Within one month, there was an 11% increase in the price of petrol, which was a steep rise given the overall high price. The per-litre petrol was at Rs389.4 for Thursday and the price was Rs400 in case of high-speed diesel that was keeping transport charges high.
The cost of transport services went up by 30% last month over a year ago, according to the PBS. The data-collecting agency stated that electricity prices were higher by 33% in September over a year ago and within one month there was a 15% surge. The high cost of electricity is already driving consumers away from the national power grid.
Motor vehicle taxes jumped by 39% over a year ago, contributing to increase in expenses. PBS said that onion prices were 125% higher in September on a yearly basis, followed by a 41% increase in wheat prices.
Owing to serious management issues, the government is already in the process of importing 765,000 tonnes of wheat. Wheat flour prices were higher by 32% compared to a year ago. But prices of potatoes, chicken, eggs and sugar were lower in the range of 30% to 20% last month.

The SECP had achieved significant milestones over the past eight months and proposed amendments to laws aimed at facilitating businesses and developing the market. Proposed amendments to insurance and company laws were currently under consideration by parliament. Important amendments had also been proposed to regulations governing the non-banking financial sector.
He said the digitalisation of the regulatory system, simplification of legal compliance and improved market access were among the SECP's top priorities. The commission was ensuring compliance with regulations to promote transparency in the market and protect investors.
So far in 2026, Rs26 billion has been raised through 13 IPOs. Companies from the manufacturing, agriculture, real estate, energy and technology sectors have raised capital through the stock market.
Improved access to the market had resulted in a 36% increase in the number of investors. Since January, 168,000 new investors have joined the stock market, taking the total number of investors to 630,000.
Several long-standing issues faced by foreign investors, particularly Chinese investors, had been resolved. He said the SECP was working on an important initiative to increase the number of capital-market investors, while the company registration process had also been further simplified.

items.author: Usman Hanif
items.content:
Effective devolution of political, administrative and financial powers to the lowest appropriate tier of the government is essential for improving governance and achieving sustainable economic growth, speakers at a discussion said on Thursday.
Speaking at a session titled "Devolution: The Way Forward for Improving Governance in Sindh" organised by the IBA's Centre for Excellence in Journalism, panelists debated whether Pakistan's governance problems could be addressed through the creation of new provinces or by strengthening existing provincial and local governments.
Former federal finance minister Miftah Ismail said the creation of new provinces could not by itself guarantee better governance, arguing "the focus should instead be on empowering citizens and governments at the appropriate level." He said no country could develop and prosper without improving public living standards and education, while stressing that political and administrative reforms had to translate into better services for ordinary citizens.
Ismail argued that the devolution of responsibilities without corresponding financial powers would remain incomplete. He questioned the logic of National Finance Commission (NFC) arrangements if provinces themselves did not establish effective Provincial Finance Commissions (PFCs) to transfer resources to local governments. "Provinces will not do devolution as nobody leaves power," he said and added that new provinces would also provide no guarantee of better governance if elections were not fair and institutions were not functioning effectively.
Former federal secretary M Younus Dagha said administrative units needed greater authority and pointed to the historical link between stronger local governments and improvements in social indicators. He said "unfortunately" devolution had repeatedly advanced under military governments, while elected provincial governments had generally been reluctant to surrender authority to lower tiers.
Dagha highlighted the contrast between Karachi and other parts of Sindh, saying that areas on the right bank of the Indus continue to face flooding and administrative problems while provincial authorities remain heavily occupied with Karachi. If local governments were empowered, he argued, they would be able to respond directly to the problems of their own areas rather than waiting for decisions from provincial authorities.
He also raised the issue of Karachi's fiscal resources, claiming that changes involving the distribution of Octroi and Zila Tax (OZT) had deprived the city of substantial revenues. Research on Sindh's local-government finances has similarly identified OZT as historically one of the most important own-source revenues for municipal councils, particularly Karachi.
Dagha said all three tiers of the government - federal, provincial and local - should operate within clearly defined jurisdictions while maintaining institutional coordination. He further argued that provinces should be allowed greater control over the energy system to support local industries, but said the principle should extend across the distribution system so that electricity and other services could respond to local economic needs.
Economist Kaiser Bengali said Pakistan's decentralisation debate remained constrained by a "fear factor" among political actors and provinces. He said the 18th Constitutional Amendment and the 7th NFC Award were attempts to correct the imbalance of powers between the federation and provinces. The 7th NFC Award increased the provincial share in the divisible tax pool from 47.5% to 57.5% from 2011-12 and introduced criteria beyond population for distribution among provinces.
Bengali argued that the fiscal system should provide stronger incentives for provinces to improve living standards, education and revenue generation rather than relying predominantly on population-based transfers. He also stressed the principle of subsidiarity, under which each function should be performed by the relevant level of government capable of delivering it effectively.
IBA faculty member Dr Nausheen Wasi said the debate over creating new provinces was emerging from quarters that, in her view, were indifferent to the broader public interest. She argued that the fundamental question was whether the state wanted to serve citizens or concentrate power among a few actors. Wasi also linked the debate over administrative restructuring with wider international environment and discussions around mineral resources and corporate farming.

items.author: Our Correspondent
items.content:
Pakistan's total liquid foreign reserves stood at $26.8 billion as of September 25, 2026, according to data released by the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP).
During the week, the SBP's foreign reserves increased by $39 million to reach $21.4 billion. Meanwhile, the net foreign reserves held by commercial banks were recorded at $5.3 billion, contributing to the country's cumulative liquid reserves position.
Furthermore, the Pakistani rupee closed slightly higher at 277.10 against the US dollar, registering a marginal gain of Rs0.01 compared to the previous session's close at 277.11. Internationally, the greenback held near a two-month high, bolstered by rising US Treasury yields amid ongoing global inflation concerns linked to the Middle East conflict.
Meanwhile, gold prices in Pakistan fell on Thursday, tracking the impact of a recent decline in international bullion prices, with the precious metal losing Rs3,000 per tola during the day. According to rates shared by the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association, the gold price per tola settled at Rs438,636, compared with Rs441,636 on Wednesday.
The price of 10-gram gold declined by Rs2,572 to Rs376,059. On Wednesday, gold had gained Rs4,300 per tola in the local market. In the international market, spot gold was largely steady on Thursday as pressure from a stronger US dollar and elevated US Treasury yields was offset by softer-than-expected US inflation data, which reduced expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike in October. Spot gold edged up 0.1% to $4,159.11 per ounce by 11:17 am EDT (1517 GMT), while US gold futures for December delivery rose 0.1% to $4,189.30, as per Reuters. Despite Thursday's modest recovery, gold prices declined more than 6% in September. Meanwhile, silver prices in the local market fell Rs50 per tola to Rs6,528.
Gold has remained above the $4,000-an-ounce level despite elevated US Treasury yields. The resilience reflects continued demand for the precious metal, although its traditional relationship with rates and the US dollar has weakened in recent years.
Gold, which does not generate any yield, typically comes under pressure when real yields rise because higher-yielding assets become more attractive. Historically, the rates and movements in the US dollar were among the major factors influencing bullion prices.

Yang menarik, Philips tidak hanya menawarkan efek cahaya di belakang televisi. Sistem ini juga dapat diperluas ke sejumlah produk Philips Smart Lighting lain di dalam ruangan, sehingga pencahayaan dapat mengikuti konten yang sedang ditampilkan di layar.
Dedy Bagus Pramono, President Director Signify Commercial Indonesia, mengatakan pengalaman hiburan di rumah tidak hanya bergantung pada kualitas layar, tetapi juga suasana di sekitarnya. “Melalui Philips Smart Lighting, kami ingin menghadirkan solusi pencahayaan yang mudah digunakan dan dapat mengikuti berbagai aktivitas di rumah, mulai dari menonton film hingga bermain game,” ujar Dedy.
Philips Smart Lighting Screen Sync membaca warna dari layar secara real-time
Pada Philips Smart Lighting Screen Sync, sistem menggunakan Screen Sync Camera untuk menangkap warna dari area layar televisi. Informasi warna tersebut kemudian diteruskan ke RGBIC TV Backlight Strip yang dipasang di bagian belakang TV.
Backlight ini dapat mengikuti perubahan warna dan visual pada layar secara real-time sehingga cahaya di belakang televisi berubah mengikuti adegan yang sedang ditampilkan.
Konsep tersebut dapat digunakan untuk berbagai jenis konten, mulai dari film dan serial hingga konser dan game. Philips juga menyebut Screen Sync dapat digunakan dengan aplikasi smart TV maupun sumber video eksternal tanpa perlu mengubah koneksi hiburan yang sudah digunakan.
Dari sisi instalasi, Screen Sync Camera ditempatkan di bagian atas layar. Philips juga menyediakan fitur Instant Calibration untuk mempercepat proses kalibrasi antara kamera, layar, dan pencahayaan. Screen Sync tersedia dalam tiga pilihan ukuran untuk televisi 40–50 inci, 55–65 inci, serta 75–85 inci. Pengguna dapat mengatur pencahayaan melalui aplikasi, termasuk memilih preset dan tingkat kecerahan.
Salah satu penggunaannya adalah ketika menonton film. Perubahan warna dan adegan pada layar dapat diterjemahkan menjadi perubahan cahaya di belakang TV. Untuk gaming, efek pencahayaan dinamis membuat cahaya di sekitar layar turut berubah mengikuti visual permainan. Philips juga menyediakan Music Sync, sehingga pencahayaan dapat mengikuti irama musik. Fitur ini dapat digunakan ketika menikmati musik atau karaoke di rumah.
HDMI Sync cocok untuk gaming, menggunakan koneksi langsung ke perangkat hiburan
Pendekatan berbeda digunakan oleh Philips Smart Lighting HDMI Sync. Alih-alih membaca layar menggunakan kamera, sistem ini menggunakan HDMI Sync Box yang terhubung ke perangkat hiburan melalui HDMI.
Perangkat yang kompatibel mencakup set-top box, konsol game, dan perangkat hiburan lain yang menggunakan HDMI. Visual dari sumber tersebut kemudian digunakan untuk mengatur pencahayaan secara real-time. Philips menyediakan dua versi, yakni HDMI Sync 2.0 dan HDMI Sync 2.1.
Perbedaan yang menarik terdapat pada versi HDMI 2.1 yang mendukung refresh rate hingga 120Hz. Dukungan ini ditujukan untuk konten gaming dengan frame rate tinggi hingga 120 FPS, sehingga sistem pencahayaan dapat mengikuti konten dengan refresh rate yang lebih tinggi.
Dengan pendekatan tersebut, HDMI Sync lebih relevan bagi pengguna yang sumber kontennya berasal dari perangkat eksternal seperti konsol game atau set-top box. Sementara Screen Sync menawarkan pendekatan berbasis kamera yang dapat membaca konten langsung dari layar.
Tidak berhenti di backlight TV, Smart lighting mulai masuk ke ruang hiburan
Efek sinkronisasi pencahayaan juga dapat diperluas ke bagian lain di ruangan. Philips menyebut pengguna dapat menggabungkan TV Sync dengan produk Philips Smart Lighting lain seperti Gradient Floor Light, Squire, dan LED Strip.
Dengan konfigurasi tersebut, pencahayaan tidak hanya muncul di belakang televisi, tetapi dapat menyebar ke area lain dalam ruangan dan tetap mengikuti visual pada layar.
Pendekatan ini menunjukkan perubahan fungsi smart lighting dari sekadar mengatur warna atau tingkat kecerahan lampu menjadi bagian dari ekosistem hiburan rumah. TV, konsol, musik, dan pencahayaan dapat ditempatkan dalam satu pengalaman yang dikendalikan melalui sistem smart lighting.
Signify membawa Philips Smart Lighting TV Sync ke kategori Home Entertainment Lights. Perusahaan melihat pencahayaan sebagai salah satu elemen yang dapat melengkapi aktivitas hiburan di rumah, seiring penggunaan TV dan layanan streaming yang semakin menjadi bagian dari keseharian.
Dalam rilisnya, Signify mengutip data yang menyebut 62,7% penonton TV menghabiskan waktu menonton selama 6–7 hari dalam seminggu. Sementara berdasarkan PwC Global Entertainment & Media Outlook 2026–2030, penonton TV yang juga menggunakan layanan OTT pada 2025 umumnya menghabiskan 1–2 jam untuk menonton, dengan film dan serial menjadi dua jenis konten yang banyak dikonsumsi. Siaran Pers – Philips Smart Lig…
Dari sisi teknologi, perbedaan Screen Sync dan HDMI Sync juga memberikan pilihan berdasarkan konfigurasi perangkat pengguna. Screen Sync mengandalkan kamera sehingga lebih fleksibel terhadap sumber konten yang tampil di TV. Sebaliknya, HDMI Sync menggunakan koneksi langsung dari sumber HDMI melalui Sync Box.
Untuk pengguna yang memiliki konsol game dan ingin memanfaatkan refresh rate tinggi, HDMI Sync 2.1 menjadi opsi yang secara spesifikasi mendukung hingga 120Hz. Namun, manfaat refresh rate tersebut tetap bergantung pada kemampuan perangkat sumber, TV, dan konten yang digunakan.
Harga Philips Smart Lighting TV Sync, ada promo Smart Remote
Philips Smart Lighting juga memberikan penawaran Smart Remote gratis untuk setiap pembelian Philips Smart Lighting Screen Sync dalam ukuran apa pun selama periode promo hingga 30 Oktober 2026. Harganya sendiri mulai Rp1 jutaan, sesuai dengan ukuran layar.
Produk Philips Smart Lighting TV Sync dan lini smart lighting lainnya tersedia melalui kanal online seperti Tokopedia, Shopee, dan TikTok Shop, serta Philips Lighting Store. Dengan Screen Sync dan HDMI Sync, Philips pada dasarnya membawa konsep ambient lighting satu langkah lebih jauh: lampu tidak lagi hanya diatur berdasarkan preferensi pengguna, tetapi dapat merespons apa yang sedang terjadi di layar. Untuk ruang hiburan, perubahan ini membuat pencahayaan menjadi bagian dari ekosistem perangkat, terutama bagi pengguna yang ingin menggabungkan TV, gaming, musik, dan smart home dalam satu ruangan.

items.author: Michael Robuck
items.content:
US broadband vendor Inseego completed its deal to buy Nokia’s fixed wireless access (FWA) CPE business, in a move it expects will roughly double its revenue.
By adding indoor, outdoor and mmWave FWA technologies to its wireless broadband portfolio, Inseego stated it now has a global presence across consumer and business connectivity.
Its footprint for operators now includes Europe, the Middle East, Asia, Oceania and the Americas, while also expanding its engineering capabilities.
To support its global ambition, Inseego established an international headquarters in Amsterdam, a development centre in Athens, Greece, expanded its presence in Bangalore, India, and added customer-facing sales and technical resources across its new markets.
“We now have the scale, technology, and global reach to support carriers across business, residential, and mobile use cases,” Inseego CEO Juho Sarvikas said.
The deal, announced in April, grants Nokia approximately 1.9 million common shares, representing an 11% ownership stake in Inseego
The Finnish vendor also received warrants to purchase up to 800,000 shares of common stock, at an exercise price of $4.26 per share.
Nokia will also kick in a further $10 million cash payment by 15 October to support engineering work on interoperability between Inseego’s device operating system and cloud platform and certain Nokia technology ecosystems over the coming year.
Nokia will provide transition support and refer new FWA opportunities to Inseego.
About 250 people from the acquired business will support Inseego’s engineering, product management, supply chain, sourcing and customer support operations. They include employees joining Inseego and Nokia personnel providing support under a transition services agreement.

items.author: Press Release
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Hashoo Group’s Real Estate Division, in partnership with Al Rehman Group, has announced the launch of Grandeur by Hashoo, a high-standard, multi-purpose development in Bahria Town Phase 8, Rawalpindi.
Strategically located in the Business District near the Statue of Liberty, the landmark development is designed to bring together premium retail, hospitality, leisure, and lifestyle facilities under one roof, offering a comprehensive destination for residents, visitors, and investors from the twin cities.
The project comprises a 25-storey high-rise development, including three basement levels, a lower ground floor, a ground floor, and 20 upper floors, with a total covered area of approximately 554,270 square feet. The development will feature a seven-storey shopping mall, dedicated club facilities, and a 10-storey hotel apartment component.
The shopping mall will include a diverse range of retail outlets, a Fun City, and a food court, with the main entrance located on the ground floor. The club facilities will feature a cigar bar, shooting range, swimming pool, gymnasium, spa, and salon, offering residents and visitors a comprehensive leisure and wellness experience.
The official agreement signing ceremony was attended by Murtaza Hashwani, Deputy Chairman and CEO, Hashoo Group; Deputy Chairman NAB Sohail Nasir; Muhammad Yousaf, Chairman, Al Rehman Group; Shakir Bhura, CEO, Hashoo Group Real Estate Division; along with distinguished guests and business representatives from Islamabad and Rawalpindi.
Speaking at the ceremony, Shakir Bhura, CEO, Real Estate Division, Hashoo Group,
“Grandeur by Hashoo marks an important milestone in Hashoo Group’s real estate journey and reflects our commitment to creating developments founded on trust, quality and responsible execution. We recognise the expectations of customers who have invested in this project, and our focus is to work collaboratively with all stakeholders to ensure progress, transparency and delivery. Building on Hashoo Group’s legacy of service and excellence, we aim to transform Grandeur into a landmark destination that creates lasting value for its customers and the community.”
Deputy Chairman NAB Sohail Nasir said, “Today’s ceremony brings good news for the affectees and marks a significant step towards addressing their concerns. NAB played a constructive role in bringing the two major groups together, paving the way for the completion of the project. Once completed, the project will enable the affectees to benefit from its outcomes.
NAB is now a more facilitative and people-friendly institution. We have worked to remove the element of fear and focus on resolving issues through constructive engagement. I also appreciate my team for working tirelessly, day and night, to resolve major issues within a short period and facilitate the public and the business community.”
Muhammad Yousaf, Chairman, Al Rehman Group, said the project represents a significant addition to Bahria Town’s growing business and lifestyle ecosystem. “Grandeur by Hashoo has been envisioned as a landmark development that brings together retail, hospitality, leisure, and lifestyle facilities in a single destination. Our partnership with Hashoo Group combines strong expertise in real estate and hospitality and reflects our commitment to delivering quality developments that meet the evolving needs of investors, businesses, and communities.”
Grandeur by Hashoo is positioned to contribute to the continued growth of the twin cities’ real estate and commercial landscape by offering a combination of retail, hospitality, leisure, and lifestyle amenities within a strategically located development.

items.author: Bambang Dwi Atmoko
items.content:
Produk pendingin udara atau AC LG meraih empat penghargaan merek di Indonesia sepanjang 2026. Penghargaan tersebut mencakup Top Brand Award 2026, WOW Brand Award 2026, Brand Choice Award 2026, dan yang terbaru SuperBrand 2026.
Keempat penghargaan tersebut memiliki konteks dan aspek penilaian yang berbeda. LG menyebut pencapaian ini menjadi bagian dari evaluasi terhadap kinerja merek, inovasi produk, serta penerimaan konsumen di pasar Indonesia.
Penghargaan terbaru yang diterima adalah SuperBrand 2026. Dalam keterangan LG, penghargaan tersebut diberikan berdasarkan penilaian terhadap sejumlah aspek, termasuk kinerja, inovasi, dan penerimaan merek di pasar. Sebelumnya, AC LG telah menerima tiga penghargaan lain sepanjang tahun ini, yakni Top Brand Award, WOW Brand Award, dan Brand Choice Award 2026.
Empat Penghargaan untuk AC LG
LG mengaitkan penghargaan yang diterimanya dengan sejumlah aspek berbeda dalam hubungan antara merek dan konsumen. Untuk Top Brand Award 2026, LG menyebut penghargaan tersebut menggunakan hasil survei independen yang mengukur tingkat kesadaran merek, penggunaan, serta loyalitas konsumen di pasar Indonesia.
Sementara Brand Choice Award 2026 berkaitan dengan pilihan konsumen serta performa merek di kanal perdagangan digital dan marketplace. Adapun WOW Brand Award 2026 menilai aspek hubungan dan keterikatan antara merek dengan pelanggan, termasuk kualitas produk, layanan, komunikasi, dan pengalaman pelanggan secara keseluruhan.
Perbedaan tersebut membuat empat penghargaan ini tidak sepenuhnya mengukur hal yang sama. Ada yang berfokus pada persepsi dan penggunaan merek, sementara lainnya berkaitan dengan pilihan konsumen di kanal digital atau pengalaman pelanggan.
Joohoon Kim, Product Director AC ES LG Electronics Indonesia, mengatakan penghargaan tersebut menjadi refleksi terhadap persepsi konsumen terhadap AC LG. Menurutnya, LG berupaya menjawab kebutuhan konsumen melalui produk yang menawarkan kenyamanan, efisiensi energi, kualitas udara, dan kemudahan penggunaan.
LG Dorong Lini AC dengan AI
Momentum penghargaan tersebut datang bersamaan dengan pengembangan portofolio AC LG di Indonesia. Pada lini terbaru 2026, salah satu produk yang menjadi perhatian adalah DUALCOOL AI Air. Sesuai namanya, LG memasukkan teknologi AI untuk membantu menyesuaikan pengoperasian AC berdasarkan kondisi ruangan dan pola penggunaan.
AC tersebut dapat menyesuaikan suhu, kecepatan kipas, dan arah hembusan udara secara otomatis. LG juga membekalinya dengan sejumlah fitur seperti Window Detection, kW Manager, All Cleaning, dan Sleep Timer+. Konektivitas juga menjadi bagian dari lini ini. Melalui LG ThinQ, pengguna dapat mengontrol perangkat dari jarak jauh.
Pendekatan ini menunjukkan arah pengembangan AC yang tidak hanya berfokus pada kemampuan mendinginkan ruangan. Pengoperasian otomatis, pemantauan konsumsi energi, konektivitas, hingga perawatan perangkat mulai menjadi bagian dari pengalaman penggunaan AC.
Namun, materi LG tidak menjelaskan secara teknis model AI yang digunakan, jenis sensor yang menjadi sumber data, maupun bagaimana pola penggunaan pengguna diproses. Karena itu, fitur AI tersebut dalam artikel ini lebih tepat dipahami dari fungsi yang dijelaskan LG, bukan sebagai penilaian terhadap kemampuan AI-nya.
Selain DUALCOOL AI Air, LG juga memperkenalkan DUALCOOL New Terminator Inverter dan Turbocool New Terminator. DUALCOOL New Terminator Inverter mengandalkan Dual Inverter Compressor, serta dilengkapi Watt Control, Dual Swing Auto, dan Gold Fin. Pada varian premium NVB, tersedia pula Filter PM 2.5 dan konektivitas LG ThinQ.
Sementara itu, Turbocool New Terminator menyasar ruangan berukuran sekitar 6–18 meter persegi. Fitur yang ditawarkan antara lain Turbo Mode, Jet Cool, Dual Swing, Energy Save Mode, dan Fine Dust Filter. Ketiga lini tersebut menunjukkan bahwa LG tidak menempatkan teknologi AI sebagai satu-satunya pendekatan untuk seluruh konsumen. Ada lini yang menonjolkan otomatisasi dan konektivitas, sementara model lain mengedepankan teknologi inverter, pengaturan daya, atau pendinginan cepat.
Seluruh seri DUALCOOL dan TURBOCOOL NSB juga disebut mendapatkan dukungan garansi kompresor, suku cadang, dan PCB hingga 10 tahun, dengan ketentuan yang berlaku.
Produksi AC di Indonesia
Di balik pengembangan produk, LG juga menyoroti keberadaan fasilitas produksi AC di Cibitung, Jawa Barat yang dibangun melalui kemitraan strategis dan mulai beroperasi pada tahun sebelumnya.
Menurut LG, fasilitas tersebut memproduksi sejumlah perangkat AC terbaru yang dipasarkan di Indonesia, termasuk jajaran DUALCOOL Inverter New Terminator Series. Perusahaan menyebut fasilitas tersebut tidak hanya ditujukan untuk mendukung ketersediaan produk di pasar domestik, tetapi juga sebagai bagian dari kontribusi terhadap ekosistem manufaktur dalam negeri.
Kehadiran fasilitas produksi lokal menjadi konteks lain dalam strategi LG di pasar AC Indonesia. Artinya, pembahasan mengenai produk tidak berhenti pada peluncuran model baru, tetapi juga berkaitan dengan bagaimana produk tersebut diproduksi dan dipasok untuk pasar domestik.
Penghargaan Jadi Momentum, Bukan Tujuan Akhir
Bagi LG, empat penghargaan yang diterima sepanjang 2026 menjadi bagian dari evaluasi sekaligus momentum untuk melanjutkan pengembangan produk dan layanan. Ha Sang-chul, President of LG Electronics Indonesia, mengatakan penghargaan tersebut menjadi representasi komitmen perusahaan terhadap inovasi dan layanan bagi pengguna AC LG di Indonesia.
Namun, penghargaan merek sendiri tidak secara otomatis menunjukkan performa penjualan atau pangsa pasar AC LG. Materi yang diberikan juga tidak mencantumkan angka penjualan AC LG di Indonesia, pangsa pasar, pertumbuhan penjualan, maupun kontribusi masing-masing lini produk.
Karena itu, nilai utama dari empat penghargaan tersebut berada pada pengakuan dari masing-masing lembaga dengan metode dan aspek penilaian yang berbeda, bukan sebagai pengganti data pasar.
Di sisi produk, LG kini membawa pendekatan yang lebih luas melalui lini AC 2026, termasuk teknologi AI, konektivitas, pengaturan konsumsi daya, hingga fitur pengelolaan kualitas udara.
Diperluas dengan Program LG Loves Indonesia
Selain produk dan layanan, LG juga mengaitkan aktivitas bisnisnya dengan program keberlanjutan LG Loves Indonesia. Program tersebut memiliki empat pilar, yaitu LG Loves and Cares untuk bantuan kemanusiaan dan kepedulian sosial, LG Loves School untuk pendidikan dan pengembangan generasi muda, LG Loves Children yang berfokus pada dukungan terhadap anak-anak, serta LG Loves Green yang berkaitan dengan lingkungan.
Dengan demikian, empat penghargaan AC LG pada 2026 hadir di tengah strategi yang mencakup beberapa lapisan: pengembangan produk, layanan konsumen, produksi di dalam negeri, dan program sosial.
Untuk pasar AC yang semakin berkembang dan semakin terhubung dengan teknologi pintar, tantangan berikutnya bagi LG bukan sekadar mempertahankan pengakuan merek, tetapi bagaimana teknologi seperti AI, konektivitas, dan pengelolaan energi benar-benar diterjemahkan menjadi manfaat yang relevan dalam penggunaan sehari-hari.

items.author: Web Desk
items.content:
A federal grand jury in Florida has indicted a Pakistani national for allegedly operating a website that sold more than 5.1 million counterfeit United States postage labels, causing over $126m in losses to the US Postal Service (USPS).
The US Department of Justice said on Monday that Faheem Akram, 33, of Punjab's Khanewal district, operated LabelsBank.com, an online website that allegedly sold counterfeit US postage at a fixed rate — typically $2 per label — regardless of a package’s weight, size or destination.
LabelsBank.com was not authorised to sell USPS products and services, the department said.
Read: US charges 2 Pakistanis for alleged involvement in $10m health care scheme fraud
It added that the counterfeit labels allegedly allowed customers to ship packages at rates far below legitimate USPS prices, resulting in substantial lost revenue and shipping costs to the Postal Service.
“The alleged scheme was simple but massive: sell counterfeit postage online at fixed, cut-rate prices, as little as $2 per label, regardless of a package’s weight, size, or destination, enabling customers to avoid legitimate postal service charges,” US Attorney Jason A. Reding Quiñones for the Southern District of Florida said.
“The indictment alleges more than 5.1m counterfeit labels and more than $126m in losses,” he said, adding that the website had been shut down, its domain seized and federal charges brought against its alleged operator.
The department said the investigation found that more than 5,200 individuals used LabelsBank.com to purchase more than 5.1m counterfeit shipping labels, resulting in over $126m in alleged losses to USPS.
In conjunction with the indictment, USPS obtained a court order authorising the seizure and shutdown of the website, according to the department.
“Our reach goes beyond our borders,” Inspector in Charge Bladismir Rojo of the US Postal Inspection Service (USPIS) Miami Division said.
“Transnational criminal organisations defrauding the postal service and targeting US consumers by pushing phoney postage will be found and brought to justice,” he added.
Also Read: US launches online portal to report suspected visa fraud
Akram was charged with one count of conspiracy to defraud the US and to make and sell counterfeit postage stamps, five counts of making and selling counterfeit postage stamp labels and four counts of wire fraud, the department said.
If convicted, Akram faces a maximum penalty of five years in prison on the conspiracy and counterfeit postage counts and 20 years in prison on each wire fraud count, according to the department.
The USPIS Miami Division is investigating the case.

items.author: Gaurav Bagur
items.content:
Delhi NCR-based NBFC Seeds Fincap raised more than ₹100 Cr ($10.4 Mn) in a Series B funding round led by the Michael & Susan Dell Foundation, with participation from existing backers Z47 and Lok Capital, alongside Norinchukin Capital and Alteria Capital.
The company will use the fresh capital to scale its branch network, enhance risk-management systems, and expand into new markets.
“This capital will enable us to deepen our presence, strengthen our technology and people, and expand our ability to serve more entrepreneurs and underserved communities,” said cofounder Subhash Chandra Acharya, who serves as its MD and CEO.
Founded in 2021 by Acharya, Avishek Sarkar and Sumeet Dhall, Seeds Fincap provides credit products ranging from ₹50,000-1 Lakh to underserved individuals and micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises.
The startup utilises a proprietary, cash-flow-driven assessment approach to underwriting, supported by technology and field operations.
It claims to have been profitable in both FY25 and FY26 with total disbursements of approximately ₹620 Cr in FY26. According to the company, it has ₹722 Cr in assets under management (AUM) and is now targeting ₹1,000 Cr in AUM by March 2027.
Furthermore, the startup claims to have 164 branches with over 70,000 active members, as of August 2026.
Lending tech startups are expected to account for more than half of India’s fintech market, which is projected to grow to generate over $250 Bn in revenue by 2030, driven by rising credit adoption.
Furthermore, some of the more mature players in the space are finally hitting the public markets too.
In recent days, SEBI cleared the proposed IPO of Social Worth Technologies, the parent company of lending tech startup Fibe (formerly EarlySalary), while digital lending unicorn Moneyview completed its stock market debut. Earlier in the year, Kissht and Aye Finance also listed publicly.

items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
Setelah rumornya banyak bermunculan sejak beberapa pekan terakhir, akhirnya Samsung memperkenalkan TWS berjenis open ear perdananya, dan siap bersaing dengan kompetitor seperti HUAWEI hingga Sony. Melalui Samsung Galaxy Buds On, ditawarkan sebuah earphone nirkabel yang lebih ditujukan untuk menemani aktivitas sepanjang hari dengan nyaman, tanpa “menutup” suara luar saat sedang berada di luar ruangan.
Sebelum diresmikan, Samsung Galaxy Buds On sempat dirumorkan bakal hadir dalam nama Galaxy Able. Dan seperti yang sudah disebutkan sebelumnya, desainnya berbeda dengan semua varian Galaxy Buds yang sudah pernah dihadirkan. Tentu selain Galaxy Buds Live yang juga punya desain tergolong berbeda dibandingkan TWS kebanyakan, dirancang berbentuk kacang.
Kehadiran Samsung Galaxy Buds On bisa dibilang bersamaan dengan dirilisnya Galaxy Tab S12 Series, serta Galaxy SmartTag 3 yang akhirnya kompatibel dengan perangkat iOS. Hanya saja, tablet terbaru Samsung hadir untuk pasar global termasuk Indonesia, sementara Samsung Galaxy Buds On debut lebih dulu pada situs resmi Samsung Korea.
Baca Juga: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Series Andalkan Performa Produktivitas dengan Dua Opsi Layar Besar
Samsun Galaxy Buds On Gunakan Desain Open Ear
Dalam menghadirkan Samsung Galaxy Buds On, perusahaan telah melakukan analisa data dari banyak jenis atau bentuk telinga, dan melakukan simulasi demi menemukan desain yang pas baik untuk bagian speaker hingga komponen lain seperti baterai. Hal tersebut membuat desain Samsung Galaxy Buds On diklaim nyaman digunakan sepanjang hari, memberikan tekanan yang stabil pada permukaan telinga. Material perangkat juga dirancang lebih elastis agar tetap menempel meski pengguna beraktivitas sepanjang hari.
Untuk hadirkan kualitas audio lebih maksimal, Samsung Galaxy Buds On mengusung “TwinBoost speakers”, dirancang untuk meningkatkan performa driver perangkat untuk memberikan suara lebih maksimal pada frekuensi rendah. Samsung juga menghadirkan sebuah fitur agar volume perangkat bisa secara otomatis berubah menyesuaikan tingkat kebisingan di sekitar. Dan agar suara perangkat tidak terdengar oleh orang lain, pengguna Samsung Galaxy Buds On bisa mengaktifkan fitur Audio Leakage Reduction.
Kalau bagian speaker dirancang dengan bentuk membulat, bagian belakang perangkat dibuat dengan permukaan flat yang bukan tanpa alasan. Pada bagian tersebut, pengguna Samsung Galaxy Buds On bisa menyentuhnya untuk kendali perangkat, seperti mengangkat panggilan, hingga mengatur pemutaran musik. Dan untuk panggilan sura, masing-masing earbud memiliki tiga mikrofon, serta sensor voice pickup unit (VPU) khusus yang kemudian disempurnakan dengan machine learning.
Ditambah algoritma Clear Call yang juga hadir di seri Galaxy Buds lainnya, semua ditujukan agar kualitas panggilan bisa lebih jelas, meski berada di area yang ramai atau dengan hembusan angin cukup kencang. Selain lewat permukaan sentuh, pengguna Samsung Galaxy Buds on juga bisa memanfaatkan fitur gestur gerakan kepala untuk mengangkat panggilan, merespons alarm, hingga membaca notifikasi pesan.
Harga Samsung Galaxy Buds On Mencapai Hampir Rp4 Juta
Tanpa menyebutkan kapasitas daya secara gamblang, baterai Samsung Galaxy Buds On diklaim sanggup digunakan hingga 9,5 jam nonstop. Durasi yang cukup panjang tersebut, hadir dari optimalisasi konsumsi daya lewat amplifier Class-D khusus, yang dibawa lewat cip Snapdragon S7 Gen 1. Dan bila tersambung ke smartphone Samsung yang mendukung Galaxy AI, pengguna bisa memanfaatkan sejumlah fitur pintar.
Mulai dari mengaktifkan Gemini Live hanya dengan perintah suara, hingga akses fungsi Quick Voice Memo dengan menyentuh-dan-tahan permukaan belakang earphone. Potongan rekaman suara kemudian akan tersimpan secara otomatis, dan dapat diakses dengan mudah lewat asisten virtual milik Samsung, yakni Bixby.
Hadir dalam satu warna yakni hitam, harga Samsung Galaxy Buds On dibanderol 299,000 won, atau sekitar Rp3,9 jutaan. Perangkat satu ini baru akan mulai dijual pada 27 Oktober mendatang di Korea, dan siap menyusul ke pasar global, meski belum ada tanggal pastinya. Apakah Gizmo friends tertarik untuk mendapatkan TWS open ear pertama Samsung satu ini?

items.author: Web Desk
items.content:
The federal government on Thursday increased the price of petrol by Rs3.26 per litre, while decreasing the price of high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs1.01 per litre for October 2.
According to a notification issued by the Petroleum Division, the price of petrol was fixed at Rs390.66 per litre, while HSD would cost Rs399.34 per litre for Friday.
The latest revision comes a day after the government decreased the price of petrol and HSD by 14 paisas and Rs1.89 per litre, respectively, for October 1
Read: Govt decreases petrol by 14 paisas, diesel by Rs1.89 for Oct 1
On July 17, the government announced a new pricing mechanism under which petroleum product prices would be reviewed and notified daily, replacing the weekly pricing mechanism, as renewed tensions between the United States and Iran continued to drive volatility in global oil markets and raise concerns over fuel supplies.
On September 13, PM Shehbaz announced a special relief scheme offering Rs100 per litre off petrol for motorcycles, three-wheeler rickshaws and cars with engines up to 800cc, in an attempt to shield lower-income consumers from the impact of rising petroleum prices.
Under the proposal, an estimated 11.8 million beneficiaries would be covered. Around 10 million two-wheeler users and 800,000 three-wheeler users would be entitled to relief on 20 litres of fuel per month, translating into a maximum monthly benefit of Rs2,000 per beneficiary.
Another one million users of cars up to 800cc would receive relief on 30 litres per month, providing them with a maximum benefit of Rs3,000 each.
On Sept 17, the government reintroduced austerity and fuel conservation measures amid rising fuel prices, tightening business operating hours and restricting public events.
Under the measures, notified with immediate effect, shops, markets, shopping malls, bazaars, departmental stores, grocery stores, general stores and kiryana shops would close by 9pm throughout the week, according to a notification issued by the Cabinet Division.
Marriage halls, marquees and other commercial venues hosting festive events would close by 10pm, while restaurants, cafes, eateries, food outlets and standalone fruit and vegetable shops would be allowed to operate until 11pm. Takeaway and home delivery services would remain exempt from the timing restrictions.
Global geopolitical developments continue to pose significant risks. International oil prices are influenced by decisions taken by OPEC+, conflicts in the Middle East, sanctions on oil-producing nations, and disruptions in critical shipping routes such as the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea. Any interruption in these supply chains can immediately increase crude oil prices and freight costs. Since Pakistan imports the majority of its petroleum requirements, these developments quickly translate into higher domestic fuel prices.
Oil ‌prices jumped more than $3 on Thursday after China suspended oil products exports, potentially tightening fuel markets already coping with global supply shortages, and as there were few signs that diplomatic efforts to end the US-Israeli war on Iran were having an effect.
The new front-month December Brent crude futures contract traded at $101.20 per barrel at 12:47 pm EDT (1647 GMT), up 3.2%, or $3.17, from Wednesday's close. The November contract expired on ​Wednesday, settling at $103.50 per barrel, marking a monthly gain of around 14% in September for the front-month contract.
Chinese refiners have suspended exports of oil products to regions beyond Hong Kong and Macau until further notice, four people briefed on the matter said on Thursday, ​a move that will further crimp war-constrained fuel markets.
"The Chinese export ban suggests concerns about domestic product availability," UBS analyst Giovanni Staunovo said, adding that it remains to be seen ​whether the measures will support higher crude imports after recent drawdowns in Chinese crude and fuel stocks.

items.author: Anjali Jain
items.content:
ixigo backed e-intercity bus operator Fresh Bus reported a 2.4X jump in its FY26 operating revenue to ₹63.5 Cr from ₹26.3 Cr as it expanded its electric fleet and route network.
The startup’s top line grew on the back of a rapid expansion of its bus fleet and routes, founder and CEO Sudhakar Reddy Chirra told Inc42.
The expansion also led to the startup’s bottom line for the fiscal swelling 33% to ₹43.6 Cr from ₹32.8 Cr loss incurred in the previous fiscal.
The startup’s bottom line was weighed down by a sharp increase in expenditure over the fiscal. Its total expenses rose 81.4% YoY to ₹107.2 Cr from ₹59.1 Cr in the year-ago period.
The jump in expenses in FY26 was primarily linked to the expansion of the fleet, according to Chirra.
Lease costs rise with the number of buses, while maintenance, captain salaries, tolls and distribution expenses increase as operations scale, he said.
Fresh Bus’ Growth Plans
The startup is now targeting a revenue of ₹180 Cr in revenue in FY27, while reducing its loss to around ₹25 Cr-₹30 Cr, Chirra said.
Chirra claims that the startup became contribution-margin positive in March 2026, with a current contribution margin of 15%-17%, according to Chirra. He expects Fresh Bus to turn profitable around April-June 2027.
The startup is looking to improve its bottom line by reducing up to 30% of its costs by doubling down on larger bus fleets. This will benefit increasing fare rates as well customer stickiness, the founder believes.
Founded in 2019, Fresh Bus operates electric buses on intercity routes. It leases buses from fleet providers including Vertelo and Drivn and offers users a digital platform to search for and book tickets. The startup claims to have completed 25 Lakh journeys for 9 Lakh passengers.
At the end of the fiscal year, Fresh Bus operated 100 e-buses across 10 routes, primarily in South India. It intends to double this number to 200 by the end of FY27 and broaden its route options to 16.
Beyond FY27, Fresh Bus plans to reach 500 buses by March 2028, initially focusing on southern India before expanding westward and then into the north. It expects to reach 1,000 buses across the three regions by March 2029.
The startup currently operates at 85-90% occupancy, with around 1.6-1.7 Lakh seats offered each month, Chirra said. Established routes such as Bengaluru-Tirupati, Bengaluru-Chennai and Hyderabad-Vijayawada have repeat ratios of more than 55%.
Moving forth, the startup is planning to deepen its presence in southern India, with routes including Chennai-Madurai, Chennai-Tanjavur, Chennai-Trichy, Bengaluru-Trichy, Bengaluru-Madurai and Bengaluru-Tanjavur planned by March.
In August, Fresh Bus and ChargeZone expanded their partnership to support 400 additional electric buses, taking the fleet supported by ChargeZone’s charging network to 500 buses. ChargeZone will add 30 MW of charging capacity to the 10 MW already dedicated to Fresh Bus.
The expanded network is expected to connect 20 cities and 17 additional towns across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana over the next 15 months
Fresh Bus had last raised ₹87.5 Cr in Series A funding in August 2024, with participation from Maniv Mobility, Shell Ventures, Alteria Capital and Riverwalk Holdings. The company had said the capital would be used to add 150 electric buses and expand its route network.
In August 2026, ixigo agreed to sell a 17.39% stake in Fresh Bus to Twelve Stone LLP for ₹36.6 Cr. Moreover, it recognised a ₹11.22 Cr share of loss from Fresh Bus in FY26.

items.content:
The Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen's Houthis said on Thursday the militant group had attacked a power distribution station ​in Medina this week, putting one transformer out of service ‌but without affecting the electricity network.
The coalition said an investigation and examination of drone wreckage confirmed Houthi involvement in planning and carrying out Tuesday's attack. It said the ​station supplies electricity to the Prophet's Mosque.
Coalition spokesman Maj Gen Turki al-Maliki said the attack targeted the Taibah electricity distribution station at 5:11am local time on Tuesday.
pic.twitter.com/JQcdsgNr2W
— المتحدث الرسمي باسم قوات التحالف (@CJFCSpox) October 1, 2026
An operational review and examination of debris from the drone established Houthi involvement in planning and carrying out what he described as a "cowardly terrorist act", Al-Maliki said.
The attack knocked one transformer out of service but did not affect the electricity grid, he added.
Al-Maliki said the facility provides electricity to the Prophet's Mosque in Madinah.
Read More: Saudi crown prince says Makkah defence pact with Türkiye, Pakistan aims to bolster regional stability
A Houthi military source, quoted by the Houthi-run Saba news ⁠agency, denied the accusation, calling it a "lie" and saying it was intended ​to cover up what he described as Saudi Arabia's failure to substantiate ​its earlier accusation that the Houthis targeted Makkah.
pic.twitter.com/E547hZGsjC
— المتحدث الرسمي باسم قوات التحالف (@CJFCSpox) October 1, 2026
Saudi Arabia said two weeks ago it had intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone south of Makkah ​before it entered restricted airspace over the city. The coalition described that ​incident as the second Houthi attempt to target Makkah since 2017, while the Houthis ‌denied ⁠targeting Makkah or any other Islamic holy site.
The coalition said the Madinah attack was part of what it described as repeated Houthi attempts to target the Two Holy Mosques and "provoke" Muslims worldwide. It said it would continue ​taking measures to protect ​the holy sites ⁠and pilgrims.
The latest escalation is the most serious fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-aligned Houthis since a ​UN-brokered truce largely halted cross-border attacks in 2022. Hostilities ​resumed this ⁠year after the Houthis declared a naval blockade on Saudi Arabia in July and began attacking Saudi territory and shipping, while Houthi forces also made major ⁠territorial ​gains along Yemen's Red Sea coast.
Saudi Arabia has ​responded with airstrikes in Yemen and backed government forces fighting to push back the Houthis.

items.title: Spesifikasi POCO F9 Pro, Flagship POCO Siap Rilis Resmi 5 Oktober
items.summary:
Setelah debut perdana beberapa waktu lalu, tidak membutuhkan waktu lama bagi POCO Indonesia untuk hadirkan generasi terbaru dari lini smartphone andalannya. Ya, setelah F8 Series, giliran POCO F9 Series yang bakal membawa sejumlah peningkatan baru. Dan dibandingkan generasi sebelumnya, spesifikasi POCO F9 Pro membawa tampilan lebih mirip varian Ultra.
Ya, tahun ini POCO F9 Series bakal kembali hadir dalam dua opsi berbeda, yakni F9 Pro dan F9 Ultra. Betul, tidak ada varian POCO F9 standar—pada generasi sebelumnya, POCO sebutkan bila lini F Series hadir naik kelas. Sementara absennya POCO F8 standar, digantikan dengan ketersediaan POCO X8 Pro yang juga mengusung performa tinggi pada segmen yang sama.
Sebelum membahas spesifikasi POCO F9 Pro lebih jauh, desain POCO F9 Pro kali ini dibuat lebih menarik. Selain tampil dalam opsi warna lebih segar, pada modul kamera belakangnya juga punya aksen tambahan seolah mirip F9 Ultra, tidak lagi hanya memajang logo Bose saja sebagai rekanan kolabora
items.author: Prasetyo Herfianto
items.content:
Setelah debut perdana beberapa waktu lalu, tidak membutuhkan waktu lama bagi POCO Indonesia untuk hadirkan generasi terbaru dari lini smartphone andalannya. Ya, setelah F8 Series, giliran POCO F9 Series yang bakal membawa sejumlah peningkatan baru. Dan dibandingkan generasi sebelumnya, spesifikasi POCO F9 Pro membawa tampilan lebih mirip varian Ultra.
Ya, tahun ini POCO F9 Series bakal kembali hadir dalam dua opsi berbeda, yakni F9 Pro dan F9 Ultra. Betul, tidak ada varian POCO F9 standar—pada generasi sebelumnya, POCO sebutkan bila lini F Series hadir naik kelas. Sementara absennya POCO F8 standar, digantikan dengan ketersediaan POCO X8 Pro yang juga mengusung performa tinggi pada segmen yang sama.
Sebelum membahas spesifikasi POCO F9 Pro lebih jauh, desain POCO F9 Pro kali ini dibuat lebih menarik. Selain tampil dalam opsi warna lebih segar, pada modul kamera belakangnya juga punya aksen tambahan seolah mirip F9 Ultra, tidak lagi hanya memajang logo Bose saja sebagai rekanan kolaborasi demi meningkatkan kualitas audio pada smartphone.
Baca juga: Review POCO Pad C1: Tablet Rp2 Jutaan untuk Hiburan, Performa Hanya untuk Game Ringan
Layar Lebih Superior, Baterai Semakin Andal
Sedikit lebih lanjut mengenai desain, tampilan POCO F9 Pro secara keseluruhan masih tergolong mirip, dengan sisi permukaan flat, dan sisi samping serta modul kamera belakang menggunakan bahan metal. Selain opsi warna putih dan hitam, juga terdapat opsi warna Aurora Green yang bisa menyala di dalam gelap ketika terkena cahaya tertentu. Membawa sertifikasi IP68, dimensinya tetap dibuat kompak.
Tetap berukuran 6,59 inci, spesifikasi POCO F9 Pro pada sektor layar ditingkatkan dengan dukungan refresh rate hingga 185Hz (vs 120Hz pada generasi sebelumnya). Menggunakan panel AMOLED M11 terbaru, bisa meningkatkan masa pakai dan efisiensi daya. Sembari membawa tingkat kecerahan maksimum sampai 10.000 nits pada skenario tertentu.
Dan untuk menyeimbangkan aspek visualnya, spesifikasi POCO F9 Pro juga diperkuat setup speaker stereo yang dirancang memberikan volume simetris, baik dari sisi atas dan bawah perangkat. Sementara peran Bose adalah untuk memberikan profil output audio yang lebih maksimal, agar suara yang didengar sesuai dengan aslinya.
Meski dimensinya lebih kompak dibandingkan smartphone gaming atau smartphone dengan unggulan pada sektor performa, spesifikasi POCO F9 Pro pada bagian daya tergolong maksimal. Kapasitas baterai POCO F9 Pro sedikit meningkat, kini mencapai 6,330 mAh, berkat jenis baterai silicon-carbon dengan densitas energi lebih tinggi. Dukungan fast charging 100W memberikan daya 50% dalam waktu 19 menit saja. Plus, kini mendukung 50W wireless charging, cukup 35 menit untuk capai 50%. Juga bisa mengisi daya perangkat lain hingga 27W.
Spesifikasi POCO F9 Pro Tetap Andalkan Performa Cip Flagship
Beralih ke performa, spesifikasi POCO F9 Pro diperkuat cip Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V octa-core 3nm dengan clock speed CPU hingga 4,6GHz. Cip tersebut dipasangkan bersama cip VisionBoost D8 khusus, sebuah cip grafis dengan dukungan AI, yang bisa memberikan fitur seperti Game HDR, AI Super Resolution, hingga interpolasi framerate sampai 185fps.
Sistem pendingin POCO 3D IceLoop juga dihadirkan, dengan dimensi yang lebih lebar, diklaim bisa menurunkan suhu perangkat sampai 3°C. Sementara pada sisi software, HyperOS 3 pada POCO F9 Pro juga membawa WildBoost Engine, untuk memaksimalkan kinerja hardware demi gameplay lebih mulus dan stabil.
Meski lebih mengutamakan performa, spesifikasi POCO F9 Pro pada sektor kamera, juga ikut ditingkatkan. Sensor utamanya kini beresolusi 200MP f/1.68 dengan OIS, dipasangkan bersama sensor telefoto 50MP f/2.0 yang mendukung jarak fokus dekat 10cm serta focal length 60mm atau setara dengan 2,5x optical zoom (juga dengan OIS). Ditemani dua sensor lainnya yakni 8MP ultra-wide f/2.2, dan 32MP f/2.2 pada sisi depan. 
Harga POCO F9 Pro memang belum diumumkan, namun situs resmi POCO Indonesia telah mengumumkan sejumlah benefit penjualan perdana flagship teranyar satu ini. Mulai dari kesempatan mendapatkan voucher Rp50 ribu, gratis tiga bulan berlangganan YouTube Premium serta Google AI Pro dengan penyimpanan 5TB, gratis perbaikan layar 1 kali, dan tambahan perpanjangan garansi hingga 1 tahun. 
Artikel berjudul Spesifikasi POCO F9 Pro, Flagship POCO Siap Rilis Resmi 5 Oktober yang ditulis oleh Prasetyo Herfianto pertama kali tampil di Gizmologi.id
