items.author: News Desk
items.content:
Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump have agreed to build a “constructive China-US relationship of strategic stability” based on respect, fairness and reciprocity, according to a statement issued by China’s Embassy in Washington, DC.
The understanding was reached during Xi’s state visit to the United States from September 23 to 25, during which the two leaders held “in-depth discussions” on bilateral ties and major international and regional issues, the ministry said in a statement.
The two sides reached eight “deliverables and understandings”, it added.
China and the United States Reach Eight Deliverables and Understandings 🇨🇳🇺🇸https://t.co/qYOVo31tOM pic.twitter.com/QU2XPWX4f1
— Chinese Embassy in US (@ChineseEmbinUS) September 26, 2026
Under the first understanding, China and the US agreed to work towards a constructive relationship of strategic stability based on “respect, fairness and reciprocity”.
The two countries also agreed to support each other in hosting the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting and the G20 Summit. Xi and Trump intend to attend each other’s meetings, according to the statement.
On Iran, the two leaders agreed that Tehran should honour its commitment not to develop nuclear weapons. They also agreed that “no country or institution can be allowed to impose tolls on international waterways”, without elaborating on the specific waterways or arrangements involved.
The leaders also recalled that China and the US had been allies during World War II and fought together to defeat the Axis powers.
On trade, Xi and Trump recognised the “positive role” of the China-US economic and trade consultation mechanism and endorsed the outcomes of recent talks between their economic teams.
The outcomes include establishing and advancing a Board of Trade and other mechanisms, as well as an arrangement for a $30 billion reciprocal tariff reduction, the ministry said.
According to the statement, the two leaders also agreed to extend the outcomes of economic and trade consultations held in Kuala Lumpur and instructed their respective teams to implement the agreements.
The two sides also welcomed progress in counter-narcotics and law-enforcement cooperation. According to Beijing, Chinese and US agencies had jointly cracked several cases involving new psychoactive substances and precursor chemicals and arrested dozens of suspects in the two countries.
AI cooperation
China and the US further agreed to establish a China-US AI Dialogue to exchange views on the risks and benefits associated with artificial intelligence.
The next round of the dialogue is scheduled for November 2026, while the two countries will also establish a bilateral communication channel for AI-related incidents.
The announcement comes amid growing international efforts to develop mechanisms for managing the risks associated with increasingly advanced AI systems.
In a symbolic gesture, the United States also welcomed the arrival of two giant pandas leased by China to Zoo Atlanta.
Meanwhile, the Chinese and US militaries agreed to conclude a memorandum of understanding (MoU) on crisis communication and prevention “as soon as possible”.
China and the United States agreed to establish a channel for handling AI-related incidents and accelerate work on military crisis communications following a three-day summit between President Xi Jinping and President Trump in Washington, the two governments said Saturday.…
— CBS News (@CBSNews) September 26, 2026
The two militaries will also continue cooperation to search for the remains of US service members who went missing in China, according to the statement.
The ministry said the agreements and understandings were reached as Xi and Trump discussed the future of China-US relations as well as major international and regional issues during the Chinese president’s September 23-25 state visit.
A day earlier, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said that President Xi’s US state visit had led to new progress in a constructive China-US relationship of strategic stability, according to Xinhua news agency.
Read: Xi's visit boosts strategic stability in China-US ties, says FM
Wang, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, made the remarks while briefing reporters on Xi’s state visit to the United States from September 23 to 25.
President Xi and President Trump had a candid and in-depth exchange of views in a friendly atmosphere of mutual respect on strategic and overarching issues concerning China-US relations and the broader global landscape, Wang said.
President #XiJinping's state visit sets right path for China, US to get along, says Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi #ChinaUS
More: https://t.co/1PQuWk6JSO pic.twitter.com/GKUQr1UMvy
— CGTN (@CGTNOfficial) September 26, 2026
Since President Trump began his second term, the two heads of state have maintained close exchanges, including three in-person meetings and five phone talks, and fostered a pattern of interaction marked by mutual respect and sincerity, said Wang, noting this has become the most valuable strategic asset in China-US relations.
An important political outcome of the visit was that President Xi and President Trump further enriched the substance of the new positioning of China-US relations and have agreed to build a constructive China-US relationship of strategic stability based on respect, fairness and reciprocity, Wang said.
Respect means respecting each other's sovereignty and territorial integrity, respecting each country's choice of social system and development path, and respecting the other side's core interests and major concerns, Wang said.
Fairness, Wang continued, means pursuing mutually beneficial cooperation and handling differences through consultation, rejecting a zero-sum game in which one side's gain comes at the expense of the other's, and not seeking unilateral absolute advantage.
Reciprocity means that the two countries are equal in sovereignty, that neither side stands above the other, that neither engages in hegemonic nor bullying behaviour, that each side's concerns are addressed on an equal basis, and that cooperation across various fields develops in a balanced manner, Wang said.
Noting that President Xi has pointed out that a stable China-US economic and trade relationship requires both expanding the list of cooperation and shortening the list of problems, Wang said that the US side should treat Chinese companies fairly, resolve problems through dialogue and negotiations, and promote the sustained, stable and positive development of China-US economic and trade relations.
The fentanyl abuse problem in the United States is not caused by China, but China has always acted with the utmost goodwill and made every effort to assist the US side in addressing the fentanyl crisis, Wang noted, adding that the two heads of state tasked the law enforcement agencies of the two countries with continuing to strengthen cooperation and jointly combat transnational crime.
To promote people-to-people exchanges between China and the United States, President Xi has announced a series of new measures, including inviting 100,000 young Americans to visit China for exchange and study programs over the next five years, Wang said.
One piece of good news that has been particularly welcomed by the American public is that two pandas, Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, will soon arrive at Zoo Atlanta, Wang added.
The Zoo Atlanta will be getting two pandas from China.
During his state visit with President Trump on Thursday at the White House, Chinese President Xi Jinping said he is sending two giant pandas to the U.S.https://t.co/rYFan6yLsB pic.twitter.com/A9GZwoe2M4
— ABC News (@ABC) September 26, 2026
During the visit, Wang said, the two heads of state had an in-depth exchange of views on major international and regional issues of common concern and agreed to strengthen coordination to make due contributions to world peace and development.
President Xi also encouraged relevant parties to stay committed to peace, supported the United States and Iran in returning to the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding, resuming dialogue and negotiations at an early date, and ultimately reaching a comprehensive agreement covering the nuclear issue, Wang said.
During the visit, President Xi and President Trump also had an in-depth exchange of views on AI, pointing out that the two countries should leverage respective strengths rather than guard against each other, Wang said.
The two heads of state agreed to make good use of AI dialogue mechanisms between the two countries and jointly prevent the misuse and abuse of AI, Wang added.
Noting that this year marks the 80th anniversary of the opening of the Tokyo Trials, Wang said that China and the United States are both permanent members of the United Nations Security Council, and it is their shared responsibility to uphold the postwar international order and prevent the resurgence of militarism.
China and the United States will respectively host the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting and the G20 Leaders’ Summit in the fourth quarter of this year, Wang said, adding that the two heads of state confirmed their mutual support, which will continue to inject momentum into cooperation in the Asia-Pacific and global governance.
(With additional input from agencies)

British police arrested five men near a US air base on suspicion of explosive and terrorism offences on ​Sunday after a tip-off that three vans had been heading to the military airfield which has been used to strike Iran.
US President Donald Trump ‌said the suspects had been looking to do "big damage" and had been under investigation by British and US authorities.
British counter terrorism detectives leading the investigation said police had received a call about three suspicious vehicles which appeared to be travelling towards RAF Fairford in the west of England in the early hours of Sunday.
Five men were arrested by armed officers and later held on suspicion of preparing ​a terrorist act. Police said they believed the incident was now contained.

items.author: Reuters
items.content:
British police arrested five men near a US air base on suspicion of explosive and terrorism offences on ​Sunday after a tip-off that three vans had been heading to the military airfield which has been used to strike Iran.
US President Donald Trump ‌said the suspects had been looking to do "big damage" and had been under investigation by British and US authorities.
British counter terrorism detectives leading the investigation said police had received a call about three suspicious vehicles which appeared to be travelling towards RAF Fairford in the west of England in the early hours of Sunday.
Five men were arrested by armed officers and later held on suspicion of preparing ​a terrorist act. Police said they believed the incident was now contained.
Police working to understand circumstances
"We are in the early stages of an investigation, and five ​men remain in custody," Counter Terrorism Policing Senior National Coordinator Vicki Evans said in a statement.
Read More: Iran says it seized US sea drone in Strait of Hormuz
"As you would expect, we are working ⁠closely with our partners to understand the circumstances of the incident."
Police said a 400-metre cordon was in place around the base as the bomb disposal unit investigated the vans. ​Local residents in 85 homes in a nearby village were evacuated, and armed officers were patrolling the site.
The British government, which has given authorisation to the US to use ​bombers based at Fairford to strike Iranian missile sites that were attacking ships in the Strait of Hormuz, said Prime Minister Andy Burnham was being updated on the incident.
Burnham thanked the police and armed forces, saying on X: "I know today's incident near RAF Fairford will be deeply concerning for local residents and for many people following developments across the country".
I know today's incident near RAF Fairford will be deeply concerning for local residents and for many people following developments across the country.
My thanks go to Gloucestershire Police, Counter Terrorism Policing, our Armed Forces and all those working to keep the public…
— Andy Burnham (@andyburnham) September 27, 2026
Britain said in July its armed forces were ready ​to protect the country from any attack after Iran's Revolutionary Guards warned it not to allow US bombers to fly from Fairford, saying any base used to launch attacks ​would be a legitimate target.
Read More: Iran says it seized US sea drone in Strait of Hormuz
Police have not said who they believed was involved in Sunday's alleged incident. An Iranian-linked motive is considered the most likely, a source familiar with the investigation said, ‌while a ⁠Russian sabotage operation or an Islamist plot are also being looked at.
"The arrest in the UK was fantastic," Trump told reporters, saying it was "an amazing job".
"We had them under investigation. They were looking to do big damage to our port and working with the British worked out great ... We had them under view for a long time, and we got them," Trump added.
On Sunday morning the base was blocked by armed police while large machinery also prevented access and Reuters witnesses said security had been increased at other bases ​used by the US, with armoured vehicles ​and soldiers at the gates of RAF ⁠Lakenheath and RAF Mildenhall in eastern England.
Declaration of a major incident
"A cordon is in place as a precaution and the public can expect to see an emergency services presence in the area for some time," Gloucestershire Police Assistant Chief Constable Richard Ocone told reporters
The ​Daily Mail website carried a photograph of five men without shirts who it said had been arrested.
A spokesperson for the ​US Air Force declined to ⁠discuss specific force protection measures.
"The 501st Combat Support Wing and our fellow UK-based Wings remain vigilant and will take appropriate actions to ensure the safety and security of our US service members, civilians, contractors, and their families," the spokesperson said.
"We constantly assess a variety of factors that determine what measures we institute or modify to protect our installations, our people and their ⁠families."
British ministers ​have also previously briefed providers of critical infrastructure on the threat posed by Russia, with the government increasingly ​concerned about possible sabotage operations and cyberattacks.
Russia denies mounting hybrid attacks on Western nations.
A British military air base in central England was broken into in June 2025 by the Palestine Action protest group, which has since ​been proscribed as a terrorist organisation.

WhatsApp is working on a redesigned bottom navigation bar for its Android app. The new interface gives the navigation area a more modern look with a floating design and rounded corners.

WhatsApp Android App Set to Get a Redesigned Bottom Navigation Bar
The upcoming navigation bar separates itself from the main interface instead of appearing as a fixed part of the screen. It features rounded edges that make it look similar to the floating tab bar recently introduced on WhatsApp for iOS.
However, the Android version is not expected to completely copy the iOS design. While both versions use a floating layout and rounded corners, WhatsApp may use different visual elements on Android. In particular, the translucent appearance seen on iOS may not be included in the Android version.

WhatsApp Already Uses Bottom Navigation on Android
WhatsApp introduced its bottom navigation bar on Android several years ago. The change moved important sections such as Chats, Communities, Updates and Calls to the bottom of the screen.
The move was designed to make it easier for users to switch between different sections of the app. WhatsApp is now preparing another visual update to the same navigation system.
The latest redesign could make the Android interface feel cleaner while giving the navigation area more separation from the rest of the screen.
Design Could Change Before Release
Since the feature is still being developed, the current design may not be the final version. WhatsApp could make additional changes to the navigation bar before releasing it to beta testers.
The company has not revealed what other changes may be included or when the redesigned navigation bar will become available to the public.
WhatsApp Continues to Update Android Interface
The new navigation bar is part of WhatsApp’s broader effort to refresh the Android app. The company has recently worked on other customization features, including new chat themes and additional appearance options.
WhatsApp has also been experimenting with different design elements across Android and iOS. The latest navigation update suggests that the company is continuing to modernize the Android interface while keeping it separate from the design approach used on Apple’s platform.
When Will the New Design Arrive?
For now, the redesigned bottom navigation bar remains under development. It is not available to regular users or beta testers.
WhatsApp is expected to roll out the feature to selected beta users in a future update before a wider release. The company has not confirmed an official release date.

items.author: Guest Contributor
items.content:
#EndSARS became more than a protest against police brutality. It became an entry point into political consciousness.
Originally published on Global Voices
Protesters at the endSARS protest in Lagos, Nigeria. Image by Kaizenify via Wikimedia Commons. License: CC BY-SA 4.0.
This post by Cali-Dibang Nshua is part of Global Voices’ September 2026 Spotlight series, “Protest in Democracy.” With this Spotlight, we seek to explore the many forms of protest, the tactics states use to delegitimize and suppress them, and the complex relationship between protest and democracy. You can support this coverage by donating here.
In October 2020, thousands of young Nigerians took to the streets demanding an end to police brutality.
What began as a campaign against the Special Anti-Robbery Squad (SARS) quickly became something much bigger. Young Nigerians were not only demanding an end to police abuse; they were expressing years of frustration with unemployment, insecurity, poor governance, economic hardship, and exclusion from political decision-making.
For a generation that had often been described as politically disengaged, #EndSARS became a moment of awakening.
But six years later, its legacy is complicated.
The protests strengthened the political consciousness of some young Nigerians and encouraged greater participation in elections, governance, and activism. For others, the experience produced fear, distrust, and disillusionment. Some began looking beyond Nigeria for opportunities and a future they felt they could not build at home.
The same movement that told young Nigerians, “You need to participate,” may have left others thinking, “I need to leave.”
As Nigeria approaches another general election in 2027, the question is no longer simply what happened during #EndSARS. It is: What did #EndSARS leave behind?
The moment a generation found its voice
Before #EndSARS, Nigerian youth were often characterized by low participation in formal politics. Young people were encouraged to vote, but many remained distant from political parties and institutions. The protests disrupted this narrative.
Through social media and physical mobilization, young Nigerians demonstrated an ability to organize outside traditional political structures. They raised funds, coordinated medical assistance, shared information and created networks that extended beyond Nigeria.
The movement also demonstrated the political power of digital spaces. Social media allowed young people to document police abuses and communicate with one another without relying entirely on traditional media or political organizations.
For many participants, the experience changed their understanding of citizenship. They were no longer simply people watching Nigerian politics from the sidelines, but active participants.
In a 2025 study of 400 respondents, political scientist Solomon Temitope Omotayo examined the relationship between the EndSARS protests and youth political participation. His research found a statistically significant positive relationship between participation in the protests and subsequent political engagement. More than half of respondents reported increased engagement with elections and governance after the protests.
Omotayo’s findings suggest that, for many young Nigerians, #EndSARS became more than a protest against police brutality. It became an entry point into political consciousness.
A more recent study by Toyin Segun Onayinka, Omolola Oluwasola, and Obasanjo Joseph Oyedele takes this argument further. Their 2026 research examines EndSARS and the later “Obidient” movement as forms of mediated political activism.
The researchers found significant relationships between social media activism and young people’s intentions to vote and contest for political office.
Yet their findings contain an important contradiction: Greater political mobilization did not automatically translate into political power.
Greater political mobilization does not guarantee political change
The activism examined in the study did not alter the outcome of the 2023 presidential election. This distinction matters.
A movement can change how a generation understands politics even when it doesn’t immediately change who holds political power or how political institutions operate.
Furthermore, the violence surrounding the demonstrations, particularly the events at the 2020 Lekki Shooting, became a defining memory for many participants. Many young Nigerians believed that protesting was a legitimate way to demand change in a democracy. But their experience during the #EndSARS protest and after made them realize that using that democratic right could have serious consequences for them personally.
Research by Khadijah Sanusi Gumbi and Yahaya T. Baba found evidence of political trust deficits surrounding the #EndSARS protests, particularly around government accountability, transparency and police conduct. Olatunde Olayinka Ayinde, Oluwasemiloore Peace Atere, Ugonna Ibeawuchi, and their colleagues also found elevated levels of psychological distress, depression, anxiety and PTSD among protesters compared with non-protesters.
The same experience that pushed some young protesters deeper into politics left others questioning whether the political system could ever truly change.
For some, it became a reason to stay engaged through organizing, voting, or considering running for office.
Others became disillusioned. Disappointment, uncertainty, and frustration led some to step back from politics, while others began to consider a different response: leaving Nigeria altogether.
The result is a generation responding to the same defining moment in very different ways.
From protest to “Japa”
The years following #EndSARS also coincided with the growing prominence of “Japa,” a Yoruba expression meaning to run or flee that has become widely associated with leaving Nigeria, particularly among young people seeking better opportunities elsewhere.
It would be too simplistic to say that #EndSARS caused Nigerian youth to migrate.
Migration decisions are shaped by many factors: unemployment, inflation, insecurity, education, poor infrastructure, limited opportunities, and the desire for a better quality of life.
But the experience of #EndSARS can form part of the larger story of how some young Nigerians came to view their future.
Anthropologist Jing Jing Liu, in her research on the Japa phenomenon, interviewed Nigerian youths about their experiences of migration. Her work suggests that leaving Nigeria is not always understood simply as an economic calculation. For some people, migration is described in terms of escape and survival.
In her 2024 study, middle-class youth fleeing Nigeria: rethinking African survival migration through the Japa phenomenon, Liu interviewed 21 Nigerian youths aged 20 to 35 and examined the urgency surrounding their decisions to leave.
Her research shows that economic deterioration, prolonged uncertainty, and frustration with Nigeria’s trajectory can create a feeling that leaving is necessary rather than optional.
In another piece, “Japa, or to flee or to run: Nigerian youth and the urgency of departure,” Liu explores the meaning behind the language itself. The use of “Japa” captures something stronger than simply moving from one country to another. It can express an urgency to escape circumstances that young people feel they can no longer tolerate.
Other researchers, Faith Adeyanju, Bukola Alao, Oyedamade Opakunbi, and Toluwalase Ajibade , similarly examined “Japa” as a survival strategy. Their research identifies unemployment, insecurity, unfulfilled aspirations, and weak economic development among the factors pushing Nigerian youths toward migration.
These studies demonstrate why young Nigerians leave. They do not establish that #EndSARS directly caused their migration.
That relationship deserves further investigation through the stories of the people themselves.
Perhaps the most fascinating legacy of #EndSARS is that young Nigerians did not respond to the experience in the same way.
One young person may have emerged from the protests thinking: “I have to become more involved in politics.”
Another may have concluded: “I cannot build my future here.”
And some did both: leaving Nigeria while continuing to engage with its politics from abroad. This complicates the idea that migration necessarily means political disengagement. A Nigerian can leave the country without leaving the conversation.
Six years on, #EndSARS remains more than a protest remembered for what happened in 2020. It changed how many young Nigerians understood citizenship, collective action and their relationship with power. While it did not resolve the problems that brought people to the streets, it left behind a generation more willing to question, organize, and demand accountability.
Written by Guest Contributor

President Asif Ali Zardari has called for the responsible and ethical use of artificial intelligence (AI) and emerging technologies to support the tourism sector in Pakistan and create new opportunities for local communities.
In his message on World Tourism Day 2026, President Zardari said Pakistan should develop a tourism industry that combines technological innovation with the country’s traditional values of hospitality, respect and responsibility.
The theme of this year’s World Tourism Day is “Digital Agenda and Artificial Intelligence to Redesign Tourism.” The theme highlights how digital technologies and AI are changing the way people plan trips, discover destinations and experience different cultures.
President Zardari Calls for Ethical Use of AI to Promote Tourism in Pakistan
President Zardari said technological developments in tourism should remain responsible, inclusive, and beneficial to people and communities. He stressed the need to align emerging technologies with ethical tourism practices so that local economies can also benefit from digital transformation.
He also highlighted Pakistan’s diverse tourism potential, ranging from the mountains of the north and the ancient civilisations of the Indus Valley to Islamic and Gandhara heritage sites, cities, deserts and coastal areas.
According to the president, Pakistan’s people and their hospitality remain one of the country’s key strengths in attracting visitors. He welcomed international tourists to explore the country while emphasising the importance of preserving its cultural values.
President Zardari also pointed to the wider economic benefits of tourism. He said the sector can create livelihoods, support local businesses and provide new opportunities for young people and women. Tourism can also help generate economic activity in communities across the country.
See Also: PC Hospitality Division Embraces AI to Transform Tourism and Hospitality
At the same time, he stressed the importance of protecting Pakistan’s natural environment, cultural heritage and traditions for future generations.
The president’s message comes as AI and digital platforms increasingly influence the global tourism industry. From discovering destinations to planning travel and accessing information, technology is changing how tourists interact with destinations.
For Pakistan, the growing use of digital technologies could provide new ways to promote its tourism destinations and connect local businesses with visitors, while responsible use of AI could help ensure that technological growth remains aligned with cultural, environmental and community interests.

The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has introduced new features and changes to the income tax return for Tax Year 2026 to make the filing process easier for taxpayers.
The tax authority is providing tax practitioners with information about the latest changes, online filing procedures and other important aspects of the Tax Year 2026 income tax return. The initiative will help taxpayers better understand the filing process and complete their returns more easily.
The FBR and the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan (ICAP) recently held an awareness seminar to brief participants about the new features and key changes introduced in the Tax Year 2026 return. The session also covered the procedure for filing income tax returns online.
FBR Simplifies Income Tax Return Filing for Tax Year 2026
According to the FBR, taxpayers can continue to file their returns through the IRIS online portal. The authority is also providing guidance on submitting income tax returns and wealth statements through the system.
The FBR is also conducting an awareness campaign for small traders regarding the simplified Tajir Return. As part of the campaign, the Regional Tax Office (RTO) Islamabad and the FBR Domain Team briefed more than 100 small traders at the Islamabad Chamber of Commerce and Industry.
Officials explained the return filing procedure and responded to technical questions from traders during the session. The initiative will help small businesses understand their tax filing requirements and use the available digital facilities.
The FBR said it is continuing reforms to digitise the tax system and make the return filing and payment processes more convenient for taxpayers.
See Also: FBR Introduces New Tax Rules for Non-Resident Social Media Influencers
As part of these digital reforms, ePayment 2.0 has recently been integrated into IRIS 2.0. The facility allows taxpayers to make tax payments through internet banking, ATMs and mobile banking.
The latest measures are part of the FBR’s broader efforts to improve digital tax services and simplify compliance for individuals, businesses and small traders. The authority is also continuing awareness initiatives to help taxpayers use the online filing system and meet their tax obligations.

items.author: Web Desk
items.content:
The Ministry of Information on Sunday rejected allegations by the Afghan Taliban regime linking its security forces and intelligence agencies to violence in Afghanistan’s Nuristan province, calling the claims “frivolous, baseless and devoid of any truth”.
"Pakistan categorically rejects the fabricated claims of involvement by its security forces or intelligence agencies in any internal clashes in Nuristan or elsewhere in Afghanistan, including allegations of recruiting or training former Afghan security personnel or facilitating Daesh or any other terrorist group operating in Afghanistan," said the ministry in a statement.
The statement came in response to allegations levelled by the Afghan Taliban’s Ministry of Defence, which claimed that groups affiliated with Daesh, along with what it described as “elements of subversion”, had crossed the Durand Line into Nuristan’s Kamdesh district with the support of Pakistan. The ministry claimed that its security forces had killed 28 of the alleged infiltrators and captured 32 others, while the remaining fighters fled back across the Durand Line.
The ministry further responded to the allegations, stating that not a shred of evidence had been produced to substantiate Pakistan’s involvement
"There were no identities, documents, communications, forensic evidence or independent verification to support the allegations," it said.
The statement also rejected a video being circulated on social media to support the false claim, saying that it "only shows a few unarmed individuals who are not even properly dressed or equipped.'
 
 
𝐅𝐚𝐜𝐭 𝐂𝐡𝐞𝐜𝐤 | 𝐌𝐢𝐧𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐈𝐧𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 & 𝐁𝐫𝐨𝐚𝐝𝐜𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠
◼️ The allegations by the Afghan Taliban regime linking Pakistan with the alleged violence in Nuristan are frivolous, baseless and devoid of any truth. Pakistan categorically rejects… pic.twitter.com/skowInbs0L
— Fact Checker MoIB (@FactCheckerMoIB) September 27, 2026
The ministry described the footage as appearing to be “a pre-planned video shoot by the Afghan Taliban regime well known for lies and fabricated claims”.
The fact-check graphic attached to the post carried the text, “Afghan Defence Ministry claims arrest of Pakistani military personnel and fighters in Nuristan.” It marked the claim as “false and fabricated” and displayed a document by the Afghan Ministry of Defence dated September 27.
The ministry said the presence and activities of terrorist groups inside Afghanistan were “well documented”, including in successive reports by the United Nations and other international organisations.
Read: ‘Irrefutable evidence’ links Afghan soil to terror attacks in Pakistan
“Attempts to manufacture a Pakistani connection cannot obscure the reality that these terrorist groups continue to find sanctuary and a permissive environment for growth in Afghan territory,” it said.
“It is particularly ironic for the Afghan Taliban regime to accuse Pakistan of supporting terrorism while terrorist organisations operating from Afghanistan continue to pose a direct threat to Pakistan and regional security,” the ministry added.
“Instead of externalising responsibility for its internal security challenges through fanciful allegations, the Afghan Taliban regime should take credible and verifiable action against terrorist organisations operating from its territory,” the ministry said.
It also called on the Afghan authorities to fulfil their commitments that Afghan soil would not be used for terrorism against Pakistan or any other country, “rather than attempting to deflect responsibility through fabricated accusations”.
The statement further added that the allegations were “reflective of lies to externalise internal dissent and oppression of women, children and minorities”.
This is not the first time the Afghan Taliban regime has levelled allegations against Pakistan. In the past, it has accused Pakistan of facilitating infiltration, carrying out airstrikes and smuggling weapons into Afghanistan, allegations that Islamabad has repeatedly rejected.
According to security officials, the Afghan Taliban regime has been providing sanctuary, support and patronage to terrorist groups. They said documented evidence contradicted Kabul’s repeated denials and pointed to an entrenched terrorist network operating from Afghan soil.
Pakistan maintains that the terrorist nexus extended beyond the movement of terrorists across the border to their training, arming and operational support.
Read more: Afghan soil must not be used for terrorism, Pakistan tells UN
Security officials estimate that up to 70 per cent of the Fitna al-Khawarij terrorists infiltrating Pakistan were of Afghan origin. They further claim that the Taliban regime had allowed leftover US and NATO weapons to reach terrorist groups, including Fitna al-Khawarij and Fitna al-Hindustan.
In 2026 alone, terrorism emanating from Afghan soil claimed the lives of 1,327 Pakistanis and injured another 2,484, according to figures cited by Pakistani authorities.
The United Nations estimated the strength of TTP in Afghanistan at around 6,000 to 6,500 terrorists. UN reporting had also documented more than 600 terrorist attacks against Pakistan during 2025, including attacks launched from Afghan territory.
According to Pakistani security officials, the TTP had established training facilities in Afghanistan’s Kunar, Nangarhar, Khost and Paktika provinces.
The government has maintained that the issue was fundamentally one of Pakistan's national security and that continued attacks from Afghan soil cannot be addressed through denials alone.
Pakistan says it expected the Taliban regime to fulfil its commitments by taking verifiable action against terrorist groups operating from its territory rather than defending or denying their presence.

items.author: AAMIR ILAYS RANA
items.content:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has described his diplomatic engagements on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) as a significant success, highlighting discussions with Iran as well as Saudi Arabia and Turkiye on regional security and the implementation of the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement (MJDA).
Speaking to The Express Tribune, the prime minister said his meeting with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and trilateral discussions with Saudi Arabia and Turkiye were among the key engagements during his stay in New York.
On August 7, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye formalised their longstanding strategic relationship through the newly signed Makkah pact, a trilateral security framework that its proponents describe as a defensive arrangement aimed at strengthening collective deterrence, enhancing military cooperation and promoting regional stability.
The prime minister said the discussions on the sidelines of the UNGA focused on implementing the agreement and strengthening coordination among the three countries.
Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar separately met his Saudi and Turkish counterparts in New York to review progress on establishing the agreement's institutional structures, including its secretariat, committees and working groups. The three ministers also discussed regional and international security issues.
The security discussions came amid heightened regional tensions, including the conflict involving Iran, the United States and Israel and attacks targeting Saudi Arabia.
Also Read: Makkah pact military chiefs condemn attacks on holy city at Riyadh meeting
PM Shehbaz also held a meeting with Pezeshkian, while Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi separately met with Pakistani officials. The discussions focused on regional developments and efforts to promote dialogue.
Defence Minister Khawaja Asif said the meeting with Pezeshkian was held in an open and candid manner and that the Iranian president had assured the Pakistani side that he would hold further discussions.
Pakistan also conveyed its position on attacks in the region, expressing understanding of Iran's concerns while condemning US and Israeli attacks on Iran. Islamabad also condemned Iranian attacks on what it described as US bases in Gulf countries, maintaining that such actions should not take place.
The discussions also touched on attacks by the Houthis, with Pakistani officials asking Iran to use its influence to persuade them to step back. Pakistan, according to the discussion, was "in a sense, operationally involved" in efforts to address the issue.
The Makkah pact remained a central part of Pakistan's security diplomacy during the visit.
Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir also met the Saudi and Turkish military chiefs as the three countries moved towards operationalising the agreement. A secretariat has been established under the arrangement to facilitate future coordination.
The three countries' military leadership subsequently met in Riyadh to review security threats and discuss intelligence sharing, military coordination and capability integration under the pact.
UNGA address and US engagement
Turning to his UNGA address, PM Shehbaz said US President Donald Trump had praised his speech. He also highlighted his meeting with the International Monetary Fund's managing director, particularly discussions over the impact of higher petroleum prices and the possibility of targeted subsidies for poorer sections of society.
 
The prime minister had earlier said Pakistan remained focused on diplomatic efforts to help end the conflict involving the United States and Iran. His UNGA address also covered Palestine, Kashmir, Gaza and wider regional tensions, including attacks on Saudi Arabia.
Rana Sanaullah, who was among the prime minister's aides involved in discussions during the visit, described the address as concise, saying there was "more sincerity and pain than rhetoric" in the speech.
Before the prime minister's arrival in New York, Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi travelled to Tehran for bilateral discussions. On his return, he briefed PM Shehbaz and Field Marshal Munir on his meetings. The following day, US Chargé d'Affaires Natalie Baker also met Naqvi and sought an update on the developments.
IMF talks and economic priorities
Economic issues were another major focus of the prime minister's discussions in New York.
During his meeting with the IMF, Shehbaz said the Fund had expressed satisfaction with Pakistan's economic reform programme and had no objection to targeted fuel subsidies aimed at protecting poorer sections of society.
The prime minister said the subsidies were not intended for the entire population but were being considered specifically in response to the impact of higher petroleum prices on low-income people.
The IMF team was, meanwhile, in Pakistan for discussions ahead of the next instalment under the country's programme.
Read More: FM Dar reviews Makkah pact implementation with Saudi, Turkish counterparts
The prime minister also discussed his longer-term economic legacy, reflecting on his previous tenure as Punjab chief minister and considering what he could accomplish during the remaining years of his second term as prime minister.
The discussions also covered provincial issues and concerns over limited employment opportunities for young people. While some young Pakistanis leave the country for education, the discussion noted that employment opportunities remain limited for graduates returning with degrees.
Political stability was identified as another priority, with the view that sustained economic stability would require a stable political environment.
Domestic political concerns
The prime minister's diplomatic engagements also took place against the backdrop of domestic political tensions.
PM Shehbaz was aware of the proposed long march in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa and Jamaat-e-Islami chief Hafiz Naeemur Rehman's planned march over the petroleum levy.
After arriving in New York, the prime minister spoke to Rehman and asked him to postpone the Islamabad march, while members of his team, including Rana Sanaullah and Ahsan Iqbal, also held discussions with the JI leadership.
The government requested that the march be put on hold, while Shehbaz offered to discuss the petroleum levy issue with the party.
Overall, the prime minister's engagements in New York brought together Pakistan's immediate diplomatic concerns over the Middle East, the implementation of the Makkah defence pact, economic discussions with the IMF and efforts to manage domestic political pressures.

items.title: Assefa misses women's world record at Berlin Marathon
items.summary:
Ethiopia's Tigst Assefa narrowly missed out on breaking the women's world record at the Berlin Marathon on Sunday, battling through injury to cross the finish line after being on record pace for much of the race.
Assefa was on track to break the record and accelerated in the final 10 kilometres, but faded in the closing stages, visibly limping across the finish line before collapsing on the road.
The Ethiopian missed the podium ceremony as she was receiving medical treatment at the time the honours were handed out.
She finished in a time of 2hr 11min 04min, the third best in history and breaking her personal best and course record of 2:11:53, set in 2023.
Assefa's late fade means the women's world record of 2:09:56 remains in the possession of Ruth Chepngetich, a mark clouded by the Kenyan's three-year doping ban handed down in 2025.
It was an all-Ethiopian podium as Bedatu Hirpa finished second in 2:16:53 and Dera Dida came third in 2:16:55.

items.author: AFP
items.content:
Ethiopia's Tigst Assefa narrowly missed out on breaking the women's world record at the Berlin Marathon on Sunday, battling through injury to cross the finish line after being on record pace for much of the race.
Assefa was on track to break the record and accelerated in the final 10 kilometres, but faded in the closing stages, visibly limping across the finish line before collapsing on the road.
The Ethiopian missed the podium ceremony as she was receiving medical treatment at the time the honours were handed out.
She finished in a time of 2hr 11min 04min, the third best in history and breaking her personal best and course record of 2:11:53, set in 2023.
Assefa's late fade means the women's world record of 2:09:56 remains in the possession of Ruth Chepngetich, a mark clouded by the Kenyan's three-year doping ban handed down in 2025.
It was an all-Ethiopian podium as Bedatu Hirpa finished second in 2:16:53 and Dera Dida came third in 2:16:55.
Ethiopia's Guye Adola won the men's race in 2:02:50, adding another Berlin crown after his 2021 victory in the German capital.
Adola's time was off world record pace and outside the course record of 2:01:09, set in 2022 by five-time Berlin winner Eliud Kipchoge.
The 35-year-old did not take the lead in the race until the 30-kilometre mark but was able to emerge with a lead of almost 30 seconds when he crossed the finish line.
"My goal was to hold back a bit and see what the pacemakers did so I could know exactly what was happening -- and that worked wonderfully well," Adola said to Germany's RTL.
"I love Berlin, totally. I love being back here and there's a pretty good chance I'll be back again."
Gemechu Dida took second in 2:03:19, continuing an impressive event for the Ethiopians, with Gabriel Geay of Tanzania third in 2:03:59.
World record past
Held in temperate September, the Berlin marathon is considered the fastest of the major courses. The world record has been broken 13 times in Berlin, more than anywhere else.
The late withdrawal of men's world record holder Sabastian Sawe, the 2025 Berlin winner who became the first man to crack the two-hour barrier earlier this year, meant hopes of another world mark shifted to Assefa.
Paris Olympics silver medallist Assefa, now a three-time winner in Berlin, pledged to run "better than my best" before Sunday's race, which would put her on track for a shot at the world mark.
Assefa began strongly and had already opened up a lead of 25 seconds by the 5km mark which grew to a minute at 15km.
Assefa largely stayed on world record pace throughout, only dropping below around the 25km mark at the flat course's only incline, before returning to record speed.
The Ethiopian was still on track for the record at 35km, pulling 15 seconds clear of the pace needed. She was still 10 seconds ahead of the required tempo with just two kilometres to go.
But with the finish line almost in sight, Assefa began to be troubled by a foot problem and started limping. She gamely fought on but her hopes at the record were dashed.

items.title: Mantan Developer Rockstar Nilai GTA VI Kemungkinan Tidak Hadir di Switch 2
items.summary:
GTA VI menjadi salah satu game yang paling banyak ditunggu dalam beberapa tahun terakhir. Dengan skala proyek dan ekspektasi yang besar, game terbaru Rockstar Games tersebut saat ini masih diposisikan sebagai game konsol. Namun, kemungkinan hadirnya GTA VI di platform lain kembali menjadi pembahasan, termasuk Nintendo Switch 2.
Jérémy Hartvick, mantan developer Rockstar yang pernah mengerjakan GTA VI hingga 2020, memberikan pandangannya mengenai kemungkinan tersebut dalam wawancara dengan Kiwi Talkz. Menurutnya, port GTA VI ke Switch 2 bukan sesuatu yang terlalu masuk akal dari sisi target audiens, meskipun secara teknis ia menilai game tersebut mungkin saja dibuat berjalan di perangkat Nintendo tersebut.
Hartvick juga menilai bahwa penggemar GTA kemungkinan akan memilih konsol yang memang sudah mendapatkan game tersebut. Namun, pernyataan ini merupakan pandangan pribadi seorang mantan developer dan bukan informasi resmi mengenai rencana Rockstar. Sampai sekarang, belum ada konfirmasi
items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
GTA VI menjadi salah satu game yang paling banyak ditunggu dalam beberapa tahun terakhir. Dengan skala proyek dan ekspektasi yang besar, game terbaru Rockstar Games tersebut saat ini masih diposisikan sebagai game konsol. Namun, kemungkinan hadirnya GTA VI di platform lain kembali menjadi pembahasan, termasuk Nintendo Switch 2.
Jérémy Hartvick, mantan developer Rockstar yang pernah mengerjakan GTA VI hingga 2020, memberikan pandangannya mengenai kemungkinan tersebut dalam wawancara dengan Kiwi Talkz. Menurutnya, port GTA VI ke Switch 2 bukan sesuatu yang terlalu masuk akal dari sisi target audiens, meskipun secara teknis ia menilai game tersebut mungkin saja dibuat berjalan di perangkat Nintendo tersebut.
Hartvick juga menilai bahwa penggemar GTA kemungkinan akan memilih konsol yang memang sudah mendapatkan game tersebut. Namun, pernyataan ini merupakan pandangan pribadi seorang mantan developer dan bukan informasi resmi mengenai rencana Rockstar. Sampai sekarang, belum ada konfirmasi mengenai versi Switch 2.
Baca Juga: Dune: Awakening Kini Tersedia di PS5 dan Xbox, Apa yang Baru?
GTA VI Dinilai Bisa Berjalan di Switch 2 dengan Kompromi
Menurut Hartvick, Switch 2 secara teknis kemungkinan mampu menjalankan Grand Theft Auto VI, tetapi diperlukan sejumlah kompromi. Salah satunya berkaitan dengan kualitas visual yang kemungkinan harus diturunkan agar game dapat berjalan sesuai kemampuan hardware perangkat tersebut.
Hal ini membuat persoalannya bukan sekadar apakah GTA VI mampu dijalankan di Switch 2, tetapi juga apakah hasil akhirnya dapat memenuhi standar performa dan visual yang diharapkan. Rockstar sendiri belum mengumumkan versi Switch 2, sehingga belum diketahui apakah studio tersebut memiliki rencana untuk melakukan optimasi khusus.
Mantan Developer Sebut Smartphone Juga Berpotensi
Menariknya, Hartvick bahkan menyebut GTA VI secara teori dapat dimainkan melalui smartphone jika pengembang benar-benar mengupayakannya. Ia menyebut teknologi yang memungkinkan hal tersebut sebenarnya sudah tersedia, meski pernyataannya tidak menjelaskan apakah yang dimaksud adalah game native atau metode streaming.
Di luar streaming, perkembangan chipset Arm dan translation layer juga membuka kemungkinan menjalankan software PC pada perangkat berbasis Arm. Namun, hal tersebut masih berbeda dengan port resmi dari Rockstar. Untuk saat ini, GTA VI tetap belum diumumkan untuk Switch 2 maupun smartphone, sehingga seluruh pembahasan mengenai kedua platform tersebut masih berada pada tahap kemungkinan teknis, bukan rencana produk yang dikonfirmasi.

items.author: Gargi Sarkar
items.content:
Five years ago, CarTrade became one of the first digital auto marketplaces to test India’s public markets. The company went public in August 2021 at ₹1,618 per share. Five years on, its stock has climbed to around ₹3,000, offering an early read on how investors have valued the online auto marketplace story.
Now, a new crop of used-car and auto commerce startups is preparing to embark on the same quest. Spinny, Cars24 and CarDekho are gearing up for potential public-market debuts. Spinny has pre-filed its IPO papers and is looking to raise ₹2,500 Cr to ₹3,000 Cr through a combination of fresh shares and an offer for sale (OFS), sources told Inc42.
The Gurugram-based startup is targeting a potential listing in 2027. However, the timeline will depend on regulatory approvals, and the final issue size and structure could change during the IPO process.
Spinny’s IPO plans have come to the fore as buying a used car is increasingly becoming a mainstream choice, thanks to the value-conscious Indian consumer. According to Redseer, India’s used-car market is expected to reach around $70 Bn by FY31, with annual sales projected to touch 9-10 Mn vehicles and the segment expected to grow at a 14-18% CAGR.
However, for Spinny, which has built a sizeable business, the real test is converting scale to profitability. Now, let’s get right into the numbers to see how the company is faring financially and what its IPO-bound journey could look like.
Spinny Is In The Fast Lane, But Profits Lag Behind
Spinny’s numbers suggest a business that is scaling rapidly but still working towards consistent profitability. Its operating revenue nearly doubled over two years to ₹4,656 Cr in FY25 and is estimated to have grown another 29% to around ₹6,000 Cr in FY26. The company expects another 25%-30% growth this fiscal. However, it reported a loss of ₹423.8 Cr in FY25, although the loss narrowed by 28% from the previous year.
Investors have shown that they are willing to back new-age companies, but growth alone is no longer enough. Spinny’s IPO will therefore be watched not just for the size of the issue or its valuation, but for how the market prices the trade-off between growth, profitability and the capital required to build a large used-car platform.
The recent correction in auto stocks adds another layer to its IPO story. The Nifty Auto index has fallen nearly 6% this month after several months of gains, while some major OEMs have seen sharper pullbacks.
“Although used-car marketplaces have a different business model from traditional auto companies, a softer sentiment towards the broader auto sector could influence how investors initially approach the category,” an analyst said.
Meanwhile, Spinny is expanding beyond the core retail used-car proposition. Launched last year, its Spinny Circle platform is aimed at helping new-car dealerships manage exchange vehicles through inspection, valuation, sale and settlement. If such initiatives can deepen supply and improve inventory turnover, they could become an important part of the company’s broader IPO narrative.
Can Spinny’s Broader Ecosystem Drive Margins?
Before we explore the question above, let’s take a quick look at how Spinny has evolved before its public-market journey. The company follows an inventory-led, full-stack model, buying used cars directly from consumers, inspecting and refurbishing them before selling them to customers.
In FY25, Spinny’s revenue from contracts with customers stood at ₹4,650 Cr, with nearly 98% coming from car sales, while commission and other income remained relatively smaller. It spent ₹4,304 Cr on purchasing goods, including ₹4,250 Cr on stock-in-trade, alongside ₹136.8 Cr in direct costs such as refurbishment, logistics and warranty.
Now, Spinny is trying to widen the monetisation opportunity beyond the initial vehicle sale. It facilitates financing and insurance and offers warranty and other protection products. It acquired car-servicing and repair startup GoMechanic in a cash-and-stock transaction valued at approximately ₹450 Cr in November 2025. GoMechanic’s FY25 revenues stood at ₹144.5 Cr. The company has yet to release its FY26 results.
“The strategic logic is to bring after-sales servicing into the ecosystem, potentially allowing Spinny to monetise customers beyond the first transaction. It is trying to build a broader ownership ecosystem around the vehicle, rather than relying solely on the margin from the initial sale,” a CXO at a rival marketplace said.
Hence, going forward, whether these adjacent businesses can strengthen the economics of Spinny’s core car-selling engine, rather than simply add more layers to an already capital-intensive model, will be important for the company.
Spinny is looking to enter the public markets at a time when India’s used-car market is becoming large enough to support multiple organised players. The market remains highly fragmented, with nearly 80% of used-car transactions still happening through unorganised channels. This leaves plenty of room for platforms that can bring greater trust and standardisation to the buying process.
Inspection and certification, transparent pricing, financing, warranties, return policies, ownership transfers and doorstep delivery are increasingly becoming part of the organised used-car experience. The opportunity is also moving beyond entry-level vehicles, as rising incomes and shorter ownership cycles bring newer and more premium cars into the resale market.
 
Spinny’s Next Test
Spinny’s potential IPO comes at an inflexion point for India’s used-car market, where scale is no longer the only differentiator. The more interesting divide is emerging between businesses that own and control the vehicle transaction and those that operate as asset-light marketplaces. CarTrade sits closer to the latter, with businesses spanning classifieds, auctions and vehicle remarketing, while Spinny has built an inventory-led model around sourcing, refurbishing, pricing and selling cars directly to consumers.
Owning inventory gives the company greater control over vehicle quality, pricing and the customer experience, but also exposes it to inventory management, refurbishment and resale-value risks. E20 petrol, EVs and changing fuel preferences are other risks that could potentially impact the resale value and demand of used cars.
For Spinny, the next phase is not simply about adding more vehicles or cities. It is about building the intelligence to decide which cars to buy, at what price, where to place them and how quickly to sell them, while extracting more value from the customer through financing, insurance and after-sales.
[Edited by Shishir Parasher]

items.title: Qualcomm Dikabarkan Siapkan Dukungan DirectX 12 untuk Emulasi Game PC di Android
items.summary:
Qualcomm dikabarkan tengah mempertimbangkan dukungan resmi DirectX 12 pada chipset Snapdragon untuk meningkatkan kemampuan emulasi game PC di Android. Informasi ini datang dari seorang YouTuber asal China yang mengklaim telah menguji fitur tersebut menggunakan perangkat referensi berbasis Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6.
Dalam pengujiannya, perangkat tersebut disebut mampu menjalankan Cyberpunk 2077 dan Black Myth: Wukong melalui translation layer dalam mode DirectX 12. Jika dukungan ini benar-benar diterapkan secara resmi, pengguna Android berpotensi mendapatkan cara yang lebih praktis untuk menjalankan sejumlah game PC melalui emulator.
Meski demikian, masih ada banyak hal yang belum diketahui. Qualcomm belum mengonfirmasi apakah dukungan DirectX 12 tersebut akan benar-benar dirilis, apakah hanya tersedia untuk chipset terbaru, atau apakah generasi Snapdragon sebelumnya juga akan mendapatkannya. Mekanisme distribusi driver juga kemungkinan bergantung pada masing-masing produsen smartphone.

items.content:
Qualcomm dikabarkan tengah mempertimbangkan dukungan resmi DirectX 12 pada chipset Snapdragon untuk meningkatkan kemampuan emulasi game PC di Android. Informasi ini datang dari seorang YouTuber asal China yang mengklaim telah menguji fitur tersebut menggunakan perangkat referensi berbasis Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6.
Dalam pengujiannya, perangkat tersebut disebut mampu menjalankan Cyberpunk 2077 dan Black Myth: Wukong melalui translation layer dalam mode DirectX 12. Jika dukungan ini benar-benar diterapkan secara resmi, pengguna Android berpotensi mendapatkan cara yang lebih praktis untuk menjalankan sejumlah game PC melalui emulator.
Meski demikian, masih ada banyak hal yang belum diketahui. Qualcomm belum mengonfirmasi apakah dukungan DirectX 12 tersebut akan benar-benar dirilis, apakah hanya tersedia untuk chipset terbaru, atau apakah generasi Snapdragon sebelumnya juga akan mendapatkannya. Mekanisme distribusi driver juga kemungkinan bergantung pada masing-masing produsen smartphone.
Baca Juga: Qualcomm Perpanjang Lisensi Paten dengan Apple, Berlaku Mulai 2027
Snapdragon Terbaru Mulai Diuji untuk Game PC
Pengujian pada Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 menjadi menarik karena chipset tersebut berada di generasi terbaru Qualcomm. Dengan dukungan DirectX 12 yang lebih baik di sisi driver, translation layer tidak perlu bergantung sepenuhnya pada solusi yang dikembangkan pihak ketiga untuk menerjemahkan API grafis PC ke lingkungan Android.
Kemampuan menjalankan Cyberpunk 2077 dan Black Myth: Wukong juga menunjukkan potensi perangkat mobile modern untuk menangani game PC yang cukup berat. Namun, keberhasilan menjalankan game belum otomatis berarti performanya setara dengan PC. Frame rate, stabilitas, konsumsi daya, kompatibilitas, hingga panas perangkat masih menjadi faktor yang perlu diuji lebih lanjut.
Belum Jelas Soal Dukungan Chip dan Update Driver
Saat ini belum diketahui apakah fitur tersebut hanya ditujukan untuk Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 dan Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. Qualcomm juga belum menjelaskan apakah dukungan DirectX 12 akan diberikan melalui pembaruan driver untuk perangkat yang sudah beredar atau hanya tersedia pada produk baru.
Hal lain yang perlu diperhatikan adalah distribusi driver pada ekosistem Android. Meskipun Qualcomm menyediakan dukungan di tingkat chipset, produsen smartphone tetap memiliki peran dalam menyediakan pembaruan driver kepada pengguna. Karena itu, implementasi akhirnya bisa berbeda antarperangkat. Untuk saat ini, dukungan DirectX 12 tersebut masih sebatas informasi dari pengujian pihak ketiga dan belum menjadi fitur resmi yang dikonfirmasi Qualcomm.
Artikel berjudul Qualcomm Dikabarkan Siapkan Dukungan DirectX 12 untuk Emulasi Game PC di Android yang ditulis oleh Christopher Louis pertama kali tampil di Gizmologi.id

items.title: Samsung Galaxy A08 Resmi di Indonesia, Bawa Baterai 6.000 mAh dan Dukungan Update 6 Tahun
items.summary:
Samsung Electronics Indonesia resmi membawa Galaxy A08 ke pasar Indonesia. Smartphone ini menyasar segmen entry-level dengan sejumlah fitur yang cukup menarik di kelasnya, mulai dari baterai 6.000 mAh, chipset MediaTek Helio G99+, hingga dukungan pembaruan software dalam jangka panjang.
Galaxy A08 juga membawa beberapa fitur berbasis AI seperti Circle to Search, Google Gemini, dan Perplexity. Samsung turut memberikan RAM LPDDR5 yang diklaim memiliki kecepatan transfer data hingga 30 persen lebih tinggi dibandingkan LPDDR4X pada generasi sebelumnya. Namun, klaim tersebut tetap perlu dilihat dalam penggunaan sehari-hari karena pengalaman performa tidak hanya ditentukan oleh jenis RAM.
Di sisi software, Galaxy A08 mendapatkan dukungan hingga enam generasi pembaruan sistem operasi dan enam tahun pembaruan keamanan. Samsung juga membekali perangkat dengan Knox Vault serta sertifikasi IP64. Kombinasi tersebut menunjukkan fokus Samsung pada penggunaan jangka panjang, meskipun spesifikasi lain
items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
Samsung Electronics Indonesia resmi membawa Galaxy A08 ke pasar Indonesia. Smartphone ini menyasar segmen entry-level dengan sejumlah fitur yang cukup menarik di kelasnya, mulai dari baterai 6.000 mAh, chipset MediaTek Helio G99+, hingga dukungan pembaruan software dalam jangka panjang.
Galaxy A08 juga membawa beberapa fitur berbasis AI seperti Circle to Search, Google Gemini, dan Perplexity. Samsung turut memberikan RAM LPDDR5 yang diklaim memiliki kecepatan transfer data hingga 30 persen lebih tinggi dibandingkan LPDDR4X pada generasi sebelumnya. Namun, klaim tersebut tetap perlu dilihat dalam penggunaan sehari-hari karena pengalaman performa tidak hanya ditentukan oleh jenis RAM.
Di sisi software, Galaxy A08 mendapatkan dukungan hingga enam generasi pembaruan sistem operasi dan enam tahun pembaruan keamanan. Samsung juga membekali perangkat dengan Knox Vault serta sertifikasi IP64. Kombinasi tersebut menunjukkan fokus Samsung pada penggunaan jangka panjang, meskipun spesifikasi lainnya tetap perlu dipertimbangkan sebelum memilih perangkat ini.
Baca Juga: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Dikabarkan Bawa Baterai 5.700 mAh, Charging Tetap 60W
Helio G99+ dan Baterai 6.000 mAh
Samsung Galaxy A08 menggunakan Helio G99+ berbasis proses 6nm dan dipadukan dengan RAM LPDDR5. Konfigurasi tersebut ditujukan untuk kebutuhan seperti multitasking, media sosial, konsumsi konten, hingga aktivitas gaming ringan. Samsung menyebut penggunaan LPDDR5 dapat meningkatkan kecepatan transfer data hingga 30 persen dibandingkan LPDDR4X.
Sementara itu, kapasitas baterai 6.000 mAh menjadi salah satu daya tarik utama perangkat ini. Kapasitas tersebut cukup besar untuk smartphone di kelasnya dan berpotensi memberikan waktu penggunaan yang panjang. Namun, daya tahan aktual tetap bergantung pada pola penggunaan, jaringan, tingkat kecerahan layar, serta aplikasi yang berjalan.
Bawa AI dan Dukungan Software Jangka Panjang
Untuk fitur AI, Galaxy A08 menghadirkan Circle to Search yang memungkinkan pengguna mencari informasi dari objek atau konten di layar dengan cara melingkarinya. Samsung juga menyertakan akses ke Gemini dan Perplexity untuk kebutuhan pencarian informasi maupun bantuan berbasis AI.
Galaxy A08 tersedia dalam konfigurasi 4GB/64GB seharga Rp2.999.000 dan 4GB/128GB seharga Rp3.599.000. Penjualan perdana berlangsung mulai 26 September melalui Official Shop Samsung di Shopee, sebelum diperluas ke kanal penjualan lainnya pada 2 Oktober. Dengan dukungan software hingga enam tahun, Galaxy A08 menawarkan masa penggunaan yang cukup panjang di atas kertas, meski pengguna tetap perlu mempertimbangkan kapasitas RAM dan penyimpanan sesuai kebutuhan.

items.title: iPad Entry-Level 2027 Dikabarkan Bawa Chip A19 dan RAM 8GB
items.summary:
Apple dikabarkan tengah menyiapkan generasi baru iPad entry-level yang diperkirakan meluncur pada musim semi 2027. Tablet ini disebut akan hadir sekitar dua tahun setelah model iPad entry-level yang diperkenalkan pada Maret 2025. Meski masih cukup jauh dari waktu peluncuran, sejumlah spesifikasi utama perangkat disebut telah ditemukan di dalam kode Apple.
Menurut laporan tersebut, generasi berikutnya akan menggunakan chip A19 dengan RAM 8GB. Jika benar, konfigurasi ini akan menjadi peningkatan dibandingkan model saat ini yang masih mengandalkan A16 dan RAM 6GB. Informasi tersebut belum dikonfirmasi Apple, sehingga spesifikasi final masih bisa berubah sebelum perangkat resmi diperkenalkan.
Peningkatan lain disebut datang dari sisi konektivitas dan fitur AI. iPad baru diperkirakan mendukung Apple Intelligence serta Siri generasi baru. Apple juga dikabarkan menyiapkan modem C1X dan chip jaringan N1, yang membawa dukungan terhadap sejumlah standar konektivitas terbaru.
Baca Juga: iPad mini
items.author: Christopher Louis
items.content:
Apple dikabarkan tengah menyiapkan generasi baru iPad entry-level yang diperkirakan meluncur pada musim semi 2027. Tablet ini disebut akan hadir sekitar dua tahun setelah model iPad entry-level yang diperkenalkan pada Maret 2025. Meski masih cukup jauh dari waktu peluncuran, sejumlah spesifikasi utama perangkat disebut telah ditemukan di dalam kode Apple.
Menurut laporan tersebut, generasi berikutnya akan menggunakan chip A19 dengan RAM 8GB. Jika benar, konfigurasi ini akan menjadi peningkatan dibandingkan model saat ini yang masih mengandalkan A16 dan RAM 6GB. Informasi tersebut belum dikonfirmasi Apple, sehingga spesifikasi final masih bisa berubah sebelum perangkat resmi diperkenalkan.
Peningkatan lain disebut datang dari sisi konektivitas dan fitur AI. iPad baru diperkirakan mendukung Apple Intelligence serta Siri generasi baru. Apple juga dikabarkan menyiapkan modem C1X dan chip jaringan N1, yang membawa dukungan terhadap sejumlah standar konektivitas terbaru.
Baca Juga: iPad mini 8 Bocor dengan Chip A20 Pro, Layar OLED Masih Jadi Tanda Tanya
Bawa A19 dan Apple Intelligence
Penggunaan A19 akan menjadi salah satu perubahan utama pada iPad entry-level berikutnya. Chip tersebut dipadukan dengan RAM 8GB, sehingga secara spesifikasi perangkat ini berpotensi memiliki ruang lebih besar untuk menjalankan fitur berbasis AI dibandingkan generasi sebelumnya.
Apple Intelligence juga disebut akan tersedia sejak perangkat diluncurkan, termasuk dukungan terhadap Siri baru. Namun, kehadiran fitur tersebut tidak serta-merta menjelaskan bagaimana seluruh kemampuan AI akan diterapkan pada iPad entry-level. Apple sendiri belum memberikan rincian resmi mengenai perangkat yang dimaksud.
Modem C1X dan Wi-Fi 7
Dari sisi konektivitas, tablet Apple baru dikabarkan menggunakan modem C1X dengan dukungan jaringan 5G sub-6GHz. Perangkat ini juga disebut membawa chip N1 yang mendukung Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, dan Thread. Jika spesifikasi tersebut benar, peningkatannya tidak hanya berada pada performa pemrosesan, tetapi juga konektivitas.
Sementara itu, harga menjadi salah satu hal yang masih belum diketahui. Tablet dari Apple yang masuk ke pasar entry-level saat ini dibanderol mulai US449 setelah kenaikan harga pada Juni. Dengan tambahan spesifikasi dan fitur baru tersebut, ada kemungkinan harga generasi berikutnya ikut meningkat, meski angka US499 sejauh ini masih sebatas perkiraan. Apple sendiri belum mengonfirmasi harga maupun jadwal peluncuran iPad tersebut.

items.author: Henry Oduah
items.content:
Spain can get even better despite extending their unbeaten run to 39 games, said coach Luis de la Fuente after coming from behind to beat England 3-2 at Wembley in the Nations League.
In their first match since being crowned world champions for the second time, La Roja were hit by an English storm just before half-time as Anthony Gordon and Harry Kane put the Three Lions in front.
But the European champions responded as Alex Baena levelled before Mikel Oyarzabal struck the winner, just as he did when the sides met in the final of Euro 2024.
“What this generation of footballers is achieving has great merit. They are constantly striving to improve,” said De la Fuente. “The statistics speak for themselves.
“It is incredibly difficult what Spain are doing. We will approach the next match against Croatia as if it was our last. These players always want to keep improving.”
Spain got off to the perfect start when Lamine Yamal robbed Marc Guehi before slotting home.
Yamal could be back in London next month as he dreams of winning the Ballon d’Or for the first time.
“His performance was exceptional; we are lucky to have him,” added De la Fuente of the 19-year-old.
“He plays exactly as the match demands, utilising both his own attributes and those of his teammates.”
AFP

items.author: Henry Oduah
items.content:
England captain Harry Kane said that the Three Lions produced some of their best football for a long time despite losing 3-2 at home to world champions Spain in the Nations League on Friday.
Thomas Tuchel’s men got off to a disastrous start when Marc Guehi gifted Lamine Yamal the opening goal at Wembley.
But England roared back to lead before half-time thanks to a brilliant counter-attack finished off by Anthony Gordon and Kane’s header.
Kane then hit the bar with a second half penalty that would have made it 3-1 before Spain roared back to extend their unbeaten run to 39 games through Alex Baena and Mikel Oyarzabal.
It was a familiar tale of what could have been for England, who have reached the semi-finals in four of their last five major tournaments without ending their wait since 1966 to win one.
“We reached good levels in the World Cup, but didn’t quite put a full 90 minutes together. Probably similar again today,” Kane told ITV.
“We had a lot of good moments, so I think that period (either side of half-time) was as good as we’ve played in a long, long time and that’s the standard that we know we can reach.
“We’re playing against the reigning world champions, European champions. We went toe-to-toe and on another day, for sure, we would win that game.”
Tuchel was left to bemoan the two defensive errors that cost his side victory.
Nico O’Riley followed Manchester City team-mate Guehi into gifting possession away deep inside England’s half in the build up to Baena’s equaliser.
“On that level, the details matter. It matters that you take your chances and it matters that you reduce the decisive mistakes. Both was not in our favour today,” said Tuchel.
“The effort was there, the quality was there, spells of the game were very, very good, but the result isn’t perfect today.”
AFP

items.author: Ayobami
items.content:
By Emma Ujah, Abuja Bureau Chief
Nigeria’s total public debt stock rose to N166.79 trillion as of June 30, 2026, the Debt Management Office (DMO) has revealed in its latest data, released at the weekend.
That figure indicated an increase of N7.44 trillion from N159.35 trillion recorded at the end of the first quarter of the year.
The breakdown showed that domestic debt accounted for N91.59 trillion, or 54.91 per cent of the total portfolio, while external debt made up the balance.
In dollar terms, the country’s total public debt stood at $120.93 billion, comprising $54.52 billion in external debt and $66.41 billion in domestic debt.
The external debt component was converted using the Central Bank of Nigeria’s official exchange rate of N1,379.1842 as of June 30, 2026.
The Federal Government of Nigeria (FGN) accounted for the bulk of both domestic and external debt.
According to the DMO, the federal government accounted for N152.77 trillion of the total debt stock, comprising N86.99 trillion in domestic debt and N65.77 trillion in external debt.
State governments and the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) accounted for the remaining N14.01 trillion, made up of N4.59 trillion in domestic debt and N9.42 trillion in external debt.
The federal government’s bonds remained the largest category, as it stood at N64.84 trillion, representing 74.53 per cent of FGN domestic debt.
Nigerian Treasury Bills came next, accounting for N19.48 trillion, or 22.39 per cent, of FGN domestic debt.
FGN Sukuk stood at N1.19 trillion, promissory notes at N1.22 trillion (comprising N206.82 billion in naira-denominated notes and N1.01 trillion in foreign-currency-denominated notes), FGN savings bonds at N122.45 billion, the green bond at N47.36 billion, and the green bond at N47.36 billion.

items.author: Ayobami
items.content:
By Ayobami Okerinde
The National Chairman of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Nentawe Yilwatda, says more than 10 million vulnerable Nigerians who benefited from the N75,000 conditional cash transfer programme do not have access to mobile phones or social media.
Yilwatda disclosed this on Saturday while speaking with journalists after a three-day retreat of the APC National Executive Council in Maiduguri, Borno State.
The beneficiaries, whom he described as poor and vulnerable Nigerians, were largely unable to participate in public discussions about government policies because they lacked access to phones, television and social media.
“We have given 75,000 naira to over 10 million Nigerians across the country using the conditional cash transfer under the Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction.
“Mind you, these people who are poor and vulnerable don’t have telephones to make calls; they are not on social media. They don’t have a television. They cannot come and challenge and discuss as we are doing here, but they are out there,” he said.
Yilwatda also criticised former Vice President and African Democratic Congress presidential candidate, Atiku Abubakar, over his position on the fuel subsidy.
“We are constructing roads and paying people that are working on the road site, and construction is going across the country,” he said.
“Over 30 states could not pay salaries and pensions. After we removed subsidies, all states can pay salaries and pensions, and no state is left behind.
“Today, if you return it, you are saying states shouldn’t pay salaries again. And what suffering are you bringing to Nigeria?”
The APC chairman also argued that a return to fuel subsidy would affect the government’s student loan scheme and other projects.
“The projects we’re doing across the country, like the coastal road and gas project to the north, which have passed Abuja, which are aimed at easing the suffering of Nigerians, will be suspended,” he said.
Yilwatda further accused Atiku of seeking to reverse the gains of the Tinubu administration in pursuit of the presidency, saying the APC and Nigerians would not accept such a move.
The APC chairman said the NEC retreat also reviewed the party’s activities at the national, state, local government, ward and polling-unit levels.
According to him, the party concluded that it remained strong and prepared for the 2027 general elections.
He said the NEC passed a vote of confidence in President Bola Tinubu, Vice President Kashim Shettima and other APC candidates who emerged from the party’s primaries for the 2027 elections.
